This baffled Elijah because he thought she was a gold-digger.

A DNA test will be carried out and justice will be served.

He wants her to marry his dad who pretends to be a chauffeur.

When they accidentally meet on the street, can they rekindle their lost love?

Determined to find a boyfriend before graduation, Lindsay's attempts often end in awkward situations with unreliable guys. However, Wayne is always there to help when she’s in trouble. As their bond deepens, they start a secret relationship. Meanwhile, bullying at school escalates, prompting Lindsay to take a stand for her peers. Her efforts earn the support and respect of the school community. In the end, Lindsay and Wayne are crowned Prom King and Queen, and Mike finally approves of their relationship.
675110c567a002f3b1017570.title: The Virgin's Bucket List

6752885d3d9eb9334300b6ca.synopsis: Victoria was set to return to Texas with her fiancé Carl to plan their wedding, but she was horrifically humiliated and betrayed by him. To save face with her family, Victoria reluctantly agrees to marry Simon, a homeless man she had been helping. Little did she know, Simon is not just any homeless man—he's a handsome and charming billionaire, the CEO of the prestigious Savage Group, ranked number one in the country. Upon returning to Texas with Simon, Victoria unexpectedly crosses paths with her arrogant ex, Carl. This time, she’s determined to reclaim all the dignity she lost.
6752885d3d9eb9334300b6ca.title: Found A Homeless Billionaire Husband for Christmas

6753b6ca3fc663ea500b579a.synopsis: Forever invisible Skylar Heron hasn't started her senior year so hot. First, she's embarrassed in front of the whole school when trying to ask out her crush Jamie Donner, her childhood best friend and next-door neighbor. Then, she gets paired up with him to work on a class project together. And, finally, to top it all off, she's forced to live with him when his house burns down and he moves into her room! But now, Jamie's crazy ex-girlfriend is out to make their lives hell. The only thing that can save both their years is... to turn the school freak into the most popular girl in school!
6753b6ca3fc663ea500b579a.title: The Quarterback Next Door

6756a3f1e1061984750adf70.synopsis: After a one-night stand with Ben, the hottest guy on campus, Kelsey realizes she's pregnant...and decides to keep the baby. But will Ben stick around - or will he stay a flirty fratboy forever?
6756a3f1e1061984750adf70.title: Straight A Pregnancy

67579a7115ee2c04c30da549.synopsis: Becca needed the break after a rough year attending Yale and a break-up with her boyfriend. She didn’t expect for her summer of fun to include sleeping with James, the Italian Stallion–her best friend's father. Knowing it’s wrong, she allows James to pull her into a vortex of pleasure that has her breaching the surface of reality and grasping for survival. Can Becca endure this pleasure without Tally finding out? Or will her secrets cause her world to crash around her?
67579a7115ee2c04c30da549.title: Submitting to My Best Friend's Dad

675a3400df0746172507d41c.synopsis: Betrayed by her fiance and her own sister, Esther marries Ricky without knowing his real identity – a secret billionaire. Together, they have to stand up against Esther's evil family, take back her mother’s company and find their happy ending.
675a3400df0746172507d41c.title: Married In A Heartbeat

675b8a0680590480bc08b778.synopsis: This Christmas, Eddie travels to his loving wife’s hometown to finally reveal he’s the billionaire CEO of the nation’s hottest start-up. But in a house and town full of Scrooges, will Eddie’s arrival be a Christmas present, or go down like a lump of coal?
675b8a0680590480bc08b778.title: Secret Billionaire Returns on Christmas

675b8fc5111c95d759079ada.synopsis: Nerdy girl Pearl is determined to catch the eye of her longtime crush, but is clueless on how to do it. But after a shocking encounter with Ethan Hart, the school's biggest bad boy, she makes a deal with him that will finally get her noticed. With his help, Pearl catches the attention of the guy she wants and sparks do fly... but in the wrong direction.
675b8fc5111c95d759079ada.title: The Hart-Breaker

675b906f095133d4f90de304.synopsis: After a medical mishap, the virgin Violet Gray becomes pregnant with the child of a billionaire stranger, Carter Watts. To provide for the child, they are forced into a hasty marriage. Carter leaves for a business trip and is away for six years, during which Violet raises their son, Patrick, on her own while working at a five-star hotel. Unexpectedly, the hotel is bought out by a mysterious new owner—Carter himself! However, after six years apart, they no longer recognize each other. By chance, Violet discovers that her charming boss, Carter Watts, is actually her long-lost husband...
675b906f095133d4f90de304.title: Genius Baby Gets Daddy Back

676101d414d3779d1608fc2a.synopsis: After Sam's ex cheats on her and steals her money, Calladan Vandalay marries her at first sight. But he doesn't tell her that he's secretly the richest billionaire in the country. What will Sam do when she finds out? And can they keep their true identities a secret from the preying family and friends in Sam's life?
676101d414d3779d1608fc2a.title: Fake Married to My Billionaire CEO

67624d5d75f46bc2a80c3380.synopsis: When the fate of a business marriage seems inevitable, Emma Watson, the heiress of the Watson family, takes on an internship at Anderson Corporation. Meanwhile, Ethan Anderson, the heir of the Anderson family, steps in as the new CEO. Both hide their true identities while evaluating each other, but they unexpectedly fall in love at first sight. However, things take an unexpected turn when someone else mistakenly claims Emma’s identity, and she mistakenly believes another man is her “fiancé.” Determined, both Emma and Ethan set out to break off their "engagements" with their so-called "fiancés." Will they ever realize that the person they're searching for has been right in front of them all along?
67624d5d75f46bc2a80c3380.title: Secret Strangers in Love

6763331070d4a48fb00bc994.synopsis: Damian, the CEO of the world's most powerful military-industrial group, is mistaken for a poor salesman earning only $3,000 a month. Unexpectedly, he enters into a quick contract marriage with Iris, a company’s boss. Damian accompanies Iris to her hometown for a Christmas dinner, where he faces constant belittlement from her relatives and ridicule from Iris's suitor. Damian continually turns the tables on the antagonists, proving his power and status, and ultimately finds true love with Iris.
6763331070d4a48fb00bc994.title: Money, Guns, and a Merry Christmas

6764b7033cd5d1a54a0b52db.synopsis: Welcome to ReelTalk, a weekly ReelShort podcast hosted by Rachel Bencosme! Join us as we spill the tea with your favorite stars and dive into the raw, real conversations about life and ReelShort shows. With new episodes dropping every Friday, ReelTalk is sure to keep you hooked and coming back for more!
6764b7033cd5d1a54a0b52db.title: ReelTalk EP1-Under the Mistletoe with Seth and Nicole

67693591880cdb5cef0d563a.synopsis: Olivia and Finn are total opposites - she's a studious, artistic good girl, and he's a rebellious party animal straight out of rehab. But when they hook up the night before Olivia's dad marries Finn's mom, they realize they have one thing in common: their obsession with each other. Can Olivia put her feelings for her bad boy stepbrother aside?
67693591880cdb5cef0d563a.title: Oops! I’m in Love with My Stepbrother

676dc3b9d143b166f80d57dc.synopsis: Ever wondered what your favorite ReelShort stars are like when the cameras are off? In this episode, Rachel Bencosme gets REEL personal with Seth Edeen and Nicole Mattox. Tune in as they give us the inside scoop on fans, dating, pet peeves, and the red flags they just can’t ignore. Buckle up for some candid confessions. You’ll never look at them the same way again!
676dc3b9d143b166f80d57dc.title: ReelTalk EP2-Let’s get reel personal

676dda478fc3bbcd4c0d1375.synopsis: To avenge her mother, Daisy disguises herself as a dancer to get close to the dangerous mafia boss, Hogan. Despite suspecting Daisy's intentions, Hogan finds himself irresistibly drawn to her deadly charm. Will Daisy manage to walk away unscathed, or will she be entangled in passion with Hogan?
676dda478fc3bbcd4c0d1375.title: Fatal Attraction: A Dark Mafia Romance

676e5f6b061f6ac5dc07eca9.synopsis: When Becca Morris gets a soccer scholarship to her dream school, Cliffton College, she gets some startling news alongside her orientation packet: she’s pregnant. But that doesn’t stop the varsity captain, Max, from falling for her. Together, Max and Becca hide her secret from scheming soccer players, a vengeful ex, and the soccer coach from Hell. But with a baby on the way, will Max give up his picture perfect image to be with Becca?
676e5f6b061f6ac5dc07eca9.title: Baby Daddy Goals

676e620de4d70b4ba105e2cd.synopsis: In DILFS movie, after moving to a new city, events out of Jordan’s control force her and her daughter to stay with three sexy single dads: Mason, who is gruff and bristly with a tragic past; Landon, the bad boy charmer; and Eli, your ice king boss. But after a night of passion with all three of them, Jordan finds herself pregnant. Which DILF is the father?
676e620de4d70b4ba105e2cd.title: DILFS

676f15658115af7a38038820.synopsis: Married moments after meeting for the first time, new couple Maya Moore and Ethan Armstrong attempt to make their spontaneous marriage work despite interference from their enemies and Maya’s mysterious past.
676f15658115af7a38038820.title: Hello, Let's Get Married

6771c32e13a2b724ec0341ca.synopsis: When Katie's younger sister's cancer worsens, she finds herself signing a contract to give birth to a mysterious billionaire's heir. However, when proving their relationship to the CEO's grandpa turns out to be more difficult than expected, Katie and Mr. Brandt find themselves growing closer to one another, despite the contract's one and only rule: no falling in love.
6771c32e13a2b724ec0341ca.title: Baby Trapped by the Billionaire

677352c9ba6133358b0d6915.synopsis: Meg and Jesse gets bubbly as they ring in the new year with Rachel Bencosme for a fun, reflective, and slightly competitive episode! The duo takes a trip down memory lane to revisit the biggest trends that made 2024 unforgettable. Did they hop on the latest TikTok lingo? Did they rock any of the Gen Z fashion fads? Find out as they play a hilarious round of End-of-Year Bingo, checking off all the trends they (or definitely didn’t) partake in! But that’s not all. Meg and Jesse also spill their plans, goals, and resolutions for 2025. Grab a glass (or two) and tune in for a mix of laughs, insights, and maybe a few surprises along the way!
677352c9ba6133358b0d6915.title: ReelTalk EP3-Are New Year's Resolutions Still a Thing?

67771c12e2935b96d307b5dd.synopsis: After getting her wolf, Maya learns that the alpha of her pack, Liam, is her fated mate. Meanwhile, the evil Rogue King searches for the True Luna who will be his bride, to make his power complete and help usher in a reign of darkness. Maya is this True Luna, and she must reckon with her destiny and the danger and transformation it brings.
67771c12e2935b96d307b5dd.title: In Love with the Alpha

67773dcf3d3252065f0e5651.synopsis: Emma and Liam shared a magical night together that ended abruptly when Liam left the next morning without a explanation. Six months later, they get reunited at Emma's sister's wedding where Liam is the best man. As their unsolved feelings come rushing back, Emma decides to fake date Liam for the weekend to get her ex to leave her alone.
67773dcf3d3252065f0e5651.title: Love Me Two Times

6777604056f3bf9f960768eb.synopsis: A car accident leaves Winnie's daughter on the brink of death. Her doctor husband, Aaron, chooses to save his first love Monica's child instead, leading to the death of his own daughter. Winnie seeks justice for her lost child, only to face relentless interference from Monica and distrust from her husband.
6777604056f3bf9f960768eb.title: When Love Comes Too Late

677a0db90fc9407e14077c4c.synopsis: College student Sylvia Parker finds herself in a dangerous love affair with Lawrence Calhoun, the last man she should want. He's hot, he's harsh -- he's her professor. As Sylvia struggles to survive in a cutthroat campus and toxic family, never has she thought her hero would be the cold, strict and sexy Professor Calhoun. As their connection deepens, a forbidden romance blooms, threatening to destroy everything if discovered.
677a0db90fc9407e14077c4c.title: Surrender to My Professor

677a0e9a35ae034cbf0a0628.synopsis: This story follows Astra, a determined girl gifted with extraordinary strength. When her twin brother loses his voice before a crucial band rehearsal, he’s threatened by a lawsuit. Astra steps in for him. Disguised as a boy, she resides in the boys’ dorm to uphold the ruse despite lacking musical talent and being unmistakably female. Amidst comedic mishaps and tense moments, Astra discovers unexpected love and genuine companionship.
677a0e9a35ae034cbf0a0628.title: Rock On! Band Beauty in Disguise

677db481a3cc638b8f0d8a59.synopsis: Giselle, the Duke's daughter and rightful heiress of the Von Howard's family, married Patrick Hilton three years ago after he saved her life. She secretly helped his company go public, but constant harassment from Patrick’s mother and relentless taunts from Becky leave Giselle, now pregnant, feeling hopeless. She decides to divorce Patrick. Despite everything, Patrick’s heart belongs only to Giselle. After the divorce, he realizes how much he needs her and begins a long journey to win her back.
677db481a3cc638b8f0d8a59.title: The Heiress Blacklisted Her Husband

677db51b4b143c5a8007f0f1.synopsis: After Erik, the biggest tech hotshot in all of Silicon Valley, gets sacked by his CEO's son William, he joins forces with Evelyn, the beautiful CEO of his old company's competitor. This causes his former employer to go bankrupt, and when William realizes he's fired the wrong guy, it's already too late...
677db51b4b143c5a8007f0f1.title: You Fired A Tech Genius

677db68bc980db58d5072f41.synopsis: In a marathon of trumping identities, Lily must own her cheating ex, his mistress, their moms, her new royal suitor, the women after her true love, and finally, the dominant mother-in-law! Can Lily win them all?
677db68bc980db58d5072f41.title: Heiress Crash Lands on Her Husband

677f61d34c0424fd9a082408.synopsis: When Logan Everett rescues Alexis Lee from her abusive boyfriend, a night of passion leads to pregnancy. As their feelings deepen they discover they share a terrible connection: Logan accidentally killed Alexis’s brother during a hockey game the previous year. Can Logan and alexis overcome their violent pasts and build the family they so desperately want?
677f61d34c0424fd9a082408.title: Pucked and Pregnant

6780eb6c148d4c1e260a3744.synopsis: In this must-see episode, Meg Bush and Jesse Morales tell us all about their new show 'Baby Trapped by the Billionaire', including their reactions to never-before-seen footage! From sizzling steamy scenes to revealing what it's really like to film those intimate moments together, they go all-in on the drama. But that's not all—brace yourself for jaw-dropping revelations as they showcase some impressive hidden talents that you definitely didn’t see coming. Laugh, cheer, and maybe even fan yourself as they pull back the curtain on their real lives.
6780eb6c148d4c1e260a3744.title: ReelTalk EP4-The Reel Magic and High Notes

6787610bf8d7a706380a969f.synopsis: When a small-town doctor unexpectedly crosses paths with a sexy, mysterious soldier, sparks fly. But as their relationship blooms, both are forced to keep the real reasons for their whirlwind romance and the truth behind their identities a secret. He's a special forces ace and secret billionaire. She's a special ops agent undercover. Both operatives have a single mission--to investigate and ultimately eliminate one another. Will they risk sacrificing everything for loyalty or love?
6787610bf8d7a706380a969f.title: Double Life of My Military Man

67887e2258dceeba8200f5b7.synopsis: Betrayed by her family, Skylar is forced into a compromising situation with a sleazy-looking director in exchange for her grandmother's medical bills. However, she unexpectedly has a one-night stand with Maxwell, CEO of Klein Group, instead, leading to an unplanned pregnancy. Sent abroad, Skyhlar returns six years later with her son and opens a restaurant. Fate eventually brings her and Maxwell back... Will he recognize Skylar as the unforgettable woman from that fateful night?
67887e2258dceeba8200f5b7.title: The Gourmet CEO Turns out to Be My Baby's Dad

67899bf0768ff6c40901da0c.synopsis: In this episode, we sit down with actress, Haley Lohrli, for an intimate conversation about her journey in the world of acting, her personal life, and the transformative self-love journey she’s been on. From navigating the ups and downs of her career to embracing life changes, Haley opens up about what it truly means to live authentically. We also challenge Haley to guess which iconic women—past and present—said some of the most memorable quotes and lyrics that have shaped culture. It’s a blend of insight, laughter, and celebration of women who inspire us all. Tune in for a heartfelt episode that will leave you feeling empowered, motivated, and ready to embrace your own personal journey of growth and self-love!
67899bf0768ff6c40901da0c.title: ReelTalk EP5-How Hard Is Letting Go?

678b0e4df513a20e830d9372.synopsis: Aria Walker needs a husband to get out of an arranged marriage. When her long-term boyfriend reveals he's leaving her for her best friend, a heartbroken Aria turns to old acquaintance/"food truck worker," Norman Hill. Little does she know Norman Hill is actually a billionaire CEO. Aria's selfish family and bitter best friend try to sabotage her at every turn, but with Norman's support, Aria's marriage only gets stronger.
678b0e4df513a20e830d9372.title: My Billionaire Ever After

678df4308987856546031790.synopsis: Emily's fiance Henry breaks up with her on their wedding day. Pushed by her toxic best friend, Fiona, she agrees to enter a fake marriage with another man, but mistakes William, her mysterious billionaire CEO, for the man she's supposed to marry. After the wedding, William finds out that Emily is one of his employees, while Emily mistakenly believes that William is drowning in debt. William hides his identity till the day of the design competition when Fiona and Henry plot to sabotage Emily.
678df4308987856546031790.title: Wrong Marriage, Fated Groom

678df762ecd01d2a7a0c77e3.synopsis: Hailey is cash-strapped and desperate for a way to pay her mother's heafty medical bills. Her family agrees to help her, on the condition she marries the billionaire Samuel Trent, whom is in a coma after a near-fatal car accident. However, it wouldn't be long before the infamous Samuel Trent would wake up from his coma and discover he's engaged to a complete stranger.
678df762ecd01d2a7a0c77e3.title: Open Your Eyes, My Billionaire Husband

678dfd473bd9b5be490a139e.synopsis: After 15 years, sparks fly when Isabel and Ari reunite and become passionate lovers. She's a police detective trying to make her career by catching a mysterious master thief. As Ari helps her investigation and their affair gets steamier, will she realize that her lover is the criminal she's hunting?
678dfd473bd9b5be490a139e.title: Ms. Detective and Mr. Thief

678dfe853bd9b5be490a13a0.synopsis: In The Lady Boss's Small Town Valentine Movie, a workaholic's life is turned upside down when she finds out her fiance is having an affair with her horrible assistant. She blows the biggest deal of her life when she has a breakdown over it during the pitch. Now, her grandfather, the CEO of her hotel company, relocates her to a tiny mountain town to take over one of their failing properties. To make matters worse, she's stuck with a small town (but devilishly handsome), co-manager, who cares more about people than profits. And she has to live with the co-manager in a little chalet...
678dfe853bd9b5be490a13a0.title: The Lady Boss's Small Town Valentine

67908db909f0a68e3c0fb3e5.synopsis: Erica Lemon hires an escort to get her pregnant after finding out she'll soon be infertile. When her ex-husband, Damon finds out, he replaces the escort and tricks Erica into sleeping with him instead. Now pregnant with her ex-husband’s baby, Erica must decide if it’s worth giving Damon another chance to love her.
67908db909f0a68e3c0fb3e5.title: Tricked into Having my Ex-Husband's Baby

679098c5fc088c544e08668d.synopsis: At her wedding, ordinary girl Lillian experiences a heartbreaking betray when she catches her boyfriend cheating with her best friend. In the moment of desperation and defiane, she determined to prove her own worth and impulsively takes the hand of a scruffy mechanic Luca, who stands beside her as it happens. Instead of becoming a burden, their marriage flourishes as they navigate a series of sweet, unexpected moments and overcome challenges together. To Lillian's surprise, Luca is not just a simple mechanic - he is secretly Hamilton, a billionaire CEO and legendary race car driver. What started as a fake marriage turns into genuine love. Watch as the two of them join forces to write a extraordinary rising love story!
679098c5fc088c544e08668d.title: Accelerating Love

6791ca1e961dcdd2ad07943a.synopsis: Dr. Leah Anderson's life is turned upside down when she falls for the hot, seductive billionaire, Ryan Carter, whose obsession makes him a dangerous lover. Their passionate romance takes a dark turn as men in Leah's life begin to mysteriously disappear, and now she must face Ryan's chilling secrets, and confront her love for him.
6791ca1e961dcdd2ad07943a.title: Billionaire CEO's Secret Obsession

6791cc1fd96e3123cb0ca88d.synopsis: Monica, a talent manager, and Adonis, an A-list star, have been in secret relationship for three years now. For Monica, it's all just unrequited love because Adonis has not even once expressed his feelings to her. Monica, now pregenant, decides to leave this relationship behind. It is only then that Adonis realizes all he needs is her. Years later, their paths cross again, and Monica is now an acclaimed film director. This time, will Adonis win back his love?
6791cc1fd96e3123cb0ca88d.title: I'm Pregnant, Let's Break Up!

6792d96bb0f5968cad0e7b4b.synopsis: Syrena and Harrison wake up next to each other one morning to find out they've announced their engagement through Instagram. To protect both of their company's reputations, Syrena and Harrison decide to fake their relationship for the public.
6792d96bb0f5968cad0e7b4b.title: Insta-Married

67935b03e9f419700b0bbbfe.synopsis: Join host Rachel Bencosme and the fabulous Haley Lohrli for a spirited episode of girl talk and espresso martinis! These two ladies discuss the importance of having a solid support system and the magic of vulnerability. As they mix up their favorite cocktails, they share heartfelt moments and the key ingredients to building your own village. Whether you’re sipping at home or just need a dose of friendship, tune in for a bubbly conversation that celebrates the power of connection, one espresso martini at a time. Cheers to friendship, laughter, and a little liquid courage!
67935b03e9f419700b0bbbfe.title: ReelTalk EP6-Could Self-Love Be Self Defense?

6794217458c8dfcacc00b8be.synopsis: After losing the money to cover her mother's medical expenses to her brother, the female lead gets bullied for being broke, but is saved by the male lead. She finds a part time job at a bar, and bumps into the male lead again, who decides to help out with the medical expenses. The female lead is pregnant with twins after a one-night-stand with the male lead. She ends up moving into his house and becomes everyone's favorite.
6794217458c8dfcacc00b8be.title: Pregnant by My Tough Daddy CEO

679423dff9a4ac9055018cfe.synopsis: After Alaina saves powerful businessman William from a near-fatal car accident, he gives her a promise. Months later, William finds her at his nephew Jason's engagement party—only to discover she's Jason’s fiancée. Though he hides his feelings, William gifts her a family heirloom. When Jason betrays her, Alaina breaks off the engagement. With her grandmother's Alzheimer’s worsening and a wedding wish unfulfilled, Alaina asks William to marry her in a secret one-year contract. William sees this as his chance to win her heart, and as he protects her, Alaina also starts to fall for him.
679423dff9a4ac9055018cfe.title: Uncle William, Please Say I Do!

679921d6a1662c0c980235d9.synopsis: Get ready for a devilishly fun episode as your favorite villain, Sarah Moliski, joins host Rachel Bencosme for a deep dive into the thrilling world of playing the bad guy. From guilty pleasures to the craft behind playing iconic villains, they explore it all. They also play a playful round of Would You Rather with moments from The Virgin's Bucket List. Get ready for laughs and absolute chaos.
679921d6a1662c0c980235d9.title: ReelTalk EP7- The Villain Era

67a549308d4646cdff0a98cb.synopsis: We’re swiping right on Sarah today as she returns for another round of hot seat questions with your host, Rachel Bencosme! In this episode, we yap about the wild world of dating apps and of course, those horror stories that are way too good to keep to ourselves. Sarah also spills the tea while multitasking as she whips up a delicious smoothie, so tune in for the perfect blend of relationship wisdom and fruity goodness.
67a549308d4646cdff0a98cb.title: ReelTalk EP8- From Hinge to Unhinged

67a722f87606666f2606a276.synopsis: When Scarlett Jameson is put in prison for a crime she didn’t commit, she ends up on the radar of sexy prison guard, Jack Rayne. He taunts and tortures her with sexual delights but does he have a darker motive for chaining himself to her?
67a722f87606666f2606a276.title: Chained to My Prison Guard

67aaaffa39850916ba0e14d0.synopsis: Three years ago, Jack Hawkins saved heiress Grace Christensen from an evil stalker, but when they reunite, a misunderstanding turns them into enemies. Now, with Grace's safety threatened again, her father hires Jack as her personal bodyguard. When they're forced to spend every second together, will they be able to resist each other?
67aaaffa39850916ba0e14d0.title: The Heiress and Her Possessive Bodyguard

67aab6d180531fad7304cf74.synopsis: All her life, Daisy Storm never knew what was wrong with her. Why couldn't she shift? Why didn't she have a wolf? Even though she was hated by her entire pack, Daisy thought at least she had her mate, the Alpha... until he cheats on her and breaks their mate bond on her eighteenth birthday, making her biggest bully into the new Luna. She ran away from home in tears, but just six months later her mother mysteriously dies, and she's ordered to return by the new Alpha in charge - the one she blames for her mom's death - Nolan Fenrir. She swears that she'll never forgive him for all he's done, and yet... Daisy feels this unnatural pull to Alpha Nolan, and despite his harsh surface somehow he feels the same. She can't have ANOTHER mate bond, could she? With the man she hates the most?!
67aab6d180531fad7304cf74.title: Claimed by the Alpha I Hate

67ac28c661896f879502bdd6.synopsis: Hallie Bildner, a successful NYC CEO engaged to a billionaire politician, is shocked to learn that her high school sweetheart never signed their divorce papers. Determined to settle the past, she returns to her hometown, only to find her ex hiding two big secrets: the true reason he broke her heart and that his 7-year-old daughter is actually hers. As old feelings reignite, Hallie faces a choice between the life she built and the one she left behind.
67ac28c661896f879502bdd6.title: Divorce Me One Last Time

67ac6031cf664d90c50f360d.synopsis: Ariel, a medical aesthetics sales rep, reunites with her college crush Evan during a clinic visit. As work forces them together, old feelings resurface, but romantic rivals and past misunderstandings stand in their way. When Ariel becomes the face of her company’s products, she rises to fame—until Evan’s fiancée, Sienna, frames her, turning public admiration into scandal. Can Ariel reclaim her love and reputation?
67ac6031cf664d90c50f360d.title: Never Too Late to Love You

67ae68f7a5716fd81b03d7ee.synopsis: When her sister gets blackmailed by a ruthless sex club owner, Dakota James is desperate enough to offer a contract relationship to Jaxon Shaw, a mysterious billionaire who never touches his lovers. Until Dakota. From her first touch, Jaxon starts to feel. Their secret relationship ends brutally when Dakota discovers she's dying and breaks up with Jaxon to protect him. When Dakota gets in too deep with the club owner, she is saved by the masked man Hades—Jaxon in disguise. But time is running out for the fated lovers. Will Jaxon uncover Dakota’s deadly secret in time to save her? Or will the forces against them destroy their love before it’s too late.
67ae68f7a5716fd81b03d7ee.title: Take Me Hades, I'm Dying

67ae6ad99eb79e96670c59df.synopsis: In Mommy Don't Cry Daddy is Sorry Movie, when his wife Sienna dies in a mental hospital, Wayne is fooled by the cunning Alison into taking home the wrong daughter. Little does he know, his wife is still alive, reborn as her ruthless alter-ego Scarlett and determined to reveal Alison's trecherous schemes and enact vengeance in her daughter's name.
67ae6ad99eb79e96670c59df.title: Mommy Don't Cry, Daddy is Sorry

67aea48fbc1be3f209069206.synopsis: In this enchanting episode, join Richard and Jessica Sharrah as they take us on a heartwarming journey through their fairy tale romance. From the moment Richard swept Jessica off her feet on a motorcycle to their happily ever after, their story is nothing short of magical. Our host, Sarah Moliski, puts their love to the test with a whimsical challenge, and even invites their children for a game of 'Who is Most Likely To.' Be sure to stay tuned until the end for a surprise that will add an extra touch of magic to their family story!
67aea48fbc1be3f209069206.title: ReelTalk EP9- The Reel Happily Ever After

67b552ef9fda67232d0477c1.synopsis: In The Ex-Wife's Comeback Strategy Movie, after hooking up with her husband Benjamin who she's never met before, Aria learns that he wants a divorce with her. Her plan to just run away is demolished by her studio's new commission, which is to design Benjamin's new house. Aria hides her identity and starts working with Benjamin for the cash. Benjamin falls for his designer Aria during this time, as she develops feelings for him too...
67b552ef9fda67232d0477c1.title: The Ex-Wife's Comeback Strategy

67b55429a9d0ac04b202017f.synopsis: In Falling for My Ex's Mafia Dad movie, Fay Alden catches her boyfriend Daniel cheating and breaks up with him. But soon after, Fay meets Daniel's father Kent Lippert, the Mafia King. Kent not only reveals that Fay's real father is Mafia don Lorenzo Alden, but presents Fay with a proposition: marry his son to join the bloodlines, and he'll protect her family from a violent criminal. Fay agrees, and Daniel is all too happy to marry Fay to distract his dad and the mob world from the truth: he's gay. Fay struggles to fit in in the mob world, and can't deny her growing attraction to Daniel's father Kent. Soon, their relationship crosses into a passionate secret BDSM love affair. Don Alden is not who he seems, and is intent on using Fay as a bargaining chip to secure a better alliance with Russian syndicate leader, Ivan Kozlov. Fay and Ivan strike up an unlikely flirtation that erodes her fake engagement to Daniel. Fay's learns all too late that not only are her father and Ivan working together to destroy Kent, but Ivan is an undercover cop hellbent on taking Kent down and taking Fay for himself. Ivan and Don Alden's double cross lands Kent in jail, and after Fay discovers she's pregnant with Kent's baby, she decides she has to do whatever possible to free the father of her unborn child. With Daniel's help, she takes out Don Alden, and pressures Ivan into clearing Kent's name. Fay and Kent are reunited, marry, and live happily ever after.
67b55429a9d0ac04b202017f.title: Falling for My Ex's Mafia Dad

67b554ea7dcbda95a808a7f3.synopsis: Years after an unexpected separation, Bella and Adam—once college classmates who fell in love at first sight—are unexpectedly reunited. Now a successful doctor, Bella is stunned when Adam, her first love and now a renowned NHL superstar, appears in her office, seeking help. As old feelings resurface, a twist of fate binds them in a contract relationship, giving their unfinished love a second chance. With each passing day, the spark between Bella and Adam grows stronger, but both must decide if this second chance will allow their long-dormant love to flourish into something lasting.
67b554ea7dcbda95a808a7f3.title: Good with Her Hands

67b7a7c15cdc9f437b0fbf91.synopsis: Caroline has just been diagnosed with cancer in Love Me After My Death movie. And told she only has three months to live when Stacy, her husband Eric's old flame, shows up with a six-year-old kid that she claims is Eric's Child. Eric goes on to repeatedly wrong Caroline, and as her cancer symptoms worsen and she slips into despair, she decides to divorce him. Only after their separation does Eric realize that he can't live without her, and he then finally learns of his ex-wife's cancer diagnosis. By then, it'stoo late for reconciliation, as Caroline is determined not to spend her final days loving him.
67b7a7c15cdc9f437b0fbf91.title: Love Me After My Death

67b7bb1b54a6e88fe10c1e51.synopsis: Richard takes us on his journey of discovering his "why" and how he channels that magic with some inspiring main character energy. Plus, learn why you should never squash someone's dream! Stick around for some lightning-fast, out-of-this-world quickfire questions from a galaxy far, far away!
67b7bb1b54a6e88fe10c1e51.title: ReelTalk EP10- Turning Dreams Into Reality

67b821fdd25ca3629404c514.synopsis: When Chloe's first day of camp, her nemesis Morgan reveals that she's a virgin to all of the other counselors, and the guys at camp compete to see who takes Chloe's V-Card. But when she's saved by bad boy counselor Asher, she meets the first person who gets her to let her guard down. Can Chloe and Asher's relationship a summer of crazy campers, wild bonfires, and a hoard of counselors who want to tear their relationship apart?
67b821fdd25ca3629404c514.title: The Virgin Camp Counselor

67bcf64bbc2c7303280b1e8a.synopsis: In The Billionaire Firefighter and His Sweet Wife Movie, on the wedding day, a fire breaks out. Chloe's fiancé, Kevin, abandons her to save his stepsister, Rachel, leaving her in danger. Leo rushes into the flames to rescue her. To reclaim her mother’s inheritance, Chloe impulsively marries Leo, unaware that he’s actually a billionaire CEO. As time passes, Leo begins to fall for Chloe ultimately becoming utterly devoted to her.
67bcf64bbc2c7303280b1e8a.title: The Billionaire Firefighter and His Sweet Wife

67bd86774ec96427fd0c7ac5.synopsis: In Alpha's Regret movie, Lila's fated mate, the rival alpha, rejected her. Now, he's back, wanting her and a second chance. But can she trust him...especially when she's hiding their son?
67bd86774ec96427fd0c7ac5.title: Alpha's Regret

67c01a6d8084d51c2804613e.synopsis: In Saved by the Sexy Cowboy movie, Ava is on the run from her abusive ex, who will stop at nothing to get her back. But then she encounters a sexy cowboy who saves her and teaches her how a woman is supposed to be loved. Can Ava learn to love again or will her abusive ex catch her before she has the chance?
67c01a6d8084d51c2804613e.title: Saved by the Sexy Cowboy

67c01b28b0d6fa52350dea61.synopsis: In The Senator's Son movie, Emma Andrews wants to lead a quiet life in college, but that’s impossible when Zach Walker, son of a famous senator and the hottest guy on campus, targets her for relentless bullying. When they end up locked in a boathouse overnight (in their underwear!), Emma discovers more to this bully than she thought.
67c01b28b0d6fa52350dea61.title: The Senator's Son

67c18c88f55fa4bb570880b1.synopsis: Strap in for a wild ride with the one and only Luke Charles Stafford! In this episode, Luke takes us on an unforgettable journey from the heart of the Midwest to the bright lights of Hollywood. Get ready to hear stories he’s never shared before, as he opens up about his personal experiences and the road less traveled. We also switch gears with a fun and unpredictable game, testing Luke’s knowledge of his ReelShort shows.
67c18c88f55fa4bb570880b1.title: ReelTalk EP11-From Memory Lane to Fast Lanes

67c2465a23f6c37d0f03ea28.synopsis: In Falling for My Dad's Best Friend, Kylie, a bold young woman infatuated with her dad's best friend. Jaxon tests his limits as she tempts him with Kylie's charm. As Jaxon struggles to resist her, the tension between them escalates, leading to an ultimate betrayal that changes everything.
67c2465a23f6c37d0f03ea28.title: Falling for My Dad's Best Friend

67c24a90717e250f170c4ebc.synopsis: In Move Aside I'm the Final Boss Movie, Kingsley is the secret King of King's Corps and the richest man on Earth, but when he returns from the battlefield, his childhood sweetheart brutally dumps him, thinking he's a clown. How will the King of all men make her regret it?
67c24a90717e250f170c4ebc.title: Move Aside! I'm the Final Boss

67c62da9fd52ffc9020984a5.synopsis: In My Loser Daddy is a Big Shot Movie, with the help of their daughter Cassie, Ethan, a veteran, and Leanne, CEO of Osborne Group, marry on a whim. Despite facing scorn from friends and family, Leanne stands by Ethan as he uses his exceptional skills to protect them from various threats. Unfairly labeled as a deserter and gold digger, Ethan eventually reveals his true identity as the leader of the secret justice group, 'GUARDIAN FORCE.' He hides his identity to root out traitors and dismantle an evil organization, all while being a devoted husband and father.
67c62da9fd52ffc9020984a5.title: My Loser Daddy is a Big Shot

67ca22f3bd99c1d0d30c60ff.synopsis: In this episode, host Sarah Moliski continues her conversation with the talented actor and musician Luke Charles Stafford. Luke opens up about his journey as an artist, sharing the intricacies of his creative process and what fuels his passion for music. He also gives us a special treat! In a captivating, impromptu performance, he takes his saxophone and serenades Sarah with his soulful sound. Tune in for a soulful conversation about Luke’s musical side!
67ca22f3bd99c1d0d30c60ff.title: ReelTalk EP12-Saxophones & Serenades

67cb7455c17f28dfa9082402.synopsis: In The Cursed Alpha's Mute Bride movie, cursed mute Wren believes no one will ever love her— until she meets Alpha Hunter Silver, who says they’re mates! But Hunter is cursed, too… Can they find love together and break their curses?
67cb7455c17f28dfa9082402.title: The Cursed Alpha's Mute Bride

67cb7e52f8974bf68703f776.synopsis: In Kiss Me 99 Times a Day movie, Alice Breslin, desperate to ditch a sleazy guy, impulsively kisses CEO Anson Vega. The next thing she knows, he whisks her away and they get married on the spot. After their whirlwind wedding, they slowly start developing feelings for each other as they spend their days together. In a dramatic twist, Anson unexpectedly discovers that the genius "Sam" he's been searching for all along is actually Alice.
67cb7e52f8974bf68703f776.title: Kiss Me 99 Times a Day

67cb8fb6ec57377a7408e9bb.synopsis: In After Divorce My Ex-Wife Became a Billionaire movie, Claire, secretly the heir to a vast fortune, hides her true identity to marry Milo out of love. Living in Los Angeles, she quietly uses her wealth and influence to smooth out the obstacles on Milo's path to building his startup. Just as Milo is on the brink of success, Claire discovers he's been unfaithful. Confronted, Milo admits he's fallen out of love, speaks harshly to her, dismisses all she's done for him, and pressures her into a divorce. Heartbroken and deeply disappointed, Claire decides to reclaim her position as a billionaire heiress. She withdraws all her support, and lets Milo face the consequences of his actions, making him regret everything he's done.
67cb8fb6ec57377a7408e9bb.title: After Divorce, My Ex-Wife Became a Billionaire

67cfa52b0d3d1aa0a4097f86.synopsis: In Love On the Sidelines movie, Natalie had it all—engaged to football star Karl and carrying his child—until tragedy struck. Her brother caused Karl’s sister’s death, and Karl’s injuries ended his career. Yet, she vanished for seven years. Now, Karl sees her with a "husband" and "daughter," seemingly happy. But he won’t let her go.
67cfa52b0d3d1aa0a4097f86.title: Love On the Sidelines

67d20e7142a6a326b70b32b3.synopsis: In Pregnant and Spoiled by the Billionaire movie, Amelia is a hard-working Junior in College. In order to pay rent, she needs to find work. Her roommate got her a job at a local bar, but her first night on the job took a dark and twisted turn. Her roomate drugged her and pimped her out to a customer for the night. But at a critical moment in the night, Leo saved Amelia from being trafficked. After a night of passion, Amelia became pregnant with Leo's baby, but Leo thinks she's a gold digger. Where will she go? What will she do?
67d20e7142a6a326b70b32b3.title: Pregnant and Spoiled by the Billionaire

67d39515f9a8d8ad160cb5df.synopsis: Get ready for a buzzworthy return as the queen bee herself, Daniela Couso, joins the latest episode of ReelTalk with Sarah Moliski! These two legendary villains dish on the reality of bringing their characters to life and the fun side of it all. Daniela also spills the tea on surviving the chaos of high school drama, how she conquered it, and made her way to the Hollywood spotlight! She even dives into fan comments. Some sweet, some downright crazy! This episode also packs a bonus clip with another villain you love, Michael Vaccaro! Tune in for a candid convo about the power of representation for mature actors and why they absolutely deserve to take the lead in those swoon-worthy romance stories too.
67d39515f9a8d8ad160cb5df.title: ReelTalk EP13-Queen Bee Meets Queen Bee

67d8a6ea787657f63a0faf83.synopsis: In Audrey in Full Bloom movie, Harvard MBA Audrey Lorenzo Bloom is on her way to shatter barriers as powerful conglomerate BloomCo’s first female and non-white CEO. She’s been preparing for years, even using an alias as a Latina cleaning lady to learn the inner workings of the company. Now on the eve of the banquet introducing her, Audrey discovers her fiancé thinks she’s an illegal alien and plans to defraud and deport her, the senior executives are plotting a coup to put her white cousin in charge, and her bitterest enemy since childhood, Ryder Marlow, might not be her enemy after all…
67d8a6ea787657f63a0faf83.title: Audrey in Full Bloom

67db2e20143929db1a039266.synopsis: In Feast of Power movie, Nick, who's secretly the wealthiest man in the world, lives as stay-at-home husband with his wife, Bella. Just as he’s about to reveal his true identity and share his wealth and power with her, he discovers Bella’s betrayal. Nick realizes he had mistaken Bella for his true love. He later finds Elena, a woman who loves him for who he is, not for his wealth or power. Determined, Nick takes back everything he had planned to give Bella and chooses to share it with Elena instead, leaving Bella full of regret.
67db2e20143929db1a039266.title: Feast of Power

67dc9b1ca68b878b5f08c6a1.synopsis: In this special edition episode of ReelTalk Backstage, Rebecca Stoughton takes us behind the scenes of her latest show, Good with Her Hands. Join Rebecca as she glides on the ice, giving us a firsthand look at romance, hockey, and second chances. ReelTalk Backstage is your all-access pass to vertical productions. Go behind the scenes with your favorite stars as they take you on set and share unforgettable moments. From intense rehearsals to candid conversations, each episode gives you a front-row seat to the action. Get ready to see your favorite shows like never before.
67dc9b1ca68b878b5f08c6a1.title: ReelTalk EP14-Backstage: Good with Her Hands

67e1d8107f46e58c8305c783.synopsis: In The Elite Heir's Ultimate Comeback movie, Hector and Alice have been in love for years. But just as Hector is about to reveal his true identity, a tragic accident leaves him in a coma. Alice’s family, despite their limited resources, contributes what they can to his recovery. As Hector slowly regains consciousness, he can only communicate by pressing a call button. Meanwhile, an antagonist posing as a doctor manipulates the family. In a critical moment, Hector finally speaks, warning the antagonist that with a single phone call, he can bring them to justice.
67e1d8107f46e58c8305c783.title: The Elite Heir's Ultimate Comeback

67e1da0ec6bf558b4b07891d.synopsis: In Go Away Stepmom You Have It All Wrong Movie, on the day of her father’s wedding, Margaret rushes home early from college exams to attend the ceremony. She only to be mistaken by her future stepmother, Chloe, as her father’s mistress. While her father is away, Chloe takes every opportunity to humiliate and mistreat Margaret. Can Margaret clear her name and expose Chloe’s true colors before it’s too late?
67e1da0ec6bf558b4b07891d.title: Go Away Stepmom, You Have It All Wrong!

67e1da90dfbcc9f2610a2ca9.synopsis: Ray, a middle-aged businessman who has given up on love in Twilight Romance Flash Marriage to Mature Tycoon. Posing as a construction worker, he enters into a flash marriage with Jocelyn, a woman who has just been kicked out of her house. Their union starts off with a sweet and dreamy honeymoon phase, but their love is interrupted by persistent bullying from the family of Jocelyn's daughter-in-law. After repeatedly saving Jocelyn from disaster, Ray reveals his hidden billionaire identity to her, and the two of them embark on a life of luxury. That's when Ray's ex-wife returns to drive a wedge betwen Ray and Jocelyn, and as Jocelyn prepares to sacrifice herself for the sake of her husband's career, Ray gives her the most romantic of surprises...
67e1da90dfbcc9f2610a2ca9.title: Twilight Romance: Flash Marriage to Mature Tycoon

67e1dd63c794efd25f08931a.synopsis: In How to Tame a Silver Fox movie, Harper Reeves is just trying to finish up her senior year of Yale without being a completely friendless loser. However, when her party's suddenly crashed by her dad's best friend and mysterious business partner, Chris Collins, she realizes she'd much rather have been busted by the cops. Chris, always in over-protective mode, gets on Harper's nerves, until she realizes he needs to go. Together with her best friend Maria, she brainstorms Operation Seduction, planning to get Chris to fall in love with her so her dad will kick him out himself. But every time Chris saves Harper from trouble, she gets closer to realizing she may have feelings for him after all.
67e1dd63c794efd25f08931a.title: How to Tame a Silver Fox

67e3169220c234316e0a4efe.synopsis: In If Loving You is a Sin then I'll Go to Hell movie, Ellie Jones has been a good girl her whole life, that is until she loses her virginity to bad boy Asher King at her first high school party. The two fall for each other and she gets pregnant. However Ellie's father, the Pastor, and Asher's family, The Red Snakes Gang, wants to keep them apart and take away their baby. Now he has vowed to protect her, no matter the cost. Episode List
67e3169220c234316e0a4efe.title: If Loving You is a Sin, then I'll Go to Hell

67e606efcbf4c07f0c0cbe2f.synopsis: We're getting mischievous on ReelTalk Backstage for April Fools’ day! Join host Sarah Moliski as she visits Jesse Morales and Samantha Drews on set for a special episode filled with pranks. Sarah might even fool Jesse with some shocking pregnancy news. But whose baby is it? ReelTalk Backstage is your all-access pass to vertical productions. Go behind the scenes with your favorite stars as they take you on set and share unforgettable moments. From intense rehearsals to candid conversations, each episode gives you a front-row seat to the action. Get ready to see your favorite shows like never before.
67e606efcbf4c07f0c0cbe2f.title: ReelTalk EP15-Backstage: ReelTalk is a Prank!

67ec430800e09545a501247d.synopsis: In Submitting to My Ex's Dad movie, after catching her fiancé cheating with her best friend just before their wedding, Flora runs away and has a wild one-night stand with a handsome stranger. Little does she know he's her ex-fiancé's father, and he has a dark secret. Will she surrender to the heat—or is it time to run again?
67ec430800e09545a501247d.title: Submitting to My Ex's Dad

67ec442f9fa6f0fd480e06e3.synopsis: In Wings of Fire The Dragon Slayer Is My Ex-Lover movie, Freya Swann turned her back on her first love, Tristan Blackwater five years ago…But she never told him she had his child! Now he’s returned to the kingdom as a dragon-slaying hero and Freya is his personal servant! Will Freya finally tell Tristan the truth?
67ec442f9fa6f0fd480e06e3.title: Wings of Fire: The Dragon Slayer Is My Ex-Lover

67ecde3cbc867af4340c4146.synopsis: In The Ultimate Fight for Love movie, after her parents' mysterious deaths, Harper finds herself deep in debt to shady businessman Travis Noble, who forces her to spy on enigmatic billionaire Andrew Barrett to pay him back. When Harper discovers Andrew's secret — he's an underground MMA fighter — Andrew convinces her to join him to take down Travis. But neither Harper nor Andrew ever expected the heat building between them... or how much they'd be willing to fight for it.
67ecde3cbc867af4340c4146.title: The Ultimate Fight for Love

67ef1311fba1c0aba1060ed3.synopsis: Sarah Moliski calls up her girls, Rebecca Stoughton and Tess Dinerstein, for a wild and unfiltered night of gossip, embarrassing stories, and lots of laughs. The trio drops some juicy details about everything from the art of being a weird girl to playing a daring game of 2 Truths and a Lie. From sharing their most cringe-worthy moments to prank-calling someone unsuspecting, this pajama party has it all.
67ef1311fba1c0aba1060ed3.title: ReelTalk EP16-Pajama Party Confessions

67f06dbaaaee64943c0b5240.synopsis: In Kidnapped by the Devil movie, when a ruthless arms dealer kidnaps a bride after her fiancé fails his test of love in a deadly game of Russian roulette, she finds herself torn between her moral principles and her growing attraction to the dangerous man who will stop at nothing to make her his.
67f06dbaaaee64943c0b5240.title: Kidnapped by the Devil

67f06f8c388bcdbbae08b10a.synopsis: In Swimming My Way Back to You movie, Hazel has been in love with Marcus for eight years and spent three of them as his secret lover. Just when she thought she had finally won his heart, she overhears Marcus confessing that the only person he’s ever truly loved is his first love, Zoe. Heartbroken, Hazel decides it’s time to break things off with him—only to find out she’s pregnant...
67f06f8c388bcdbbae08b10a.title: Swimming My Way Back to You

67f4bf3ef677c88e22096ccc.synopsis: In Selling My Virginity to the Mafia King movie, desperate to save her dying sister, Tessa agrees to auction off her virginity -- only to be claimed by the most dangerous man in the Mafia. Will she ever be able to trust the man who bought her love... or will trusting him cost her everything?
67f4bf3ef677c88e22096ccc.title: Selling My Virginity to the Mafia King

67f62d7be40e2748790ffcf9.synopsis: In After Divorce I Built A Fabulous Life movie, once a talented designer, Mia married Tyler for love and became a housewife post-graduation. However, a three-year marriage ended with a divorce decree. Tyler's heartlessness makes Mia give up hope, leading her to reclaim her beloved career. Eventually, Mia shines in her passion, and Tyler realizes his true feelings, allowing them to rediscover love...
67f62d7be40e2748790ffcf9.title: After Divorce, I Built A Fabulous Life

67f6cbba96412fe9460d57ac.synopsis: In Baby Please Don't Marry Him movie, to secure her boyfriend’s future, Gloria pretends to be superficial and breaks up with him. Seven years later, she's forced into an arranged marriage, only to find her fiancé's uncle is her now-successful ex. As old feelings resurface and misunderstandings unravel, the two are drawn back together for a second chance at love.
67f6cbba96412fe9460d57ac.title: Baby, Please Don't Marry Him

67f6d16f2b53e01e2000118a.synopsis: In My Boss Is My Secret Sperm Donor movie, Leia, struggling with infertility, is caught slacking off at work by her boss, Alec, while browsing a sperm donor website. Mortified by the encounter, she tries to move on. After carefully selecting a donor at the sperm bank, fate takes an unexpected turn—she ends up choosing Alec’s donation without realizing it. When will Leia discover that the child she’s carrying is actually Alec’s?
67f6d16f2b53e01e2000118a.title: My Boss Is My Secret Sperm Donor

67f6d31af51c3a3b9e0549f2.synopsis: In Undercover Prison King movie, when ex-soldier Troy Poe inherits a corrupt private prison, he decides to go in undercover as an inmate to expose those responsible. But when the head guard, a man who he trusted, turns out to be the leader of the crime ring , Troy must find a way to convince the officials that he is not a prisoner, but in fact, the owner of the prison... or break out. All the while, he must protect those in danger, including a weak old prisoner whose sentence has been falsely extended, and a beautiful doctor who's caught in the crossfire. Will Troy find a way to escape? Or will he become just another casualty of his own prison?
67f6d31af51c3a3b9e0549f2.title: Undercover Prison King

67f7906c085fd270130b34b6.synopsis: In Pretty Baby movie, Rosy Dolores, the city's most sought-after escort, enters a fake engagement with billionaire single father Tad Williams to locate the daughter ripped away from her at birth. Unbeknownst to her, Tad's charming daughter, Lily, is the very child she's been searching for.
67f7906c085fd270130b34b6.title: Pretty Baby

67f790bf2e5020721707e329.synopsis: In Secret Boss of the Five Keys movie, Grayson Rodgers is a gardener with a secret: Over the last five years, he's taken out the five heads of the Five Nation Syndicate, and taken their Gold Keys: The symbols of their authority, but also the keys to the vault that acts as a bank for their entire fortunes. He's now ready to stop, and give his wife a life of luxury and peace. But before he can reveal himself to her, he discovers her sleeping with a high ranking syndicate general, Ivan. Ivan wants Grayson to use his clearance as a gardner to help him break into the Golden Key Vault. Now Grayson must find a way to prove to everyone that he's the true leader, while catching Ivan in the act... all the while being thought of a just a gardener.
67f790bf2e5020721707e329.title: Secret Boss of the Five Keys

67f790db472487b6b00b8e24.synopsis: In Freeze! Runaway Groom movie, to pay for her father's medical bills, Ivy is forced to marry Byron, a wealthy heir, instead of her stepsister. But on their wedding day, Byron doesn't show up, leaving Ivy humiliated in front of all their family and friends. After they finally marry, they set three rules—agreeing they won't fall in love with each other. Eventually, Byron tells Ivy that the agreement is ridiculous because he's already fallen in love with her. He asks her if she loves him back. So, will Ivy reciprocate his feelings?
67f790db472487b6b00b8e24.title: Freeze! Runaway Groom

67f7910e778a52eee8096337.synopsis: In Mistaken as the Mistress movie, Vivian comes home early to celebrate her son Noah's engagement party. But his fiancée Mia mistakes her as his mistress, resulting in Vivian's public shame and abuse. When Noah arrives and finds his mother missing, he quickly erupts in anger and vows to find his mother at all costs!
67f7910e778a52eee8096337.title: Mistaken as the Mistress

67f7913141ebfd891f0fc824.synopsis: In Fuel to Our Fire My Racer Stepbrother movie, struggling to pay the bills to support her ailing mother and abusive step-father, Elaine turns to her work as a dancer at illegal street races. But, as fate would have it, she unknowingly runs into the world's most-feared and envied world-championship street racer... her step-brother. And gives him her virginity.
67f7913141ebfd891f0fc824.title: Fuel to Our Fire: My Racer Stepbrother

67f791456da404e5a7033b88.synopsis: In My Ex is in the Navy SEALs movie, six years ago, Regina chose to break up with her boyfriend Julian to avoid hindering his promising military career due to her overwhelming debt. Six years later, they reunite in a foreign land, Julian is now a commanding officer, while Regina is a single mother. Their chemistry reignites, but their bonding faces uncertainties of their class differences and pressure from people around them. This time, will they find their way back to love again?
67f791456da404e5a7033b88.title: My Ex is in the Navy SEALs

67f7917b8c6a1df566097a39.synopsis: In Hillbilly Girlie Marries a Billionaire movie, small-town girl Emily moves to the city to collect a debt from her ex, Kevin, hoping to pay off her mother’s medical bills. But she discovers Kevin is now a sugar baby living off of wealthy woman, Rose, and together they humiliate her. Just as Emily hits rock bottom, she stumbles across Lucas. Through an unexpected misunderstanding, Emily becomes the contract wife of a CEO.
67f7917b8c6a1df566097a39.title: Hillbilly Girlie Marries a Billionaire

67f94b9768edc18a72097275.synopsis: The chaotic pajama party continues! Listen in for a sweet surprise as the trio spills the tea on their crushes, showmances, and the cringiest things they’ve done in the name of love. Things really heat up when they jump on the Hear Me Out trend so prepare yourselves for some hot takes.
67f94b9768edc18a72097275.title: ReelTalk EP17-Hear Me Out…He Is Kind of Hot?

67fce07b81c0454503051544.synopsis: In Love Trap with My Dashing Knight movie, the wealthy heiress Emily White marries Tim Carter, a man from humble beginnings, for love. She spares no effort in elevating him to the position of CEO, using her family’s vast resources to secure his success. Yet, after ten years of marriage, Tim betrays her, secretly engaging in an affair with his secretary, Laura Green. Stripped of power, Emily is reduced to a housewife, trapped in a hollow, loveless marriage, suffering alone. Eager to secure her position, Laura devises a ruthless scheme—she hires a male escort to seduce Emily, planning to obtain "evidence" of her infidelity and force her out of the marriage with nothing. However, in a twist of fate, she mistakenly targets Ryan Clarke, the illegitimate son of the influential Clarke family, believing him to be an escort. The moment Ryan sees Emily, he immediately recognizes her—she is the woman who unknowingly saved him years ago. Harboring unspoken emotions, Ryan seizes the opportunity and infiltrates the White household, becoming Emily’s chauffeur and live-in assistant. He relentlessly flirts and teases her, awakening long-buried desires within her.
67fce07b81c0454503051544.title: Love Trap with My Dashing Knight

67fdc407e4fc584da1068cc2.synopsis: In Love at Dangerous Speeds movie, when Violet flees her abusive fiancé on their wedding day, she hides with Marcus, a notorious street racer. Their protection-for-a-kiss deal ignites into passion, giving her the freedom she craves. Then Marcus confesses a dark secret: the hit-and-run accident that haunts him killed Violet's father. Will she forgive the man who stole her heart but destroyed her family, or return to the controlling life she desperately tried to escape?
67fdc407e4fc584da1068cc2.title: Love at Dangerous Speeds

6800bcd28e63e6be8505c47c.synopsis: In Taming the Mafia Boss He's Mine Now movie: Leah, the daughter of the Cruz family, appears to be a "fierce delicate flower" who throws money around in nightclubs and acts in a cynical way on the surface. In reality, she is a down-and-out heir whose power was seized by her stepfather. During a misunderstanding, Leah, fueled by alcohol, generously spent a large sum of money and "kept" Allen, the "bankrupt noble young master" — little did she know that this man whom she could pin against the wall and whose shirt she tore open was actually the person in power of the Smith family, a mafia clan. A misunderstanding about "keeping someone" kicks off: He can wear an apron and cook dinner, and when she is framed by her stepsister Lisa, he will press the muzzle of a gun against the forehead of the enemy. She once thought that he was a person in distress who needed her protection, but when she herself was in trouble, she discovered that the overwhelming power of the Smith family could be casually wielded by him — she thought she was the hunter, but she didn't know that from the moment she pinned him against the locker, he was willing to shed all his disguises just for her... Let's see how Leah makes a comeback from the "sugar mommy" to become the wife of the mafia boss, staging an ultimate love story between two powerful individuals where "You hide your power to protect my vulnerable part, and I shed my thorns to give you my sincere heart."
6800bcd28e63e6be8505c47c.title: Taming the Mafia Boss, He's Mine Now!

68018b77b5261ea7470d23d6.synopsis: Following the success of Money, Guns, and a Merry Christmas, Anna Stadler and Drew Ater reunite over drinks for a candid, celebratory sit-down. In this exclusive close-up interview, the duo revisits the action, the chemistry, and the moments that made it all unforgettable. Expect heartfelt gratitude, behind the scenes stories, and a few never-before-heard secrets along the way.
68018b77b5261ea7470d23d6.title: ReelTalk EP18-Money, Guns, and a Merry Christmas: The Reunion

6802d2e64af71963930e1931.synopsis: In A Hamptons Summer Affair with My BFF's Brother movie, Olive Parry agrees to be her BFF Sam’s fake girlfriend, and in return, he would pay for her expenses to save her little brother from his evil foster mom. One condition: don't fall in love with Sam’s older brother. Everything was working perfectly until Olive found out that the man she’d secretly pined for after a one-night stand, and Sam’s off-limit older brother were the same person.
6802d2e64af71963930e1931.title: A Hamptons Summer Affair with My BFF's Brother

6805e89858fc9ba8bd070ca7.synopsis: In Royal Heir Breaks My Heart in a Warzone movie, the emergency room doctor fell in love with a special forces officer at first sight. But because of family difficulties, she had to pretend to be unfaithful and break up with him. She didn't know that after breaking up, she found out she was pregnant…and the special forces officer's other identity was actually a royal heir fulfilling his military service. Years later, she was forced to join an international medical team and met him again at the international peacekeeping base. She reunited with her special forces officer, her prince, whom she had been thinking about for a long time, but they were like strangers...
6805e89858fc9ba8bd070ca7.title: Royal Heir Breaks My Heart in a Warzone

6805e8ac23f200c0c408fb2e.synopsis: In Heiress Returns: Boss's Defense and Love movie: The daughter of the world's wealthiest man pursued a man who manipulated and mistreated women for three years, during which she endured emotional abuse. Despite transferring hundreds of millions in assets to this manipulative individual, she received no formal recognition or respect in their relationship. On their third wedding anniversary, this deceitful man brazenly introduced his mistress to her, mocking her lack of wealth, beauty, connections, and desirability, claiming she deserved to be betrayed. Unbeknownst to him, with just a single decision from her, he and his mistress would lose everything. At this critical moment, the male protagonist—a peer of the female lead in terms of wealth and family background—appears. However, due to misunderstandings orchestrated by the antagonistic secondary characters, he is mistaken for a hired model intended to embellish the scene. Ironically, both the male and female leads initially perceive each other as impostors, with the male lead even mistakenly believing the female lead is his arranged marriage partner. Enraged by the betrayal of the secondary male character, the female lead hastily signs a divorce agreement and marries the male lead. Yet, the secondary characters remain oblivious to the gravity of their actions. Let us observe how they are subsequently humiliated in various ways.
6805e8ac23f200c0c408fb2e.title: Heiress Returns: Boss's Defense and Love

68064de0b2e1243e6b03586e.synopsis: In Accidentally Pregnant Forever Spoiled movie: since childhood, Ella has lived with her remarried mother and stepfather after her parents divorced. She endured indifference and abuse in her stepfather's household. After her mother passed away, her stepfather and half-brother treated Ella as nothing more than a tool to make money. Her stepfather even spent all of her college tuition, forcing her to work part-time to pay for her education. While working at a bar, Ella was drugged by a customer, but was rescued by a drunken Edward, leading to a one-night stand. Two months later, Ella discovered she was pregnant! Her stepfather, wanting to sell her off for a good price, attempted to force her into having an abortion. In a critical moment, Edward arrived in time to save Ella and brought her home, offering her care and protection. However, due to her low status, Ella faced insults from Edward's sister and bullying at school. A wealthy heiress, who also had her eyes on Edward, threatened her as well. Yet, Edward remained firm in his commitment to protect her. After overcoming multiple challenges, Ella transformed from a timid, self-conscious girl into a brave and strong woman, gradually winning Edward’s heart. She safely gave birth to their child, and years later, became a brilliant AI researcher.
68064de0b2e1243e6b03586e.title: Accidentally Pregnant, Forever Spoiled

68073d0f8046d9913c066077.synopsis: In Shhh Professor Please Don't Tell movie: Ellie is living a double life as a student by day, masked stripper by night. When the handsome Jackson Steele walks into the club, Ellie takes him on as her new favorite client. But when Ellie realizes that Jackson is her college professor, she must fight the attraction that is burning between them. Can Ellie keep her double life a secret? And can she continue to resist her professor who watches her dance every night?
68073d0f8046d9913c066077.title: Shhh, Professor! Please Don't Tell

68073fc1d5ec063ec302e73c.synopsis: In Freed by the Sexy Farmer movie, after her once-wealthy family loses everything, virgin heiress Lily Holt is sold to Mason Black. He is the notoriously cruel heir of the Black family fortune. Terrified of his violent reputation, Lily runs away from Mason the night of their fake marriage and crashes into Cal Foster, a sweet, sexy farmer who falls for her at first sight. However, when Cal discovers the man Lily’s running from is his landlord and long-time rival, he risks his life and livelihood to protect her.
68073fc1d5ec063ec302e73c.title: Freed by the Sexy Farmer

680755a6421039a0780bd65b.synopsis: In Watch Out She's a Mastermind Heiress movie, after growing up in the countryside, 21-year-old Isabella Patton is sent back to her wealthy birth family. Before long, she becomes acquainted with the smoldering (and much older) Oliver Bates, who begins to relentlessly pursue her, oblivious to the fact that she is his fiancée. Meanwhile, Isabella's cousin Eliza, who was raised by the Patton family in her place, is on a desperate mission to turn the whole family against her for good. Unluckily for Eliza, Isabella is a hotshot genius with unparalleled talent in the medical and tech fields, and is able to outduel Eliza at every turn. As Isabella's unique skills are revealed, she wins the support of her five brothers and parents, becoming the crown jewel of the Patton family while always remaining just out of Oliver's grasp.
680755a6421039a0780bd65b.title: Watch Out! She's a Mastermind Heiress

680755cdaf8e465a6c0e8e91.synopsis: I'm In Love With My Brother's Best Friend?! is based on the novel published by Tapas Entertainment, Inc. In I'm In Love With My Brother's Best Friend movie: when Kaitlyn Sinclair moves into her off campus apartment with her high school sweetheart for her freshman year of college, she immediately catches him cheating on her. She is forced to move into her brother’s apartment and share a space with his best friend who is in grad school on the same campus. When her childhood crush reignites, Kaitlyn and Cole must navigate their newfound adult relationship while evil exes, mean girls, and worst of all- Kaitlyn’s brother, try to tear them apart.
680755cdaf8e465a6c0e8e91.title: I'm In Love With My Brother's Best Friend?!

680755e1c7ae148edd0ee59e.synopsis: In The Billionaire's Virgin Surrogate movie, what happens when a student surrogate proposes to her client that they should conceive the baby the natural way? In the movie The Billionaire's Virgin Surrogate, desperate to save her father, Harper agrees to carry a baby for Will Trenton— a single, mouthwateringly hot billionaire. As their worlds collide and the boundaries blur, Harper finds herself irresistibly drawn to Will. But beneath the surface, a question remain: Is Will feeling the same?
680755e1c7ae148edd0ee59e.title: The Billionaire's Virgin Surrogate

680755f6e2beaa8d5309d902.synopsis: In The Quarterback’s First Love movie, after her quarterback fiancee’s betrayal, cheerleader Maddie’s life unravels. Drawn to Cameron, another football player who feels oddly familiar, she faces new challenges as her ex, the cheer captain, and Cameron's mother plot to tear them apart.
680755f6e2beaa8d5309d902.title: The Quarterback's First Love

6807560ea0676c7b8705a8ba.synopsis: In Song of My Mother's Tears movie, Faith searches for her lost family when she learns that she doesn't have long to live. But turns out, they're the people she hates the most!
6807560ea0676c7b8705a8ba.title: Song of My Mother's Tears

68075635df42c4bb2a02709c.synopsis: In Boss Me Around If You Dare movie: Just after she is falsely accused of sleeping with her boss and fired, Olivia lands a new job at Wilder Conglomerate—only to realize her new boss is Theo Wilder, the man she hooked up with last night! Olivia says they can’t work together, but Theo challenges her to stay and take a bet: he says he can make her fall for him, while Olivia bets she can resist his seduction… but just how long can she last against her boss’ sexy advances?
68075635df42c4bb2a02709c.title: Boss Me Around If You Dare

6807565447c113d594077ca8.synopsis: In My Stepbrother's Dirty Secret movie, Alice transfers to St. Mary's High School after her mom remarries a millionaire--only to butt heads with James, a hot classmate who turns out to be her new stepbrother! Will Alice and James learn to get along? Or will their irresistable chemistry turn into something else?
6807565447c113d594077ca8.title: My Stepbrother's Dirty Secret

6807566fd88a6d32a90a4b12.synopsis: The Cursed Alpha's Mate is based on the novel by Cricket Colson, published by Tapas Entertainment and Radish. In The Cursed Alpha's Mate movie: Shay Santos is finally ready to lose her virginity, but when she tries to surprise her boyfriend, she finds him cheating on her instead! Heartbroken, she goes out with her BFF and vows to sleep with the first guy who approaches her… Who happens to be powerful Alpha Mal Haywood. Their attraction is instant, animal, and for a human and a werewolf… Forbidden. But that’s not the only problem: Mal’s been cursed, and if doesn’t mark Shay as his mate and impregnate her with his pup, he’ll die!
6807566fd88a6d32a90a4b12.title: The Cursed Alpha's Mate

6807568174479ad7f60dc6f3.synopsis: In My Husband Regrets Divorcing Me movie, Audrey hides her identity as a CEO to protect Cornell's pride, working behind the scenes to help him secure a major hotel project and climb to the top as the hotel's CEO. As she helps him make his way up the ladder, his first love, Cecilia, returns, putting a strain on their relationship . Meanwhile, Audrey faces relentless pressure from those around her, including Cornell, which pushing her to consider a divorce. After enduring countless humiliations, she finally recognizes her worth and the price of dedicating herself to the wrong person. With her confidence restored, Audrey eventually chooses divorce and fight to reclaim her place as the CEO.
6807568174479ad7f60dc6f3.title: My Husband Regrets Divorcing Me

68075696ff120dcf2509b0ef.synopsis: In The Virgin Stripper and the Hockey Star movie, Jenna leads a double life: by day, she’s a quiet, unassuming student; by night, she secretly works as a stripper to pay for her sister’s medical bills. Her worlds collide one night when Casper, her cocky school rival and the star of the hockey team, walks into the club. He’s instantly drawn to the enigmatic dancer, Angel, unaware she’s the same girl he spars with at school. But the deeper their bond grows, the closer they come to unraveling each other’s truths.
68075696ff120dcf2509b0ef.title: The Virgin Stripper and the Hockey Star

680756aa539a46a7960f35f9.synopsis: In Rules of Protection The Bodyguard I Hate movie, Elena and Ace used to be engaged for marriage. But, after Ace is disabled from the war, he pretends to cheat on Elena to save her from his new disability. Three years pass until the CEO of a medical insurance company gets shot. Elena needs a personal bodyguard, and Ace just happens to be the one for the job. Will Elena and Ace repair their rocky past and reignite the love they once had for each other?
680756aa539a46a7960f35f9.title: Rules of Protection: The Bodyguard I Hate

680756c56f852549da0789fa.synopsis: In Accidental Triplets with the Billionaire movie, urgently needing an heir to secure his position in the company, Oscar turns to surrogacy. But unexpectedly, his sperm is accidentally injected into Phoebe, who comes in for a gynecological exam. To ensure Phoebe keeps the baby, Oscar proposes a contract marriage, and the two embark on a journey filled with tests...
680756c56f852549da0789fa.title: Accidental Triplets with the Billionaire

680756e113ea058f2c07f351.synopsis: In Never Underestimate Girl movie Math, Zosha is a poor orphan who gets bullied by all the rich Ivy League kids for working on a farm. But Zosha's about to beat them all at the one thing they least expect: math.
680756e113ea058f2c07f351.title: Never Underestimate Girl Math

680756f542a99850b106f7ff.synopsis: In My Firefighter Fiancé Returns as a Billionaire movie, Archer is nowhere to be seen on his wedding with Alice—rumor has it he died in an explosion during a firefighting mission. Alice’s greedy parents try to marry her off to a sleazy suitor, Philip. At the new wedding, Alice finally sees her husband again—but he’s now engaged to someone else.
680756f542a99850b106f7ff.title: My Firefighter Fiancé Returns as a Billionaire

6807570bacbfcb9dcc0c9bb4.synopsis: Swallow Me Whole is based on the novel by Gemma James, published by Tapas Entertainment and Radish. I need to know how to blow a guy. Ashton Levine is my best friend's brother and totally off-limits... until one reckless night under a bar table changed everything. The rules of him being my sex tutor are simple: No kissing. No screwing. No falling in love. But the more I use my body in the name of experimentation, the more I know being friends isn’t enough. Is it too much to want it all with him?
6807570bacbfcb9dcc0c9bb4.title: Swallow Me Whole

68075726bfe31ae241029d10.synopsis: In The Deaf Heiress's Secret movie, A deaf heiress regains her hearing just in time to discover the people closest to her plotting against her. Keeping her recovery a secret, she plays a dangerous game of deception against those who believe her disability makes her weak. As she investigates suspicious events from her past, she must carefully navigate a web of betrayal while pretending not to hear the conspiracies unfolding around her in order to bring those who wronged her to justice.
68075726bfe31ae241029d10.title: The Deaf Heiress's Secret

680aa8211eef6c4917096b4b.synopsis: This week, we’re going behind bars with ReelShort sensation Marc Herrmann, star of the explosive new series Undercover Prison King. Marc takes us inside the walls of this gritty and thrilling ride. Danger lurks in every shadow, plots shift like smoke, and the next jaw-dropping stunt is always just around the corner. ReelTalk Backstage is your all-access pass to vertical productions. Go behind the scenes with your favorite stars as they take you on set and share unforgettable moments. From intense rehearsals to candid conversations, each episode gives you a front-row seat to the action. Get ready to see your favorite shows like never before.
680aa8211eef6c4917096b4b.title: ReelTalk EP19-Backstage: Behind Bars

680b2b37f9bde1cbed032547.synopsis: In Swept Away by My Janitor Husband movie, Ethan, the CEO of Rutherford Enterprises, is undercover as a janitor to uncover a company mole. However, his secret identity complicates things when he falls for Melanie, a secretary at his company. Meanwhile, Melanie, unaware of his true identity, is dealing with betrayal from her fiancé and best friend, as well as family pressure to prove her engagement with a successful man.
680b2b37f9bde1cbed032547.title: Swept Away by My Janitor Husband

680b2c50310d687b600a1eec.synopsis: In Pride & Prejudice movie, despite societal pressures to marry, Lizzie Bennet, second eldest of the Bennet sisters, has her heart set on spinsterhood. But when her father falls gravely ill, Lizzie is unexpectedly thrust into the classist world of courtship in order to save her family from destitution. After a fateful encounter with the broody, mysterious millionaire, Mr. Darcy, Lizzie’s forced to choose between denying her feelings for the sake of her family or allowing herself to fall recklessly in love.
680b2c50310d687b600a1eec.title: Pride & Prejudice

680b30d100ef4d481807d0c7.synopsis: In The Alpha King and His Virgin Bride movie, the Alpha King Killian Storm is cursed to not live past age thirty. Only finding his true fated mate can break the curse, but what happens when his fated mate is a human? Humans cannot mate with Alphas. If he mates with her, she dies, but if he doesn't... he dies.
680b30d100ef4d481807d0c7.title: The Alpha King and His Virgin Bride

68150df833b25f40180886bf.synopsis: Sparks flew at ReelShort’s first-ever exclusive screening of Wings of Fire: The Dragon Slayer is My Ex-Lover. Follow stars Seth Edeen and Nicole Mattox as they reignite their chemistry in the latest sizzling ReelShort show. From the big screen to the Q&A and fan meet and greet, this star-studded night was on fire. Fans, cast, crew, and surprise ReelShort stars showed up for a night full of laughs, dragon slaying, and maybe even a little drama. Watch closely, you might just spot a few familiar faces in the crowd. Don’t miss this behind the scenes look at the hottest premiere of the season!
68150df833b25f40180886bf.title: ReelTalk EP20-Wings of Fire: The Dragon Slayer is My Ex-Lover Premiere Screening
