68191e5408a393374109d3ca.synopsis: In The Break-up Bet With My Billionaire Ex movie, when Layla and Joshua break up, they sign a separation agreement: If they're both still single in five years, they get married. Five years later, after becoming the world's hottest and wealthiest chef, Joshua takes the position of head chef at the restuarant where Layla works. Joshua wants her to fulfill the contract, but with her health in an unstable condition, Layla lies and says she's already engaged. Still, an undeniable chemistry builds between them, and the flames of love become hard to suppress. Will Joshua ultimately discover Layla's lie? Can they bridge the gap of lost time and truly be together again, love conquering all?
68191e5408a393374109d3ca.title: The Break-up Bet With My Billionaire Ex

6822a241bcbbb3c4ee08bd30.synopsis: Heather found her mate James was cheating with his uncle's fiancee. She was so hurt that she went into his uncle Antonio’s room to seduce him, and kissed him... However, The cold man seems had feelings for her so that he couldn't control himself and kissed her hardly...
6822a241bcbbb3c4ee08bd30.title: My Accidental Alpha's Desire

68231417a0f7a86c6d08968d.synopsis: A modern romantic psychological thriller in the tone of Fifty Shades of Grey and Secretary, Assistant is dark, seductive, outrageously thought-provoking, and riveting. Directorial debut of genre filmmaker Louisa Warren (Cannibal Cabin, Hard Copy).
68231417a0f7a86c6d08968d.title: Dirty Work

68239ae8c85961939e012759.synopsis: In How to Dump a Hockey Star movie: After leaving behind her life as a billionaire heiress, Renee dedicates herself to helping her husband recover from a vegetative state and pursue his NHL dreams. However, after suffering a devastating miscarriage, she is faced with a brutal truth: the man she sacrificed everything for might have chosen someone else.
68239ae8c85961939e012759.title: How to Dump a Hockey Star

68259abb130591adac007a1b.synopsis: In My Cold-Hearted Mafia King movie, after her father's death, Vivian was abandoned by her stepmother Catherine and stepsister Olivia, then kidnapped and trafficked—until she was rescued by Damien Russo, the king of the mafia, and brought into his home. Despite their age gap, Vivian gradually develops feelings for Damien, while he struggles to resist the temptation. When an arranged marriage between Olivia and Damien is revealed, chaos ensues, putting their already complicated and budding romance to the ultimate test.
68259abb130591adac007a1b.title: My Cold-Hearted Mafia King

6825b0364baea997900af476.synopsis: In I Am Bloody Mary movie, Mare and her fiancé Nick may not have much money, but they have love. As a foster kid with no family of her own, Mare dreams of a wedding with Nick’s family by their side, but Nick is secretive about his estranged relatives. Then, unexpectedly, his mother arrives, warmly inviting Mare into the wealthy and mysterious Thornwood family. She even offers to host the wedding at their grand estate. But the morning of the ceremony, a horrifying discovery shatters Mare's dream, and she realizes she’s not walking into a happy-ever-after, but into a nightmare twisted by the Thornwood family’s dark history--one that might end up killing her.
6825b0364baea997900af476.title: I Am Bloody Mary

6825b1146b80c83269085553.synopsis: In Lassoed by a Cowboy's Love movie, Madison was a Manhattan heiress with it all—until she loses everything, including her now-cruel fiancé who stranded her in Texas. Broke and desperate, Madison wanders into a local saloon…and into the arms of Beau Hayes—her ex’s rugged, dangerously sexy cowboy uncle. After a steamy night, Beau offers her a job -- and an unexpected shelter. Now Madison’s trading pearls for cowboy boots, riding bulls, horses—and maybe even a cowboy.
6825b1146b80c83269085553.title: Lassoed by a Cowboy's Love

6825b16d10d861e01708bf53.synopsis: In Hey Boss Your Company is Getting Bombed movie, Clyde is a middle-aged salesman who has been marginalized in his job. One day, he wakes up with a superpower of seeing when and how people would die. He tries to save multiple people from death, but no one believes him. A few days later, his power tells him there is going to be an explosion at his company that will kill everyone in the building. To save everyone, he has to find out who planted the bomb and stop them.
6825b16d10d861e01708bf53.title: Hey Boss, Your Company is Getting Bombed

6825b18899955153a60f7327.synopsis: Breaking the Deal with My Hockey Bad Boy movie shows Jane Wellsy has a secret — she's got a crush on her stepbrother Nate Duncan. No one knows except for her worst enemy, hockey badboy Zach Gates. Even worse, Jane finds out Nate's new transfer student girlfriend was her bully from high school, Melissa! When Melissa finds Jane's smutty story and demands to know if it's about Nate, Zach swoops in to save her, kicking off their fake relationship to keep her secret safe. As they spend time together, Jane finds there's a warm, kind heart under Zach's cold bad boy persona, ready to heal her broken heart and face the world at her side...
6825b18899955153a60f7327.title: Breaking the Deal with My Hockey Bad Boy

6825b19ec7aae107a705218e.synopsis: In The Alpha's Virgin Captive movie, Evelyn never meant to save the ruthless alpha, Dominic—but now she’s his mate. She’s wolfless and already chosen Harrison, but Dominic doesn’t take no for an answer. He kidnaps her, claiming her as his. She tries to run, but the more she resists, the hotter the desire burns between them. What terrifies her most? The way she’s slowly starting to crave him... more than anything.
6825b19ec7aae107a705218e.title: The Alpha's Virgin Captive

6825b1afb6c3cf13af0e26a6.synopsis: In Doctor Boss Is My Baby Daddy movie: When med intern Molly has a one-night stand with a stranger, she thinks it’s a one-and-done kind of deal. But a month later, she discovers two shocking truths: she’s pregnant with his baby… and the stranger is her new boss, Dr. Graham Weston. As soon as Molly’s secret comes out, so do her rivals, including her jealous family and a figure from Graham's past, each determined to keep her and Graham apart. With pressure mounting from all sides, can they survive the chaos and find love in the process?
6825b1afb6c3cf13af0e26a6.title: Doctor Boss Is My Baby Daddy

6825b313f981e578730e6174.synopsis: In Pregnant by My Ex's Professor Dad movie: on her first day of the semester, Emily catches her boyfriend cheating on her. That night, she has a wild one-night stand with a stranger named Charles. The next day, they are mutually shocked to find out that Charles is Emily's new professor. They maintain a professional student-teacher relationship, but there's an undeniable tension between them. Just when Emily thinks everything will get back on track, she unexpectedly finds out she's pregnant...
6825b313f981e578730e6174.title: Pregnant by My Ex's Professor Dad

6825b32759426343470c833f.synopsis: In The Adjuster movie, after his sister dies due to losing health coverage, Matteo Leone, a broken man, takes justice into his own hands by killing the insurance company CEO. But he isn't just out for revenge, he has a bigger goal: Expose corrupt health insurance companies for preying on their most vulnerable customers. Matteo stays one step ahead of the police, leaving a trail of clues to send his message, soon becoming a hero to the people the evil CEO's thought they could silence.
6825b32759426343470c833f.title: The Adjuster

6825b34d0453c1c8c408726f.synopsis: In Never Reject A Wolf Princess movie: Lia was born a princess, but all she really wants is a life of her own. So she chooses love over duty—only to be betrayed and rejected by her mate. But she’s not one to stay broken for long. When she unexpectedly bonds with a new mate hiding his own secrets, Lia is thrust into a world of power, deception, and second chances. Now, she’s done following the rules. It’s time to reclaim her throne—and make everyone who doubted her regret it!
6825b34d0453c1c8c408726f.title: Never Reject A Wolf Princess

6825b360f80a554645009d35.synopsis: In How to Kiss a Vampire movie, eight years after Vincent abandoned her, Ella—now a single mom—is pushed off a rooftop and saved by a mysterious, flying masked man. She wakes up to find Vincent at her side. He denies being the masked man but insists his enemies are targeting her and demands she move in with him for protection. Why is the man who broke her heart now acting like her savior? And why does he seem... not entirely human? Can Ella trust him again—or is he hiding more than just a mask?
6825b360f80a554645009d35.title: How to Kiss a Vampire

6825b379ac2e521b7f0db504.synopsis: In Queen Never Cry movie: 7 years ago, Nicole leaves her family fortune behind for her husband Ethan. She thought she's the happiest wife and mother -- until Ethan and her best friend Elaine sent her to jail and took her daughter away. Now seeing their true color, Nicole decides to regain her heiress status, take back her daughter and show everyone what a real queen looks like.
6825b379ac2e521b7f0db504.title: Queen Never Cry

6825b38d4baea997900af478.synopsis: In Secret Surrogate to the Mafia King movie, Vanessa Peters is in for a surprise when she goes to sell her eggs to pay off her boyfriend's debt...and ends up pregnant due to a clinical error. She decides to keep the child after finding out her boyfriend is cheating on her, but begins to fear her decision when she finds out that the father is no other than Marcello Lavigne, a ruthless, murderous Mafia King. After saving her life from thugs who try to attack her for having mafia money, Marcello moves Vanessa to his mansion against her will. As he continuously proves his commitment to keeping her safe from criminals, bullies, and his mafia family, Vanessa begins to develop feelings for him despite his player behavior and his murderous capacity. Will she accept Marcello as the father to her child, and accept his offer to become queen of the Mafia empire?
6825b38d4baea997900af478.title: Secret Surrogate to the Mafia King

6825b3b6ddcc859b080f78d6.synopsis: In The Lost Son Returns as the Duke movie: Kidnapped as a child, Arthur, Duke of Mercia, returns to his village to reunite with his long-lost family. What he didn't expect was to find them abused by everyone in town. With his identity a secret, will Arthur be able to avenge them?
6825b3b6ddcc859b080f78d6.title: The Lost Son Returns as the Duke

6825b3d4440cf7c17309a7db.synopsis: Arianna dies a tragic death on the day of her graduation, while Derek, the driver's son, takes all the spotlight on stage. She gave him everything—her car, her credit card, even her father’s company—only to be used and discarded. While he spoiled Ivy like a princess, he treated Arianna like a servant. Only in death does she realize that Hayden, the billionaire’s heir - had been waiting for her all along. Now, fate gives her a second chance to make things right.
6825b3d4440cf7c17309a7db.title: Reborn to Love Mr. Right

6825b3f25b08ac3a230d912d.synopsis: In Obsessed with His Silent Bride movie, Taken in as a ward of the Calvert family, Eva has always loved Declan Calvert, the boy who grew up as her protector. Nonverbal since birth, she struggles to express her feelings in a marriage built on duty—Declan only married her to honor his grandfather’s dying wish. Trapped in a toxic union, Eva endures Declan’s cruelty and his mistress Selene’s relentless schemes to drive her out. Despite it all, Eva clings to the hope that Declan might rediscover the love they once shared as children. Bound by silence, Eva must decide: fight for his heart or break free before it’s too late.
6825b3f25b08ac3a230d912d.title: Obsessed with His Silent Bride

6825b40ac6c46f2b17055695.synopsis: The wolfless Lyra, has been captive in the Wolfsbane pack for seven years, during which she was constantly abused by Alpha Roland. During one of her escapes, Lyra has an accidental one-night stand with Alpha Alfred, Moonshadow pack's strongest Alpha, and becomes pregnant with his child. Alpha Alfred rescues Lyra from Alpha Roland and brings her back to his pack. To protect her, Alfred and Lyra form a Fake Luna contract.
6825b40ac6c46f2b17055695.title: Two Alphas Are in Love with Me

6825b41bf2eb39f1c50606bb.synopsis: In Mother Warrior Unleashed movie, when her teenage daughter is grabbed by sex traffickers, the legendary warrior, Navy SEAL Lieutenant Phoenix Ryan, abandons her life of anonymity as a small town diner owner to rescue her daughter and destroy the Navarro Cartel that has taken her.
6825b41bf2eb39f1c50606bb.title: Mother Warrior Unleashed

6825b45960033dc2750e6ae1.synopsis: When a High Level Mafioso finds himself in the body of a bullied high schooler, he uses it as a second chance at finishing high school. But will his street smarts help him to fulfill his dream of going to college, or will a group of bullies drive him to drop out again?
6825b45960033dc2750e6ae1.title: Mafia Boss Takes High School

6825b4807cc7bf22e3085e15.synopsis: After losing my parents, I move in with my godmother, Aunt Sandra. I live under her roof with her two sons-the Miller brothers-surrounded by love and care. I think I’ll end up with one of them. But everything changes when the maid’s daughter, Lola, moves in. The Miller brother I love most breaks my heart into pieces. After I leave, they lose their minds trying to find me.
6825b4807cc7bf22e3085e15.title: Don't Miss Me When I'm Gone

6825b496ac2e521b7f0db506.synopsis: In Forgive Me, Forget Me Not movie, Lottie is forced to give up on the man she loves in order to save his life. Year later, she runs into him again and he's a bigshot lawyer with billions at his disposal. But not only that, he has a cold hard vendetta against her... for stabbing him.
6825b496ac2e521b7f0db506.title: Forgive Me, Forget Me Not

682fbf3caaa19ac5730dfc8c.synopsis: OG ReelShort stars Autumn Noel and Kasey Esser are back and better than ever! The duo reunites on screen in this episode, rekindling their chemistry. Watch them react to their latest show, Hillbilly Girlie Marries a Billionaire, and spill all the behind the scenes tea about working together again. Trust us, you won’t want to miss this one!
682fbf3caaa19ac5730dfc8c.title: ReelTalk EP23-New Show, Same Spark

6835831790ff91ab240435a1.synopsis: Left heartbroken at the altar, Liana impulsively marries Jacob, a mysterious billionaire hiding his own pain. What begins as a cold agreement transforms into a journey of passion and healing. As they navigate meddling exes, family drama, and corporate battles, will their whirlwind romance blossom into true love, or will their pasts tear them apart?
6835831790ff91ab240435a1.title: Runaway Billionaire Becomes My Groom

6836676702c5394e880dc4cc.synopsis: When her boyfriend suddenly drops out of their roadtrip to her best friend's wedding, Samantha Smiles is forced to take the long drive from LA to NYC with the boy she's spent the last five years trying to forget. The boy she spent one secret summer night with. The boy she let take ALL her firsts: Tristan Montgomery, AKA her best friend's older brother! Torn between loyalty and her resurfacing (mutual?) feelings for Tristan, Samantha has to make a choice: will she keep living for others, or will she finally, for once, do something for herself?!
6836676702c5394e880dc4cc.title: The Boy I Hate

6836a4b02ef81742260a5219.synopsis: In Regret is the Punishment movie, MC Karen is a stay at home mom, her husband Tom is a rich Lawyer. While Karen is out, her house catches on fire and their five year old daughter Anna falls to her death. Good samaritan Merry goes with the fire truck to take Anna to the hospital, driven by Bob, the fire captain. They need to take Anna to the ER for surgery as soon as possible. The fire truck hits Karen's car, on her way back from cheating on her husband. She demands they grovel for forgiveness, then pay for damages, wasting their time. Merry and Eve, the paramedic, as well as kind passerbys, try to get her to move. Karen does not give in, not realizing the fire truck is trying to save her own daughter.
6836a4b02ef81742260a5219.title: Regret is the Punishment

6838c51e0186d2294806ff06.synopsis: To wrap up Mental Health Awareness Month, Autumn Noel gets real with her bestie Amanda Liguori in a heartfelt conversation. For the first time, Autumn opens up about her experience with bullying, online negativity, and the path she’s taken to heal. From finding strength in songwriting to standing up for herself, she shares how she’s turned her struggles into growth. This is Autumn like you’ve never seen her before. Only on ReelTalk!
6838c51e0186d2294806ff06.title: ReelTalk EP24-Surviving Bullying & Navigating Mental Health

68392804654b9abb0b050279.synopsis: In Crossing The Line To Love movie: three days before her wedding, freelance writer Nichole catches her fiancé in bed with her bridesmaid. In a moment of heartbreak and rage, she storms into a bar and kisses a random stranger—only to realize he’s Fabian Winston, a wildly popular contemporary artist and the sole heir to a powerful elite family. The kiss goes viral overnight. Faced with mounting public pressure and relentless media, Nichole is pushed into a contract marriage with Fabian. What starts as a scandal-driven deal slowly unravels into a messy, irresistible entanglement of power, secrets, and unexpected feelings.
68392804654b9abb0b050279.title: Crossing The Line To Love

683e4a35f75bf8fadc007571.synopsis: Rin, the sole heir of the White Nine-Tailed Fox clan, was kidnapped as a child by the Black Nine-Tailed Fox and raised in darkness. On her 20th birthday, she plans to escape—once her fox powers finally awaken. But fate has a cruel twist in store: her destined mate is revealed to be Hyun Dong-joo, the cold and powerful leader of the Black Nine-Tailed Fox. Rin and Hyun Dong-joo resent one another and reject the bond. But just when White Fox leader Baek Do-yoon steps forward and claims Rin as his fated partner, Hyun Dong-joo suddenly declares he will marry her instead. Who will truly be Rin’s fated mate?
683e4a35f75bf8fadc007571.title: Fated Mate of the Nine-Tailed Fox

684205692e68fc317d0f3a28.synopsis: Ever wondered what really goes on behind the scenes of those steamy on-screen moments? Especially in the world of vertical dramas? Renowned intimacy coordinator Olivia Ku joins ReelShort star Tess Dinerstein, known for her bold performances in Surrender to My Professor and How to Tame a Silver Fox, for a candid conversation about the art and logistics of choreographing intimacy. Tess opens up about what empowers her in these daring roles, how she protects her boundaries, and what it takes to bring your favorite romance stories to life. All with safety, trust, and consent.
684205692e68fc317d0f3a28.title: ReelTalk EP25-The Art of Intimacy

68466cf23f6f0588fd06b114.synopsis: In A Sweet Contract with the Mafia Boss movie: by chance, Tessa, an emergency room nurse, saved Victor, a dangerous and charming gang boss, but was strongly targeted by him. He was closing in on her, and she was running for her life—until fate tore away her last hope. Her brother was dying, and the sky-high medical bills were crushing her. Victor narrowed his cold eyes and said, "Be my woman, and I'll save him." She was forced to sign a marriage contract. She resisted his world but indulged in his protection and tenderness. When she found out that the mysterious man who saved her on the rainy night five years ago was actually him, the boundary between hate and love completely collapsed...
68466cf23f6f0588fd06b114.title: A Sweet Contract with the Mafia Boss

684b300872f493d786070e7a.synopsis: "The Adjuster" star Evan Brown sits down with none other than Perez Hilton, making his first-ever appearance on ReelTalk. Together, they reveal a bold new era of storytelling with the first fictionalized show depicting true crime. Watch them react live to the trailer and exclusive scenes, and uncover juicy behind the scenes secrets from set that you won’t find anywhere else.
684b300872f493d786070e7a.title: ReelTalk EP26-The Adjuster Meets The Original Influencer

684fcbef21d655837d01cc7b.synopsis: When Amelia Monroe finds out that hoemcoming queens are dying at her family's academy, she poses as a student to investigate the cause. But she meets her match with Kristy Troy - the baddest bully at Monroe Academy. When they face off for homecoming queen - who will win? And will Amelia save her family's school?
684fcbef21d655837d01cc7b.title: True Heiress Saves High School

68530eb8ef7a335a81085380.synopsis: In Mama, Sing Me a Lullaby movie, Single mother Tracey works hard to raise her twins on her own. Her youngest son Henry hates his family and considers Logan, his older brother with a heart condition, to be a burden. Logan is hit in a car accident and adopted by a rich man, changing his life forever. Tracey continued to work odd jobs as a janitor. Both Tracey and Logan never gave up on finding each other, and Logan, now CEO, feels a connection to Tracey the moment they meet again. Tracey's selfless sacrifice has been wasted on Henry. He finds her embarrassing and is eager to deny knowing her, even actively bullying her. Finally, at Henry's wedding, just as Henry is about to smash a bottle of wine on Tracey, Logan receives the DNA testing results. The woman on stage being humiliated is his own mother!
68530eb8ef7a335a81085380.title: Mama, Sing Me a Lullaby

68533c2caa1810d4df07bf5a.synopsis: Ever wonder what really goes on inside a girl’s head? Is it girl math? Delusion? Pure genius? This is the episode for you. We’re reuniting Never Underestimate Girl Math stars Kaikane and Caledonia to spill the behind-the-scenes tea, dive into the importance of representation, and play a game to decide once and for all: is it girl math… or just straight-up delulu?
68533c2caa1810d4df07bf5a.title: ReelTalk EP27-Beauty, Brains, and Girl Math

6858f8db4a5c5789ed06bcf3.synopsis: Elara catches her fiancé, Victor, cheating on her with her best friend, Helena. Devastated, Elara impulsively marries a humble homeless man named Liam. Unbeknownst to Elara, Liam is actually the billionaire Alpha leader of the werewolf world. And he spoils Elara beyond her wildest dreams!
6858f8db4a5c5789ed06bcf3.title: Fated to My Homeless Billionaire Alpha

6858f8eb8c83eb897809f195.synopsis: After losing her family and her pack, pre-med student, Yara, wants to leave the wolf world behind and live as a normal college girl. But when she stumbles across Alpha Warren, a strong, sexy pack leader and saves his life, he’s hellbent on proving to her she belongs at his side. Convinced they’re fated mates, Warren takes Yara back to his pack to make her queen. When he crowns her pack doctor, Yara goes from shy student to leading Luna, and slowly falls for the Alpha who loves her as she is.
6858f8eb8c83eb897809f195.title: The Pack's Doctor

6858f8f4914e86e56706abbc.synopsis: In My Three Ungrateful Brothers Come Crawling Back movie, Oriana's mom passed away when she was 6; her stepmother abandoned her at a trailer park. When she was 12, she saved the richest man on earth, Murray Morel, and was adopted as his granddaughter. 2 years later, her three brothers found her, and she decided to return to her biological family. In consideration of their egos, she hid her wealth from them but still secretly helped her brothers to succeed in school. However, the brothers are fooled by her evil stepsister and start to bully her. They kicked her out and almost beat her to death. After getting rescued by her adopted Grandfather, she finally sees the true colors of her brothers. She breaks up with them and plans to take everything back. The punished brothers eventually realize that Oriana is their real family and beg on their knees for her forgiveness.
6858f8f4914e86e56706abbc.title: My Three Ungrateful Brothers Come Crawling Back

6858f90310d21493f5048723.synopsis: When high school swim team captain Aidan Crew loses his essential after-school job due to his rich bully Will Harrison standing up for him to his boss, he has no idea how he's going to pay his mother's substantial medical bills and rebuild his college fund, until Will offers Aidan a humiliating, but lucrative job as his pool boy. Aidan reluctantly takes the gig and the two start to fall for one another, but they must navigate the hatred between their families and vicious school bullies, while protecting the secret of Aidan's pool boy gig and the feelings building between them.
6858f90310d21493f5048723.title: Poolboy

6858f9575bd2413a260a1eb2.synopsis: In Sadness Knows No Boundaries movie, Charlotte Hasting's life is turned upside down after her daughter dies due to her husband's negligence and favoritism for a pretty employee. To make matters worse, her husband won't believe her, and thinking that she's hiding their daughter from him, continuously makes her life a living hell.
6858f9575bd2413a260a1eb2.title: Sadness Knows No Boundaries

6858f98983761bd35a005ddd.synopsis: Eve takes a flight to Hawaii to attend her big brother's wedding, booking an extra-wide seat because of her broken leg in a cast. A nasty woman and her bratty son demand Eve switch seats with them. The kid trips because of turbulence, his mom demands the flight turn back and fights the pilots, forcing an emergency landing. The mom's sister, Clara, shows up to back her up. Clara accuses Eve of being her fiancée's mistress, not realizing that she's her fiancée's little sister. The wedding is canceled, and Clara is sent to jail.
6858f98983761bd35a005ddd.title: The Reckoning Takes Flight

6858f9ac22406d541c068b15.synopsis: In Daddy Help Mommy’s in Prison movie, when a powerful CEO discovers his daughter and frees his college sweetheart from prison, they must overcome years of resentment and sacrifice to protect their child from those who tore them apart.
6858f9ac22406d541c068b15.title: Daddy Help! Mommy’s in Prison!

6858fa6fbfdd547a4e00e1b4.synopsis: Emma, a self-made, country girl, has escaped a difficult life, and now works in the city. Life takes a turn for Emma, when she misidentifies handsome stranger William and is forced to marry him , unaware, that William is the CEO of Irving Corporation. Both William and Emma hope to get a divorce soon after, but sparks begin to fly when they move in together. To admit their love for each other and save Irving Corporation from falling into the wrong hands, Emma and William must tackle several obstacles and villains standing in the way of their blossoming romance.
6858fa6fbfdd547a4e00e1b4.title: Country Gal to CEO's Bride

6858fa90d5ac8f5f560d3c25.synopsis: In CEO's Twins Want Mommy Back movie, with a loving hubby and cute stepkids, Cassandra's flash marriage seems too good to be true. But will her troubled past catch up to her? And why do the kids seem so familiar?
6858fa90d5ac8f5f560d3c25.title: CEO's Twins Want Mommy Back

6858fb19fe0ef756060aa940.synopsis: After falling into the water and losing his memory, Warren Davis, a once-powerful chairman, unknowingly becomes a porter at the very hotel he founded. He endures humiliation from his employees - and even his own son, as they treat him as nothing more than a lowly servant, until he remembers who he is.
6858fb19fe0ef756060aa940.title: My Father, My Hero

6858fb34698cc855a209fe28.synopsis: In The Billionaire Female CEO from the Trailer Park movie, Elise Gray was called to serve her country the day of her wedding, developing cutting edge fighter jets for the military. She was also able to use found Lockheed Gray, the world's biggest aerospace and military defense contractor, becoming the richest billionaire in the world. Four years later, she goes home to her husband Cato to give him the wedding they never had, hiding her identity in order to give him the surprise wedding of his dreams. However, when she returns to her small-town she finds trouble - Beatrice has been relentlessly pursuing Cato, plotting to destroy their marriage. Cato's family, especially his mother Stacy, are also trying to push Elise to divorce Cato so he can marry Beatrice, resorting to humiliating her to get their way. Cato's loyalty and earnest love for Elise gives her strength to fight back till the end. Elise won't back down - no matter the cost, she'll defend her marriage and take back her dignity.
6858fb34698cc855a209fe28.title: The Billionaire Female CEO from the Trailer Park

6858fb5deb198a16ec0e6f83.synopsis: Based on the novel by Havley McQueen, published by Tapas Entertainment and Radish. When Jayne Turner asks a stranger at a bondage party to teach her how to be a dominatrix, she has no idea he’ll turn out to be the man overseeing her father’s exit from the family company. What’s meant to be a single night of education about dominance and submission turns into something more when Jayne asks Dom to continue teaching her. Because of a morality clause in his contract, a relationship with her could mean his job if anyone finds out, but Dom agrees. They must keep their relationship strictly educational and entirely undercover, but as their passion grows, so does the risk of discovery. Jayne’s success on the movie set is thanks to Dom’s “instruction,” but as she begins receiving increasingly more threatening messages tying her to her deceased mother, famous actress Ingrid Hart, it's up to Dom to protect what he owns. With multiple enemies possibly behind the threats, Jayne isn’t sure who to blame. It turns out to be the gaffer on set, a man who’d worked with and been obsessed with Ingrid. Doug kidnaps Jayne but her quick thinking has Dom on the way to rescue her – which reveals their relationship and triggers the morality clause. Dom makes a deal with Jayne’s dad without her knowledge. Dad will back off trying to stop Jayne’s movie career, and Dom will return to London, never to see her again. The night of Jayne’s movie premiere, Dad reveals the truth and Jayne reaches out to the man she’s fallen in love with. At her message, Dom returns to beg forgiveness for leaving her. Jayne forgives them, and they can be together openly.
6858fb5deb198a16ec0e6f83.title: Dominated by My Dad's Boss

6858fb7de433f2f91702fca0.synopsis: Billionaire magnate Jack retired to spend time with his family. He was once CEO of the world's biggest defense contractor, but he's not just a school janitor. His son throws him out of their house to make space for his new baby. Jack saves a young woman from danger. She's so impressed by his heroics she sets him up with her mother Emma, the icy cold headmistress. They start a contract marriage. The school dean keeps trying to overthrow Emma, Jack swooping in to save her from his schemes, even saving the school from bankruptcy! Right when Emma is facing unprecedented challenges, about to be removed from the school board, he steps in with billions of dollars to save her from humiliation. His true identity is finally revealed - he's the richest man in the world!
6858fb7de433f2f91702fca0.title: The Billionaire Janitor Is Back!

6858fb989839201f9b033264.synopsis: In The Lost Quarterback Returns movie, when Asher Bradshaw, the son of hall-of-famer NFL quarterback Trent Bradshaw and former beauty queen Krista, goes missing in a devastating fire, psychotic fan Donny Lewis takes it as an opportunity to swap Asher with his own son, Wyatt. Twelve years later, the two boys cross paths at football tryouts where Asher out performs Wyatt. The Bradshaw's not realizing Asher is their long-lost son, attack him relentlessly. They put him through physical and mental torture, egged on by their adoptive son. Until they uncover the shocking truth—Asher's the one they've been looking for. The Bradshaws then do everything in their power to beg for forgiveness while Wyatt and Donny plot revenge.
6858fb989839201f9b033264.title: The Lost Quarterback Returns

6858fbb2ba1325d77905c8c6.synopsis: Chef Leon Kennedy, once the "King of Cooking," fell apart after his wife died in a tragic car accident. His deep depression led him to fall into homelessness, losing everything except his beloved dog, Dante. A restaurant owner takes him in, giving him a job, not knowing who he is. Working in the kitchen, he faces the abuse of the executive sous chef (Bryant), who belittles and disrespects him. Leon tries to keep his head down, but when a nefarious businessman (William) threatens the restaurant, Leon has to break out the skills and artistry that made him a legendary chef. The restoration of his glory and joy is shortlived, however, as the spiteful chef Bryant defames him, and the resentful William kills his beloved dog. Enduring ups, downs, and devastation once again, the aggrieved Chef Leon picks up his chef's knife, hungry for revenge.
6858fbb2ba1325d77905c8c6.title: Cooking My Way Back to Love

6858fbe0326be9941603afe7.synopsis: In Yearning for a Mother's Love movie, Maeve is from the richest family in town. She elopes with a mechanic and gives birth to our protagonist, Lydia. But after a tragic car accident, and interference from Maeve's mother, Regina, Maeve was led to believe that Lydia died. Lydia grows up without a mother. Eighteen years later, by a twist of fate, Lydia ends up working as a maid in Maeve's home. Will Maeve realize that this poor, quiet, anonymous maid is actually her long-lost daughter?
6858fbe0326be9941603afe7.title: Yearning for a Mother's Love

6858fc06d565019f9c058b58.synopsis: In I'm Done Being a Yes-Man movie, Enzo is the mysterious heir to the Quinn Corporation. He comes from a prominent family and has an extraordinary talent for football. He is infatuated with the daughter of his family's chauffeur, Stella Hall. One night, Stella gets into an accident from drunk driving, but she convinces Enzo to take the blame for her. Worried that her secret will eventually get out, Stella scams Enzo out of all his savings and hires a killer to murder Enzo. However, just as Enzo is about to die, a mysterious power sends him one month back into the past. Now that Enzo knows Stella's real personality, he's no longer in love with her. Enzo resolves to leave behind his "simp" image and make sure Stella gets what she deserves.
6858fc06d565019f9c058b58.title: I'm Done Being a Yes-Man

685dc17eadb7b88e4f012890.synopsis: Sink your teeth into this dangerously addictive inside look at Seth Eden and Nicole Mattox’s new show, How to Kiss a Vampire. For the first time ever, we’re getting an intimate glimpse into their life on set and everything in between. From Seth’s morning routines to Nicole’s workouts and a few daring stunts shared between on-screen lovers, this is more than just a love story. Follow along this reunion told through video diaries. Get ready to fall for the ReelShort stars you already adore, all over again.
685dc17eadb7b88e4f012890.title: ReelTalk EP28-Backstage: How to Kiss a Vampire

6862fd11255c680c4706b9f1.synopsis: Scarlett Winters is devastated when her fiancé, Carlton Simmons, abandons her at the altar. Fleeing in humiliation, she’s nearly hit by a car, an incident orchestrated by Leo Forester, genius and legendary CEO who recognizes the runaway bride. Leo offers her an unusual solution: a contract marriage to help her regain her dignity and rebuild her life. As Scarlett heals, Leo secretly supports her, hiding his true identity and intentions. But when old enemies resurface and buried secrets emerge, Scarlett feels betrayed and considers leaving. Now Leo must decide: confess his feelings or risk losing her forever.
6862fd11255c680c4706b9f1.title: Stop Crying, I Married Someone Better

6863a4b94a66dce83c0ac654.synopsis: After a car accident, Memi falls into a coma—but her soul awakens and witnesses a nurse secretly swapping her newborn son. Powerless to act, Memi watches for seven years as her real son, Nick, suffers abuse. Just as the nurse plans to harvest his corneas to cover the truth, Memi miraculously wakes up and rushes to save him.
6863a4b94a66dce83c0ac654.title: Hidden Companionship

6865ae4d7b1481d70c0384da.synopsis: Get ready to kick it with the guys of ReelShort in this hilarious ReelTalk spin-off! Richard Sharrah, Aaron Oberst, and Jeff Lawless are heating up the summer with an epic BroTalk hangout. From juicy fan questions to never-before-heard stories, nothing is off limits!
6865ae4d7b1481d70c0384da.title: ReelTalk EP 29-BroTalk Part 1

686c974d1a828765240c2774.synopsis: In The Lost Daughter's Silent Cry movie, in a cruel twist of fate, Annabella Walton's perfect life is shattered. Ten years later, to save her disabled adoptive father, Annabella, now named Amelia, is forced to deal with the Walton family again...this time, as the target of their attacks. Will the Waltons figure out the truth? Or will it be too late for Amelia?
686c974d1a828765240c2774.title: The Lost Daughter's Silent Cry

68703631be870f923e058d0f.synopsis: The party’s not over. It’s just getting hotter with BroTalk! Richard Sharrah, Aaron Oberst, and Jeff Lawless are back with more flexing, grilling, and a competitive game of pool. Oh, and did someone say surprise ape cameo? Tune in to see what kind of mischief the bros are stirring up this summer!
68703631be870f923e058d0f.title: ReelTalk EP 30-BroTalk Part 2

68795c2c1fc318d4220c0eb6.synopsis: Get your backstage stage pass the The Deaf Heiress’s Secret! This is a story packed with deception, dark schemes, and shocking betrayals. But off-camera, it’s a whole different vibe. Join Sarah Moliski as she uncovers the real fun on set, including exclusive interviews with Adam Daniel and Samantha Drews you won’t see anywhere else.
68795c2c1fc318d4220c0eb6.title: ReelTalk EP 31-Backstage: The Deaf Heiress's Secret

687addd8fdb18489980cda6b.synopsis: At her parents' anniversary party, a successful CEO is dismissed as a low-class nobody, her diamond gift called fake, and she's even banned from the table!
687addd8fdb18489980cda6b.title: Queen Mom Rules

687da1f5514a4243e20a55ba.synopsis: In How To Trap President's Son movie, in a world where money rules everything, he’s the President’s son - a handsome, spoiled playboy above the law. She’s just a cleaning lady with a dream and… a mop. One accidental kiss turns into a media scandal, and suddenly they’re forced to fake a romance for the public.
687da1f5514a4243e20a55ba.title: How To Trap President's Son

687da24e3b6625abbd0b3264.synopsis: In The Year in His Chains movie, when Anna's husband racks up a massive debt to dangerous mob boss Jeremy, she becomes the price - literally his property for one year. She expects cruelty from the notorious crime lord, but discovers something unexpected: a wounded man hiding behind his cold mask. Her cheating husband wants her to seduce Jeremy for money. His controlling father wants her eliminated. But as Anna finds herself caught between lies and loyalty, she realizes the man who owns her might be the only one who truly sees her. Sometimes the chains that bind you are the only things that can set you free.
687da24e3b6625abbd0b3264.title: The Year in His Chains

687da27a4b1b7f3b77045a6c.synopsis: In The Woman Starts The War movie, when nurse Cindy gets caught in a deadly mafia shootout, ruthless crime boss Allan D'Angelo saves her life by declaring she's his fiancée. Now she's a prisoner in his world - living in his mansion, wearing his ring, and playing a role that could get her killed.
687da27a4b1b7f3b77045a6c.title: The Woman Starts The War

687f2a41314aed63020928f9.synopsis: Dani, a mousy, plain-looking designer, saves her company's Paris Fashion Week show only to have her success stolen by lazy but stylish intern Brynn, who gets Dani FIRED by her boss's power-hungry daughter. But when a rival fashion house recruits Dani, she gets the glow-up of the century and becomes determined to show off her design skills and reclaim her title as the true couture QUEEN.
687f2a41314aed63020928f9.title: You Fired a Fashion Icon

687f2a606574848af1043cb9.synopsis: The Iron Marine, Toby Stark, returns home after saving the country only to be brutally dumped by his ex who as no clue he's the richest guy on Earth! How will Tobias slap back at her?
687f2a606574848af1043cb9.title: Money, Robots, and a Happy 4th of July

687f2ab2dafc1bd65e0e34ca.synopsis: After Dr. Adrian Marksman, the most renowned surgeon in the country, gets dismissed by his boss's son, he joins forces with Dr. Vivian Hart, the brilliant and ambitious head of a rival hospital. This move drives his former hospital into financial ruin, and when Preston realizes he has let go of the wrong doctor, it's already too late...
687f2ab2dafc1bd65e0e34ca.title: You Fired A Genius Surgeon

687f2ae7a58a11d8910aca34.synopsis: In Escorting the Ruthless Billionaire Doctor movie, Violet, desperate to pay for her father’s surgery, decides to sell her virginity, but the good doctor she calls is determined to pull her back from the edge. However, as the two share a heated, unforgettable night, Dax finds himself hooked on Violet, despite thinking she’s just another gold-digger. When their darkest secrets are laid bare, will their fragile connection survive?
687f2ae7a58a11d8910aca34.title: Escorting the Ruthless Billionaire Doctor

687f2aff660c56461a0952a8.synopsis: When Elle Vanderbilt, the secret tech-genius Dr. Nova, is divorced and dumped by her husband for an imposter, she flash marries handsome stranger Roy Grant - only to discover he's her ex’s biggest rival. Together, Elle and Roy battle her cheating ex and the fake Dr. Nova for the world's biggest tech contract.
687f2aff660c56461a0952a8.title: You Divorced a Genius Heiress

6881db3fabcfd08c27003f1c.synopsis: Four years ago, at the wedding arranged by their families, Max, the scion of the conglomerate, was absent, leaving the down-and-out socialite Alice as the nominal Mrs. M. Four years later, Alice has transformed into a well-known divorce case investigator, while Max returns home as the chairman of the M Group and entrusts her with handling his divorce case—neither recognizing the other. The meddling of a scheming colleague and the conspiracy of a cousin pile up one misunderstanding after another. When the truth comes to light, the two, who once passed each other by, finally come together after resolving their knots.
6881db3fabcfd08c27003f1c.title: That Makes Two of Us

6882afe4da4e24bb0d021242.synopsis: In this episode, we reunite two familiar faces from the ReelShort universe: Kiki Frags and Samantha Drews. The duo reminisces about their first time meeting and share some stories from set. Plus, Kiki surprises a fan with a video call so get ready for some laugh out loud moments as he answers their burning questions. Stick around as Kiki reacts to How to Dump a Hockey Star and drops some juicy insights you won’t want to miss!
6882afe4da4e24bb0d021242.title: ReelTalk EP 32-Getting Dumped & Calling Fans

6883565dc255ace14a072541.synopsis: Pregnant. Widowed. Dragged into the Mancini mafia. Ava never expected her late husband to be the hidden heir—nor to crave his ruthless brother. Ice-cold don Luca vows to shield her, but every touch ignites a forbidden fire. Rival gangs close in, her birth family plots betrayal, and the dynasty teeters on war. How long before Luca shatters every rule to claim the woman worth killing for?
6883565dc255ace14a072541.title: Mancini’s Forbidden Bride

688b2690b360370bcb019ea1.synopsis: In Yellowstone King of Montana movie, Henry Conrad, the legendary founder of Yellowstone Ranch and the King of Montana, hid his identity as a school janitor. Now, after 10 years -- he's returning to his throne. However, before he can reveal who he is, his son gets bullied, beaten and humiliated. Henry vows to protect his son, make the bullies pay and right the wrongs in this valley like a real King.
688b2690b360370bcb019ea1.title: Yellowstone: King of Montana

688b26ae50d6a96cd8026622.synopsis: 8 months pregnant, Alyssa is abandoned by her husband for his mistress and their lovechild Lilly. Little do they know, Alyssa is actually Jane Davenport M.D.--heiress to the Davenport fortune, and the only heart surgeon in the world that can save Lilly.
688b26ae50d6a96cd8026622.title: The Divorced Wife is a Genius Surgeon

688b26ee23935b2c1a04ea3b.synopsis: Fresh out of prison, Grace landed a job as a nanny. Her boss, the ruthless billionaire Alex Hill, cares only about his precious daughter. Grace passed Alex's rigorous test and gradually won over his cold heart, but Grace holds a dark secret, one that could destroy everything good.
688b26ee23935b2c1a04ea3b.title: Ex-Convict Nanny and Billionaire Single Dad

688b2701ad6a89c3b60c1133.synopsis: In When Wife Won't Forgive movie, on their 25th wedding anniversary, Anne discovers her bestselling author husband, Jonathan, has been having an affair. Anne is fed up and wants to get a divorce. Jonathan thinks he's going to become the CEO of the publishing company, so he immediately kicks Anne to the curb. Utterly heartbroken, Anne decides she won't forgive Jonathan again. She resumes her position as Chairwoman of an elite publishing company, and removes Jonathan from his position. Jonathan finally realizes that Anne who played housewife for 25 years was actually a wealthy heiress.
688b2701ad6a89c3b60c1133.title: When Wife Won't Forgive

688b27fc69789c93710bf84e.synopsis: In The Genius and the Bad Boy movie, when two hot brothers go after plus size Sophie, will she pick the true-hearted bad boy or the lying quarterback?
688b27fc69789c93710bf84e.title: The Genius and the Bad Boy

688be44fe3eb5bba8b0233dd.synopsis: We go deep in this episode with the badass queen we all know and love, Eli Jane. She takes us through the highs and lows of her journey, sharing how every experience, even the tough ones, helped shape who she is today. No regrets, just realness. Grab some tissues and get ready because she’s also answering fan questions you’ve all been dying to know!
688be44fe3eb5bba8b0233dd.title: ReelTalk EP 33-Modern Elegance, Redefined

689412a977c582c95a06a0be.synopsis: Kate's always fantasized about a sexy man who will dominate her in the bedroom, but finding one is way easier said than done. Until Catacombs' notorious Master, Banner Jennings, offers to help her find the perfect Dom. But once he finds her sexual match, will he be willing to let her go?
689412a977c582c95a06a0be.title: Finding Master Right

689528c167783fdbd208f8f2.synopsis: We’re graduating today… to the set of the steamy series, Pregnant by My Ex’s Professor Dad, starring Jesse Morales and Tess Dinerstein! Join our host, Sarah Moliski, as she takes you behind the scenes to uncover the sizzling secrets of bringing Jesse and Tess’s characters to life. There’s drama, games with the crew, and wait for it, alpacas. Steamy scenes and furry friends? Count us in.
689528c167783fdbd208f8f2.title: ReelTalk EP 34-Backstage: Pregnant by My Ex's Professor Dad

68955a832bc50c718b009d8d.synopsis: In Daisy Tucker and Mr. NYC movie, after a flash marriage, country girl Daisy finds herself married to her new boss, Hamilton Smith, owner of Smith Media. But misunderstandings and plots by Hamilton's evil VP, Bianca, threaten to destroy their relationship before they can confess that they really love each other.
68955a832bc50c718b009d8d.title: Daisy Tucker and Mr. NYC

689aa21bb709670003083069.synopsis: In Miss You After Goodbye movie, to repay a debt of kindness, Neil signs a secret contract with Keira's father stating that he will marry Keira for five years and help her recover from a painful breakup with her first love, Simon. During their contract marriage, Neil is attentive and caring towards Keira, but she never treats him as anything more than Simon's substitute. When the contract comes to an end, Neil discovers Keira's persisting infatuation with Simon and finally decides to divorce her. When Keira sees the divorce agreement and learns from her father of Neil's departure, she is overcome with regret and travels the world searching for Neil, ultimately realizing that the man she lost was truly in love with her. However, it's all too little too late, as Neil has already embarked on a new, promising path and left her behind for good.
689aa21bb709670003083069.title: Miss You After Goodbye

689b41196c5945d642016ca5.synopsis: School hockey star Brady asks brainy wallflower Harper to be his chemistry tutor. In exchange, he promises to be her fake boyfriend, teach her how to flirt — and help her land her crush. But what will happen when their contract backfires, and the chemistry becomes more than just on paper?
689b41196c5945d642016ca5.title: The Tutor Trap

689b432d58c2b18f9509250d.synopsis: In The Hidden Billionaire in First Class movie, they all thought Jett Hawkings was a lowly baggage handler and threatened to throw him off the flight. But when their plane is about to crash due to a storm, he's actually the secret billionaire that can save them.
689b432d58c2b18f9509250d.title: The Hidden Billionaire in First Class

689b4c59ab5190f7610e5779.synopsis: ReelShort invites all visionary creators to showcase their storytelling brilliance in the most anticipated short drama contest of the year. Whether it's romance, suspense, a ReelShort fan adaptation, or something entirely original - turn your talent into impact! Our very own Sarah Moliski and Luke Charles Stafford show you how to reimagine iconic ReelShort series with your own unique creative lens. Follow along, grab your wig, and enter the contest today!
689b4c59ab5190f7610e5779.title: ReelTalk EP 35-Surrender to My Reel Vertical Impact

689bfaee016e1832030ff98b.synopsis: After a one-night stand with an infertile billionaire silver fox, a 45 year old maid discovers she’s pregnant with his twins… as he strives to secure his company’s legacy by producing heirs, they must navigate their clashing worlds and unexpected feelings to see if they can build a family together.
689bfaee016e1832030ff98b.title: Pregnant by the Golden Billionaire Bachelor

689bfb20fb303ed5f209d2ad.synopsis: In You Are My Destiny movie, Logan was blind and abandoned—until Giselle saved him, and they fell in love. She sacrificed everything for him, even giving him her corneas. But just as he regained his sight, she was gone. What he didn’t know was that she was pregnant—and fate made her his wife. Five years later, Logan returns as the Hale heir, unaware that his wife and their ailing daughter are the very ones he’s been searching for. When the truth finally comes out, will he win them back—or has he already lost them forever?
689bfb20fb303ed5f209d2ad.title: You Are My Destiny

689bfb32655f032e0e0a4031.synopsis: In I Love You More Than Life movie, during Eric and Grace's wedding anniversary party, Grace's stepsister Amanda suddenly appears and demands that Grace give Eric back to her, shocking everyone at the party. Amanda devises a way to purposely make Grace fall, which causes Grace to have a miscarriage. Instead of looking after Grace, her husband instead leaves with Amanda in his arms. This is Grace's cold awakening. She finally decides to divorce Eric.
689bfb32655f032e0e0a4031.title: I Love You More Than Life

689bfb4bcd280b136601cf5d.synopsis: When Anna Sinclair is cheated out of a prestigious art scholarship in Paris, her only chance to escape her abusive parents, she reinvents herself as a glamorous New York socialite to catch the eye of rich kid Preston Kingsley and secure a second shot at her dreams. But things get complicated when she starts to fall for Preston’s best friend, Brooks Whitmore, Upper East Side royalty and the biggest threat to exposing Anna's true identity. Will her secret turn Brooks against her, or will it bring them the happy ending that neither of them saw coming?
689bfb4bcd280b136601cf5d.title: Park Avenue Girls Don't Play Nice

689bfcef5bd68625550ec33b.synopsis: Bella, heir to the wealthy Walton family, is tired of being surrounded by calculating rich kids. She falls for Marc, a plus-size guy who seems to love her for who she is, hiding her identity and even helping him get recruited to Harvard’s football team. But betrayal hits hard, Bella discovers Marc has been cheating on her with her classmate - and bully - Jessie, who constantly mocks Bella’s body. Even worse, Marc has stolen her identity, claiming he is the Walton heir to win clout and rise to the top of Western High’s social scene. Bella dumps him, has a stunning glow-up, and embraces her curves. When they mock her college future… could Bella’s next move leave them speechless?
689bfcef5bd68625550ec33b.title: The Queen Bee Strikes Back

689d78ed706a951e700a01c7.synopsis: In The Beast on Her Leash movie, to find evidence of Vincent's crimes—the murderer of her parents—Eliza accepts an invitation from Vincent's father to become the president of Evertech AI. Unexpectedly, the father imposes an additional condition: she must educate his youngest son, Ryder, who is as ferocious as a wild beast, into a civilized man. After agreeing, Eliza finds Ryder an extremely difficult man to handle, and the two often clash with intense tension. However, during their coexistence, Ryder falls in love with Eliza. When Eliza realizes she has feelings for Ryder too, she is forced to push him away in order to pursue Vincent's crimes. The entanglement among them is filled with ambiguity and excitement, where opportunities and dangers coexist.
689d78ed706a951e700a01c7.title: The Beast on Her Leash

689e222a75034b7ff90fd71b.synopsis: Identical twins Erin and Elise were torn apart as kids. 20 years later, gently Elise is betrayed by the two people she trusted most — her husband and best friend — then tortured and left for dead. Grief-stricken and furious, badass CEO Erin steps into her dead sister’s life to exact revenge. Their faces may be carbon copies, but Erin is no one one to mess with as she systematically and pyschologically pits her sister’s husband and best friend against each other in a cat and mouse game to destroy the murderers.
689e222a75034b7ff90fd71b.title: Her Double, His Trouble

68a2c80901fe3f9d300fbb61.synopsis: Two heirs of rival mafia families fall in love under false identities. A gang war leaves Alyssa injured with amnesia, Dylan poses as her fiancé，entangling them in love, betrayal, and buried family secrets…
68a2c80901fe3f9d300fbb61.title: Secret Life of A Mafia Sweetheart

68a2c832774c14ee960cd38d.synopsis: Jennifer Sullivan, a lawyer, becomes a spy for Isaac Marks in order to save her sister. In the midst of love, hate and conspiracy, she gradually uncovers the truth of the arson case, and when the murderer is finally caught and Isaac reforms, Jennifer decides to let go of her past and make a fresh start with Isaac.
68a2c832774c14ee960cd38d.title: Love Under Contract

68a2c85cae1686e7de05fbd0.synopsis: The U.S. nuclear medical professor Charlie Clare quits his career for family, but is abandoned as his wife and daughter favor his love rival Isaac. After suffering his family’s ignorance, he decides to leave for the Unicorn Project, which he designed for healing his daughter’s neuro-skel birthmark as his life work. But unaware that Charlie’s burning his life for them, his wife and daughter deepen the rift with Charlie upon reunion and eventually destroy everything Charlie left for them with their own hands before realizing their errors, only to find it too late.
68a2c85cae1686e7de05fbd0.title: Beg for My Return After Kicking Me Out

68a2d77dc2e678dddd06f4fd.synopsis: Lena — heir to the divine legacy of Athena. A nurturing, gentle mother figure, easily moved by compassion, yet beneath her warmth lies a sharp, commanding presence. Once the High Strategos of the fabled Order of Aegis, she vanished from power after a devastating fire twenty-five years ago—when she risked her life to save seven infants and raised them as her own. For decades, Lena kept her true identity hidden. But on her fiftieth birthday, the seven sons she sacrificed everything for are swayed by their birth families, turning against her and branding her a trafficker. Betrayed and heartbroken, Lena awakens her long-buried power. No longer willing to endure in silence, she rises to reclaim control, expose the truth, and remind the world—and her sons—why she was once feared as a leader destined to command.
68a2d77dc2e678dddd06f4fd.title: The Betrayed Mother is the Divine Heiress

68a769452bda5a620e0882a8.synopsis: We’re bringing back the cast of ReelShort’s first unscripted hit, Love Bombing. The singles (and not-so-singles) reunite to spill the tea, revisit the drama, and relive the jaw-dropping moments that made this dating rollercoaster unforgettable.
68a769452bda5a620e0882a8.title: ReelTalk EP 36-Love Bombing: The Reunion

68a77fac1967059c3c0457d2.synopsis: Sierra Lane thought she was getting her life back when she was finally released from juvie after taking the fall for her boyfriend, Jake. Instead, she’s met with a shocking truth: she’s the long-lost Lancaster Heiress, heir to one of the biggest fortunes in the country. Armed with a new identity and eager to reclaim her place at Hawthorne Prep, Sierra returns to school, ready to share the news. But instead of a warm welcome, she finds that Jake has moved on with her ex-best friend, Fallon. Even worse, Fallon has already been telling everyone that she and the heiress are best friends, making Sierra’s arrival a direct threat to Fallon's reign as queen bee of the school. As Sierra battles relentless gossip, sabotage, and an entire school that wants her sent back to juvie, she’ll have to prove she’s exactly who she says she is before Fallon destroys her reputation for good.
68a77fac1967059c3c0457d2.title: Don't Mess with a Prep School Princess

68a8094e16f9696eb3064b98.synopsis: In Coaching His Heart movie, after a one-night stand, Kate and Tom are separated by a misunderstanding. They reunite one month later when Kate becomes the assistant coach of a men's hockey team and Tom joins as their new captain. Forced to work in close proximity, sparks of their unresolved passion begin to reignite. Only this time, Kate must hide a big secret to keep her job—she's pregnant with Tom's child - a revelation that could change everything.
68a8094e16f9696eb3064b98.title: Coaching His Heart

68a80959bddb266830011182.synopsis: The Stay-At-Home Dad Levels Up tells the story of Jack Parker, a penniless orphan deeply devoted to his wife and son. Unfortunately for Jack, his wife’s family has always disapproved of him, and are actively trying to sabotage their relationship. All that changes when Jack becomes the heir to one of the richest companies in the world. Now Jack must convince them that he is really a billionaire, before they sabotage his marriage, get his daughter taken away, or even have him killed.
68a80959bddb266830011182.title: Stay-at-Home Dad Levels Up

68a80965464e649eb9009808.synopsis: In You Drive Me Crazy movie, 6 years ago, car restorer Yasmin was drugged and had a passionate encounter with a handsome homeless guy she thought she’d never see again — only to discover she was carrying his child. Now, fighting to save her 5-year-old son, she takes a job as secretary to Tristen Mars, former race car driver and CEO of Mars Motor Group. Little does she know this billionaire is the father of her little boy! As old sparks reignite and hidden truths come dangerously close to the surface, Yasmin and Tristen fall for each other while still unaware that they’re the very strangers they’ve spent years longing to find.
68a80965464e649eb9009808.title: You Drive Me Crazy

68a8097158b3889a170408d0.synopsis: Raised in rural poverty, Taylor gets into MIT, but her father and older brother rip up the acceptance letter and sell her to an old rich man for cash. With help from her mom and little sister, Taylor escapes—but loses all contact with them. Seven years later, Taylor is the richest person in the world. She returns home in glory—only to find her mom beaten and her sister sold by her brother. Fueled by rage, Taylor shows up at the welcome banquet held for the world’s top CEO—her brother, now her employee, doesn’t recognize her and calls her a whore in front of everyone. Can Taylor prove who she is, find her sister, and bring justice to those who crushed her? And when the truth comes out—what punishment awaits those who looked down upon Taylor?
68a8097158b3889a170408d0.title: What Doesn't Break Me

68ac9e836fa202798104e24a.synopsis: In Dungeons of Ecstasy movie, after a near-fatal car crash shatters her body and her heart, travel journalist Emily escapes to remote Italy—only to be ensnared in the mysterious Dungeon of Ecstasy, where her captor, uncannily resembling her long-abandoned ex-husband, forces her through dangerous, sensual trials that awaken forbidden memories and a love she never knew was meant to heal her.
68ac9e836fa202798104e24a.title: Dungeons of Ecstasy

68ad71a3071da44c3a0119d4.synopsis: In The Fashion Queen Returns movie, once the Queen of the Red Carpet, Eve Corbelle is content with her new life as a housewife--until a sudden betrayal brings her back to the center of her fashion empire at the Grand Maple Gala.
68ad71a3071da44c3a0119d4.title: The Fashion Queen Returns

68afbd04a97815e1c00b13db.synopsis: In Carrying His Triplets, Becoming His Wifey movie, Daisy works in a warehouse to pay for her tuition, but her father steals her money. Financially desperate, gets another job at a strip club to make ends meet. There, she has a one-night stand with Marcus, a billionaire. Soon after, Daisy discovers that she is pregnant with triplets.
68afbd04a97815e1c00b13db.title: Carrying His Triplets, Becoming His Wifey

68afbd1325d801f4860baa74.synopsis: Nina runs into hot hockey captain Enzo at a party after she catches her boyfriend Justin cheating. Since Enzo's a known player who only sleeps with girls once, Nina agrees to a no strings attached night of fun with Enzo, but when they both catch feelings, Nina learns that Enzo's player reputation is due to a rule: he can't have sex with anyone twice, or they'll die. The catch is...if Nina's his fated mate, she's safe. But that's not all. Enzo's got a crazy ex-hookup who won't let him go and wants to make Lisa's life a living hell. And once Nina lost her virginity, her true hybrid nature emerged, putting her sister Selena's crosshairs. Selena wants to escape the Lycan World by switching places with Nina. While Enzo and Nina try to navigate their budding romance amidst never ending drama, the Sister kidnaps Nina to the Lycan World--all with the help of Nina's internship colleague James. All the while Enzo is fighting to stake his pack's place in the human world by winning a hockey tournament against his sworn enemy Ronan, while Enzo's father plans to marry him off to none other than Nina's sister Selena. In the end, Enzo wins his tournament, and Selena comes into the human world and pretends to be Nina, until Enzo's father blows her cover. Enzo races to the Lycan World to save Nina, and they finally have sex for the second time and learn that Nina is, indeed, Enzo's fated mate. Enzo has one more rule...no more sex without engagement, and he takes Nina as his fiance...and they live happily ever after.
68afbd1325d801f4860baa74.title: My Hockey Alpha

68afbd239ced05f58b0e83b5.synopsis: In The Billionaire Married a Homeless Girl movie, after a one-night-stand, Adele Moore becomes pregnant. She wants to keep the child, but her father kicks her out of the house. With nowhere else to go, Adele becomes homeless. She tries her best to raise her son despite her challenging circumstances. One day, Adele's son, Brad Moore, runs into billionaire Heston Deleon. By chance, Heston discovers that Brad is his son. He tries to track down Brad, but loses their trail. Through a series of misunderstandings, Adele and Heston become entangled again!
68afbd239ced05f58b0e83b5.title: The Billionaire Married a Homeless Girl

68b1135109ac3c3b58012dfb.synopsis: In The Mafia Boss Happenes to Be My Sex Partner movie, Fiona Shaw's life of luxury shattered when her family's empire collapsed, leaving her burdened with a crushing $500 million debt. To save what's left of her family, she agrees to a cold-hearted bargain: a marriage of convenience to Henry Sterling, the second son of a powerful business dynasty. But behind the glamour of high society lies a painful truth. Henry is gay, deeply in love with his male secretary, Louis, and indifferent to Fiona. He married for one reason alone—to produce an heir under his mother Elizabeth's pressure, secure the family fortune, and defeat his rival half-brother, Jeff. Now, trapped in a loveless marriage and yearning for freedom, Fiona finds herself drawn into a dangerous affair… with a man whose secrets are even deadlier than her own.
68b1135109ac3c3b58012dfb.title: The Mafia Boss Happens to Be My Sex Partner

68b17820f4d69f56740a6a23.synopsis: Caroline has just picked up her engagement ring that she ordered a few weeks ago. She wants to show the ring to Matthew, her fiancé, at Matthew's apartment. When she arrives at Matthew's apartment, she discovers Matthew having sex with her stepsister, Alexis. Caroline is furious and quickly leaves Matthew's apartment, but accidentally gets hit by a speeding motorcycle. At that moment, Jack, who is overseeing his company's apartment, sees Caroline and immediately saves her. The next day, Alexis and Matthew visit Caroline at the hospital, but Caroline, feeling very sad, asks for the engagement to be called off. While at the hospital, Caroline sees a man attempting to steal the wallet of an elderly patient. Caroline helps the elderly woman. While escorting the woman back to her room, Caroline receives a call from her late mother's company lawyer, informing her that her stepmother plans to transfer ownership of her mother's Rosewood company to Caroline's greedy stepmother, Joana. Upon entering the woman's room, Caroline discovers Jack, the woman's grandson, who has just arrived, and the woman, named Nancy, is seen scolding Jack, who is also unmarried. Jack appears disheveled as he had just returned from inspecting his company, leading Caroline to assume he is poor.A few days later, Caroline meets Jack at a cafe and asks him to marry her. Eventually, the company falls into Caroline's hands, and she struggles to restore her mother's company to its former financial glory, which has suffered a decline.Throughout their journey, Caroline discovers that Jack is the heir to the famous Stone family. However, the conflict is not over as her stepmother, Joana, tries to sabotage their marriage. In the end, Caroline and Jack overcome all obstacles and begin a new, happy life together.
68b17820f4d69f56740a6a23.title: The Day We Got Married

68b9292947761f335e0a7b74.synopsis: Five years ago, curvy waitress Scarlett saved Brandon's life and spent one unforgettable night of passion with him before vanishing. Now she's back, slimmed down and unrecognizable, and he's the reclusive CEO who unknowingly fathered her daughter.
68b9292947761f335e0a7b74.title: I Had a Baby without You

68b929384c72c7c64907f813.synopsis: In Mistaken as His Mate The Luna’s Regret movie, Alpha Caspian’s pregnant sister Marina arrives for his Luna’s coronation, but Luna Willow mistakes her for a rogue mistress. In a jealous rage, Willow bullies Marina, causing her miscarriage. Now the Brooks siblings want blood.
68b929384c72c7c64907f813.title: Mistaken as His Mate: The Luna’s Regret

68b92943a20880cce40ac468.synopsis: Chloe and Mateo have been best friends for years, until they accidentally spend one fateful night together and end up in a flash marriage! Will Mateo confess he's been in love with Chloe for years, and pull her out of their "friend-zone"? And what will Chloe do, when she finds out Mateo is secretly a billaionire CEO?
68b92943a20880cce40ac468.title: I Flash-Married My Best Friend?!

68b9294ff4e5830a65025e3b.synopsis: In America's Favorite Ex-Husband movie, an aspiring writer’s life is turned upside down when he rescues an up-and-coming Hollywood starlet. Ten years later, Daniel’s the house husband to America’s Sweetheart, ignored and invisible to the paparazzi and his own family. When a megastar old flame comes back to seduce his wife, Daniel’s life reaches a new level of hell and he realizes he must do the unthinkable: divorce America’s Sweetheart! By the time his famous wife realizes what she’s lost, it may be too late to win him back.
68b9294ff4e5830a65025e3b.title: America's Favorite Ex-Husband

68b9295a0725da05b40b9799.synopsis: The day Ellie's IVF process is a success, she finds out her fiance and her best friend are having an affair. Devastated, she decides to raise her child alone. The doctor reveals there's been a mix up at the sperm bank - she's pregnant with the Mafia Boss' baby. Ellie has been unwillingly dragged into a mafia war of succession. In order to protect her unborn baby, she agrees to a contract marriage with the mafia boss. They never thought this would lead them to true love.
68b9295a0725da05b40b9799.title: Ruthless Mafia Daddy

68ba2ab99bb4d6451d05bac2.synopsis: Get ready for a fresh slice of Cooking My Way Back to Love! Host Laze stirs things up with Adam Daniel, taking us behind the scenes of this fiery new show. From the exciting BTS footage to Adam’s take on what makes the series special, you won’t want to miss it. Plus, keep your eyes peeled for another furry guest in this Backstage episode!
68ba2ab99bb4d6451d05bac2.title: ReelTalk EP 38-Backstage: Cooking My Way Back to Love

68babb189531500f4d055438.synopsis: After a flash marriage arranged by her late mother’s best friend, Jenny waits three years for her husband Charles, who left abroad right after the wedding. When he returns, misunderstandings, accusations, and missed chances drive them toward divorce. Just as Jenny is framed by rivals, Charles steps in to protect her, but new twists and family schemes continue to keep them apart.
68babb189531500f4d055438.title: Boss, Your Wife's a Whole Detective!

68bb61123f9c8d053b0d83bc.synopsis: In Alpha Mate Unchained movie, he killed his vicious father to save her. Now the new Alpha King must hide his fated mate and use a decoy fake Luna to keep her alive. But while he’s away battling, she’s discovered by the Fake Luna and brutally tortured. Can she survive long enough for the Alpha King’s return and vengeance?
68bb61123f9c8d053b0d83bc.title: Alpha Mate Unchained

68bf6f41e98eb0e612057b7d.synopsis: Katie Walker is the janitor’s adopted kid — bullied, humiliated, a nobody. Then the golden Maddox brothers show up looking for their long lost heiress sister: Katie! But the school’s queen bee steals her place. Now it’s Katie’s turn to level up, take back her crown, and make them all regret underestimating her.
68bf6f41e98eb0e612057b7d.title: Lost Heiress of Kingston High

68bfa02557f6da1b110fb43c.synopsis: After quelling external disturbances, the best warrior of Republic of Valoria, Zoe Miller, returns to home. However, she discovers that her daughter has been mistreated by her relatives David's family. In a fit of rage, Zoe unleashes a massacre at the banquet, accidentally revealing herself to be the legendary Secretary of Defense. Later, she learned that her adopted son Jacob had already been betrayed by enemy spy Robert, and what was even more astonishing was that Mia's father, President Louis, was also deeply involved in a power vortex. With Mia critically injured and on the verge of death, can Zoe successfully protect her daughter?
68bfa02557f6da1b110fb43c.title: Don't Mess with Supermom

68c0cabeabd4f6e6ea08fe93.synopsis: In search of the "masculine energy" she needs to balance her magical power, naive witch Astrid Hall leaves her all-female coven for a co-ed private school where sparks fly between her and blind but devastatingly handsome Nate Woodford. When she discovers the curse that robs him of his sight, they make a deal: if she cures him and returns his vision, he'll do anything she asks. But Astrid is in for the culture shock of her life when she learns "sleeping together" doesn't quite mean what she thought it did!
68c0cabeabd4f6e6ea08fe93.title: Sleep with Me, Mortal!

68c23465c69194e17d0d5f0d.synopsis: In Was the Heiress Switched at Birth movie, on the same day, two best friends give birth. But Edith, born into poverty, secretly swaps her baby with her CEO friend’s—hoping to give her daughter a life of luxury. What she doesn’t expect is that the CEO sees everything and quietly switches the babies back. Eighteen years later, just as Edith’s plan is about to succeed, she discovers the shocking truth: the daughter she’s mistreating all these years is her own.
68c23465c69194e17d0d5f0d.title: Was the Heiress Switched at Birth?

68c234702695ad507e01fc02.synopsis: In My Dear Daughter Love Me Once More movie, The male lead only has eyes for his first love and won’t even let Aria, his own daughter with his wife/the female lead, call him “Dad.” Aria waits all day for him on her birthday, only to witness him propose to his ex. At the school talent show, the mistress and her daughter bully Aria, and the husband helps them. To steal Aria’s summer camp spot, he feeds her a strawberry cake, knowing she’s allergic—she nearly dies. That’s when the female lead decides to divorce him and finally reveals her secret: she’s the daughter of a duke. She uses her true identity to fight for justice for her daughter. In the end, even when he kneels and begs Aria for forgiveness, she never calls him “Dad” again.
68c234702695ad507e01fc02.title: My Dear Daughter, Love Me Once More

68c33943850f8afb9a083c3f.synopsis: We’re thrilled to welcome Nicole Mattox back to the show, alongside first-time guest Eric Guilmette, as they sit down with host Sarah Moliski to talk about their new series Dungeons of Ecstasy. Together, they unwrap this mysterious vertical thriller that’s captivating fans. Shot at a stunning location in Italy, the show not only delivers thrills but also reveals an exciting, more sensual side of Nicole.
68c33943850f8afb9a083c3f.title: ReelTalk EP 39 - Mystery and Sensuality in Italy

68c3e89cb3a6ca84810a4cb2.synopsis: Vesper, who is determined to raise money to save her father, finds Raymond, the boss of the Hell Gang, to become his contracted lover. However, Vesper doesn't know that Raymond has been secretly in love with her for many years. How can they overcome the misunderstandings between money and love...
68c3e89cb3a6ca84810a4cb2.title: Mafia's Tender Torture

68c8fb3a7d022d88b000f0eb.synopsis: Lovestruck, Beatrice Lawson eloped with her college sweetheart Desmond Belmont and has been secretly married to him for ten years. However, when she discovers his affair with a wealthy socialite, Beatrice decides to divorce him and finally stop living in his shadow. As she begins to make a name for herself with a new apartment and new career, she meets the mysterious and attractive Damian Crowley. As the two men fight for her attention, Beatrice wonders if love is worth all the pain and sacrifice, or if she's better off fending for herself.
68c8fb3a7d022d88b000f0eb.title: Trapped in the Boss's Embrace

68c8fb62a739599c100ed1bf.synopsis: Adrian leaves his own daughter Esther in a car while he hangs out with his childhood sweetheart, Stacy and her son Lucas. Under the hot summer sun, the car overheats and shuts down. The A/C stops working and Esther starts to overheat. She's at risk of heatstroke and almost faints. Esther dials Adrian's phone to ask for help. Without listening to her, Adrian hangs up. Just before Esther's tablet runs out of battery, she calls her mother. She begs her mom to save her. However, before Esther can tell Claire her location, the tablet dies. Claire starts to desperately search for her daughter. Will Claire be able to successfully find and save her daughter before the unthinkable happens?
68c8fb62a739599c100ed1bf.title: When Love Walked Away

68c8fb89d2ab7e32980fb28b.synopsis: Ella is wolfless amongst the wolves, but at least she has her mate, Beta Noah Gravens... until she catches him cheating with her rival Ava. Shattered, Ella falls straight into the arms of Noah's brother, Liam Gravens, the newly returned Alpha of the Crescent Pack, who has loved her since childhood and knows she's his fated mate. But with jealous rivals, bitter exes, and two worlds pulling them apart, can Ella and Liam embrace the love they are destined for?
68c8fb89d2ab7e32980fb28b.title: Claimed by My Ex's Alpha Brother

68c8fb9e6073aca9ca08fa5e.synopsis: In Queen of the Court movie, after abandoning her career as a tennis star, Lily Pearson dedicated her life to helping her boyfriend Adam's tennis career. But after helping him win his own Grand Slam...the fame changed Adam for the worse. Adam's not only involved with a younger tennis star Mia Sparks, but he wants Lily to coach her as well. Will Lily accept this betrayal and love a cheating man she no longer recognizes, or will she have the courage to leave, and salvage her potential from all those years ago?
68c8fb9e6073aca9ca08fa5e.title: Queen of the Court

68cc7e93c52547cff3055e67.synopsis: The stars of Miss You After Goodbye are back and bringing the laughs on this episode of ReelTalk! Haley Lohrli talks all about her bold new role while Ben and Josh spill about their own unforgettable characters. Just when you think it can’t get any better, the trio face off in an improv game and a lightning round of ReelFast questions. Chaos, giggles, and roasts guaranteed!
68cc7e93c52547cff3055e67.title: ReelTalk EP 40-Contract Lovers & Heartbreak

68d59847cf741dba4c0649e7.synopsis: ReelTalk is hitting the streets with hot seat questions! Host Sarah Moliski and vertical star Jeff Lawless take over the Santa Monica Pier, racing to interview as many people as possible while convincing them to download the ReelShort app. From asking if you would date your professor to whether it’s a red flag to discover your boyfriend’s a werewolf, nothing is off limits. Tune in for an episode packed with laughs, competition, and fun in the sun!
68d59847cf741dba4c0649e7.title: ReelTalk EP 41-Street Interview at Santa Monica Pier

68d5a14b7ce82927ad0108bd.synopsis: Wall Street tycoon Ryan Chase is poisoned and pushed overboard by his fiancée, Mia, during a lavish yacht party. He miraculously survives—but loses his voice, his identity, and everything he once had. Left with nothing, Ryan is rescued by a kind mute woman named Sophia, who brings him back to her family's small restaurant and offers him a job. Despite constant abuse from Sophia’s spiteful stepmother Diane, Ryan and Sophia grow close and eventually fall in love. When Sophia’s father, James, falls critically ill, Ryan steps up to help the family. Meanwhile, Mia forges a marriage certificate in an attempt to steal Ryan’s multi-billion-dollar empire. Ryan’s loyal assistant, Thomas, risks everything to protect what’s left. When Diane discovers Ryan’s true identity and still refuses to help James, Ryan finally reaches out to Thomas—ready to return to the battlefield and take back everything that was his.
68d5a14b7ce82927ad0108bd.title: The Beggar King Returns

68d5a240341a3fdc3002f6a0.synopsis: In How I Made the Alpha Mine movie, Luca Conri is the wolf-less runt of the Nightreign Pack, whose bark is bigger than his bite. Tormented by his own Pack and hunted by rivals, Luca is reluctantly put under the protection of his dominant Alpha -- and older brother's best friend -- Dalton Grey. However, everything changes when the two become fated mates, a bond that violates the natural order of the Pack. As enemies close in and traditions try to tear them apart, Luca and Dalton must decide if they want to give into their lustful temptations in a forbidden romance that threatens their own lives.
68d5a240341a3fdc3002f6a0.title: How I Made the Alpha Mine
