68d5a3937492825f6c0a6f08.synopsis: America’s top billionaire, Derek Wolf, is dying and hires elite surgeon Shaun to bring a donor kidney by plane for a secret transplant. But the flight is delayed when Kim — mother of Jessica, who’s engaged to Derek’s grandson Erik — goes to the bathroom. When Shaun urges them to hurry, Jessica humiliates him. After takeoff, Kim suffers a heart attack, and Shaun saves her, breaking her ribs in the process. Ungrateful, Jessica demands Shaun apologize in a humiliating way. When he refuses, she threatens to destroy the kidney. Forced to reveal Derek’s condition, Shaun pleads, but Jessica doesn’t believe him — until she smashes the case and sees the name on it: Derek Wolf, her own fiancé’s grandfather.
68d5a3937492825f6c0a6f08.title: Countdown to Life: Rescue at 30,000 Feet

68d6d9874a593acf1d093be8.synopsis: Cain Hunter is a broken man after his wife betrays him and ruins him financially. Just as all hope is lost, Cain is suddenly brought to the mysterious Don Ludwig, who makes him an offer: pass his tests, and Cain will succeed him as the new Godfather of Bourne Syndicate.
68d6d9874a593acf1d093be8.title: Super Godfather: My Ex Begs Me on Her Knees

68dadaea23e33857e70a78f9.synopsis: Emma Parker is a new transfer to Maple Elite Academy - and she's picked a fight with The Big Four, on her very first day! Four rich heirs who rule the academy, they've decided she's public enemy number one! But maybe there's more than meets the eye. Rowan Calloway acts like a tyrant, but is he really a ruthless bully? And August Langford keeps helping her out. Have they met before? Who's Emma going to choose - her worst enemy, or her childhood friend?
68dadaea23e33857e70a78f9.title: Taming My Bullies

68debdd66704ca4a470c01cc.synopsis: Daisy and Alex share a one night stand and part ways on one fateful night -- which leaves Daisy pregnant. Alex is on his way to her when he gets into a car accident and loses his memory. 5 years later, Daisy runs into a homeless Alex, and her daughter Poppy insists he's her father. When will Daisy realize this homeless man is her baby daddy? Will the family of three work together to take revenge against scheming villains?
68debdd66704ca4a470c01cc.title: Homeless Billionaire Baby Daddy

68debeedb1751af04908a55f.synopsis: In The Hacker Heiress Strikes Back movie, in a previous life, heiress Emily was a genius in the hacker field. In a global competition, fake heiress Olivia accuses Emily of plagiarism, which totally destroys her reputation. Her family believes these false accusations and kicks Emily out of the house. In the end, she’s killed by fake heiress Olivia. In her second life, not only does Emily cut off her ties with her blind to the truth family, but she also gives Fake Heiress Olivia who was falsely accusing her of plagiarism a slap in the face.
68debeedb1751af04908a55f.title: The Hacker Heiress Strikes Back

68debf6fbf5a7addc00ff0d6.synopsis: When Snow discovers her alpha husband cheating, she offers herself as ritual sacrifice to be eternally frozen. And when she leaves, she will finally break their mate-bond, leaving ice cold regret to be his new forever mate! But what will he do to bring her back?
68debf6fbf5a7addc00ff0d6.title: Leaving My Alpha Husband in Ice Cold Regret

68df0ce15f316838990244f5.synopsis: Now introducing, ReelTalk Dates! Join The Quarterback Next Door’s Chris Quartuccio and Cayla Brady as they race through a shopping challenge, share a bite together, unwind with a romantic picnic, and top it all off with a swan boat ride, all in true Los Angeles style.
68df0ce15f316838990244f5.title: ReelTalk EP 42-Chris and Cayla Went on a Date!

68e611aaaf245aae290e73be.synopsis: I'm a disaster. One minute I'm spilling coffee on my ridiculously hot boss, Simon, the next I'm discovering I have a secret power I can't control. My world is a mess of spilled coffee and tangled feelings, and I'm caught between two unbelievably hot guys. Simon, my mysterious boss, is as alluring as he is dangerous - a vampire who promises to teach me to harness my magic. Then there's Michael, my kind and loyal best friend. But he's hiding a deadly secret: he's a hunter sworn to destroy everything Simon stands for. They both want me. And as my magic gets more powerful, so does the fire burning between us. How can I choose when they both know my darkest secrets?
68e611aaaf245aae290e73be.title: Desired by Two: the Vampire and the Hunter

68e80feb00e1875fe80e757f.synopsis: Pampered real heiress Ellie is framed and sent to juvenile detention by her family. They believe she lives comfortably, unaware that under the fake daughter's orders, Ellie suffers brutal abuse. Three years later, she is released, broken inside, but still seen as spoiled. Only when her father beats her and her prosthetic falls off do they realize the truth...
68e80feb00e1875fe80e757f.title: True Heiress Never Lies!

68e811872fbacf89a40a3d79.synopsis: Nessa, secret Wolf Queen, has her wolf sealed so that she can runaway with her fated mate, Alpha Blaze Ashclaw. But Blaze mistakes the birthmark on their son to mean Nessa cheated and makes them his slaves. Only when the life of their son is threatened, is there a chance for Blaze to realize the truth, but will it be too late then?
68e811872fbacf89a40a3d79.title: Betrayed Alpha Queen Rises from the Ashes

68e8121e74e98090fa074792.synopsis: In You Fired the Backbone of Detroit movie, Hank Walker, mechanic by day and genius auto engineer by night, is fired under new management. Betrayed, Hank is offered a dream job from rival company Mach 15. Will Hank get to build the supercar of his dreams? Or will interference from rivals old and new cost him everything?
68e8121e74e98090fa074792.title: You Fired the Backbone of Detroit

68e84ecfa89b17c90e083dcd.synopsis: Our fashionistas are back! In this episode, host Sarah Moliski teams up with stars Sarah Noelle and Maria Barseghian to tackle a style challenge inspired by some of our favorite ReelShort scenarios. With SHEIN’s different styles, they’ll put together outfits for every situation. On-screen or off. Who will slay the looks and who will improvise? Tune in to find out!
68e84ecfa89b17c90e083dcd.title: ReelTalk EP 43-We Recreated Iconic ReelShort Looks!

68e8cfc00c688dd4be068945.synopsis: The new intern, Isla, never imagined that the cold and demanding CEO Christian — who shoved her relentlessly on the tennis court during the day — was the same person who broadened her view to unknown territories at night in an exclusive BDSM club. But when the mask comes off and secretive identities assimilate into reality, is this a game she can stay afloat… or submerge deep within the shadows of desire seeking unexpected redemption? Produced by：Vantage Entertainment
68e8cfc00c688dd4be068945.title: Hold Me in the Dark

68e9aa284838ef5d700ef20a.synopsis: A college freshman comes home for her family's legendary Thanksgiving feast and starts to suspect there's something very wrong with her parents.
68e9aa284838ef5d700ef20a.title: We're Your Parents

68ec5fc14bfbf35b930548ea.synopsis: Trapped in an arranged marriage to the cold and dangerously seductive heir of the New York mafia, LUCA, 18yo sheltered mafia princess from Chicago, ARIA must decide if surrendering her body—and maybe her heart—to a man born of violence is her greatest betrayal or her only chance at survival.
68ec5fc14bfbf35b930548ea.title: Bound by Honor

68ec5fd4621a1f21220a397a.synopsis: Brie is the daughter of a servant who works for Teddy’s family. She grew up living in the household with her mother and developed mutual feelings for the young master, Teddy. Once they came of age, Teddy began pursuing Brie passionately, but Brie feels insecure because of her status as a servant’s daughter. Teddy struggles to convince her to be with him. Brie keeps trying to pull away, but through all their back-and-forth, she eventually admits how she truly feels.
68ec5fd4621a1f21220a397a.title: Tell Me Not to Love You

68ec5fe750892c571f0509ae.synopsis: For seven years, Christmas meant grief––until Raphael Stone sees a face he thought he'd never see again. Lucy, his beloved wife, is alive, but she can't move or talk anymore. Worse, she doesn't seem to remember him at all. Will true love triumph over pain and misfortune?
68ec5fe750892c571f0509ae.title: Someone Loved is Never Lost

68ec5ffa149d9ee25f0cb4c0.synopsis: At 16, Bailey's foster mother sold her eggs on the black market, leaving her infertile. Years later, working as a school janitor, she saves a little girl from a kidnapping and meets the child’s father, a secret billionaire caught in a brutal custody battle. As their unexpected flash marriage blossoms into real love, secrets, betrayals, and a vengeful ex-wife threaten to tear apart their fragile new family.
68ec5ffa149d9ee25f0cb4c0.title: Fated to Find You

68ec6010ff5e5a5c120c70fd.synopsis: In Blood & Silver: Rise of the Alpha's Rejected Mate movie, after a devastating betrayal that decimates two powerful wolf packs, young Ann Reed is forced into a mating bond with Alpha Dane Montague—her enemy, her savior, and the man who believes she’s responsible for his family's death. For three years, Dane torments her, determined never to love her. But when he finally claims her body and then shoves her aside, Ann shatters. She cuts their magical soul-bond and disappears—leaving behind only a severed ribbon, a credit card, and a secret she hasn’t even discovered yet. Years later, she returns not as Ann Reed, but as Aurora Moon, heir to a royal European pack, cloaked in wealth, power, and secrets. Her mission is clear: protect her children, reclaim her power, and avoid Dane at all costs. But when she walks back into his world, she triggers the one thing she feared most: his attention. As Dane fights the pull toward the mate he thought he hated, dark forces stir, old enemies rise, and the truth about the past—and their bond—is about to explode. Because Aurora didn’t come back to be claimed. She came back to conquer.
68ec6010ff5e5a5c120c70fd.title: Blood & Silver: Rise of the Alpha's Rejected Mate

68ec6024a7344dc50f009aff.synopsis: Uncle Jesse's smokin' hot tattoo and great technique on bed awakens Sophie Holland's fantasy in How To Break A DILF Trailer! She might be Jesse's best friend's daughter, and Jesse might have told her to date guys of her age. Still, something about Jesse lures Sophie. So, keep watching to know what lies behind their relationships!
68ec6024a7344dc50f009aff.title: How to Break a DILF

68ee05e5b7748f54600ae29f.synopsis: Reborn heiress Emily remembers everything - the false accusations, her family's betrayal, and her death at Olivia's hands. Now armed with knowledge of the past, how will she handle the fake heiress who destroyed her life? Caroline Harrington, the only daughter of a top wealthy elite family in LA, concealed her true identity and broke away from her family to marry middle-class CEO Liam Foster. Throughout their marriage, she secretly used her family's resources to support Liam's business. However, Natty Parker, the youngest daughter of the Parker family, had long harbored feelings for Liam. She conspired with Liam's mother to set a trap—engineered to make Caroline appear engaged in inappropriate physical contact with Liam's uncle, Connor, right in front of Liam. This misunderstanding led to their divorce, and Caroline was driven out of the household. Heartbroken, Caroline returned to her family, determined to take revenge against her ex-husband and his relatives. Yet, amidst her quest for vengeance, she unexpectedly developed profound feelings for Connor. Meanwhile, after discovering his mother and Natty’s plot to frame Caroline, Liam became determined to win her back. Now torn between Connor—her mature and alluring current husband—and Liam, the man she once deeply loved, Caroline faces an agonizing choice: which path should she take?
68ee05e5b7748f54600ae29f.title: Slay to Fosters: I Took His Uncle

68eeff95f696235bfd0f4e21.synopsis: Leading lady, Jess Gonzales, must whittle down 25 male suitors to four that she wants to actively date. After she makes her choice, the remaining singles she rejected have the opportunity to sabotage her dates for a cash prize!
68eeff95f696235bfd0f4e21.title: Love Under Attack

68f149fea109fbc4220912f5.synopsis: Jesse Morales is taking our vertical stars to the court! Watch as he schools them on the basics of tennis, puts them through a series of warm ups, and challenges them to a thrilling 2v2 match. In the end, Fulop Budavari, Madeleine Rocha-Barnette, and Savannah Coffee face off for a special prize. Who will come out on top?
68f149fea109fbc4220912f5.title: ReelTalk EP 44-Jesse's Tennis Bootcamp

68f1b46b9ce9d16c840c1e3f.synopsis: Ada, a math genius reclaimed by the noble Selivis family, is treated as an outsider and framed by her scheming sister. But they picked the wrong genius to cross.
68f1b46b9ce9d16c840c1e3f.title: The Genius Returns

68fa86aafdc5b2a097072ba2.synopsis: Can you tell the difference between Dominos and Pizza Hut? We put Jeff Lawless, Mariah Moss, and Eric Guilmette to the test! Watch our stars do the Blind Taste Test Challenge and see if they can guess some of our favorite snacks. From spicy noodles to sour candy, they race with their senses to come out on top! The products and brands featured in this episode are used for entertainment and reference only. All trademarks and product names belong to their respective owners.
68fa86aafdc5b2a097072ba2.title: ReelTalk EP 45-Blind Taste Test Challenge

68fad4c3ae2a8190890bbdf1.synopsis: Eliza Spencer, self-made billionaire, survives a murder attempt and wakes with amnesia. Rescued by Justin Patton, a handsome stranger in a wheelchair- she marries him unaware he's also a billionaire faking his disability. When her memory returns, she keeps her identity a secret to reclaim her company from her greedy family and protect Justin from his vicious half-brother and step-mother.
68fad4c3ae2a8190890bbdf1.title: Sweet Wild Bride of Mine

690305826deb145032038b86.synopsis: In He Said the Baby Was Too Expensive movie, heiress Iris gave up her family fortune to marry Dorian, a poor average-joe. Three years later, she's about to welcome her first child, when suddenly, her crazy control-freak mother-in-law (Tessa) insists the hospital she's staying at is too expensive. Tessa manages to convince Dorian that they should switch to a cheaper hospital. Dorian, being a spineless mama's boy, gives in to all of Tessa's demands and starts bullying Iris too. Iris fights off increasingly unreasonable demands, all while dealing with unbearable pain in her heavily pregnant belly. Just as she can't take it anymore, Iris's father finally appears, bearing gifts for his new grandchild. How will Alec defend his daughter? When will Iris give her husband and mother-in-law a slap in the face?
690305826deb145032038b86.title: He Said the Baby Was Too Expensive

6903061c4578d838e3076c28.synopsis: Med student Cora never expected to get pregnant—let alone with the baby of Damon Hawkins, the city’s most eligible billionaire bachelor... and her new visiting professor. She planned to keep the child a secret, but Damon kept pushing past her walls—until he dropped to one knee and asked her to marry him. What Cora thought would be a fleeting romance turned into a whirlwind of unexpected tenderness and indulgent love. But the closer they grow, the more dangerous secrets begin to surface. As betrayal and hidden bloodlines come to light, Cora must face the ultimate question— Can she truly find happiness... and reunite with the family she never knew she had?
6903061c4578d838e3076c28.title: Dear Professor, You Are My Baby Daddy

690306819de921f53b0046c8.synopsis: In The Christmas Switch movie, sixteen years ago, Molly has an affair with Colton, the son-in-law of the powerful Grant family. When she gets pregnant, Colton heartlessly tells her to get an abortion. Furious and heartbroken, Molly secretly swaps her newborn daughter with the baby girl born to the Grant family’s heiress, Rachel. That baby—Rachel’s real daughter—grows up as Dolores, raised in the slums. Meanwhile, Molly’s biological daughter, Sara, is brought up as the Grant family’s beloved princess. Now, both girls attend the same prestigious school. Their paths cross again. Dolores, strong and kind, catches the attention of Aaron—Rachel’s father and the Grant family patriarch. At the same time, Sara’s longtime crush, Ryan, starts falling for Dolores. Feeling threatened, Sara begins scheming against her, afraid of being replaced. As tension builds, the secret behind their true identities slowly starts to unravel...
690306819de921f53b0046c8.title: The Christmas Switch

690306d7afd90472c800cf3a.synopsis: In Step Aside I'm the King of Capital movie, for six years abroad, Cassius builds the world’s top financial empire, the Enros Group, under the name “Mr. S,” even helping the current president rise to power. When he quietly returns home to propose to his girlfriend Isabella, she dumps him, chasing wealth and claiming only the mysterious Mr. S is good enough for her. Meanwhile, a small favor lands Cassius in a sudden marriage to Freya, the beautiful CEO of Mirror Media. At Isabella’s inauguration party, she tries to kick Cassius out again and again, never guessing who he really is—until Cassius finally decides to reclaim everything he once gave her.
690306d7afd90472c800cf3a.title: Step Aside, I'm the King of Capital

6903ba9c65c6a5dc9c098489.synopsis: For this special Halloween episode, a tarot card reading with Nicole Mattox and Kirby Ellwood takes a spooky turn! Listen in on their scary stories, dating life, and what the future holds for them. Will they survive a haunting on set? Tune in to find out!
6903ba9c65c6a5dc9c098489.title: ReelTalk EP 46-Halloween Special: A Ghost on Set!

690431ebb2b880f039018f4d.synopsis: Tessa and Asher were first loves. Asher left without a word due to family reasons. Three years later, they reunite, but Tessa is now the fiancée of Asher's nephew.
690431ebb2b880f039018f4d.title: The Secret Between US

690afdf57658ff7b8c047b36.synopsis: In I Leashed A CEO movie, a drunken woman walking her dog late at night was led by the dog to a tycoon’s private car. Chasing the car, her clothes got caught and torn by the door. The two had an intimate SM encounter in the car, fully photographed by paparazzi and making gossip headlines. To calm public anger, the tycoon lied that the woman was his fiancée and searched for her using a dog leash as a clue. His stepsister faked her identity after seeing the news. The woman knew the man that night was the tycoon but dared not tell anyone, nor did she know her sister’s impersonation. She later became his personal bodyguard via an interview, and affection grew between them. Yet the stepsister kept sabotaging their relationship, causing constant conflicts. Will this scandal - triggered farce reveal the truth? Will the two lovers finally get together?
690afdf57658ff7b8c047b36.title: I Leashed A CEO!

690be20bffab2ea5a40fe66b.synopsis: Penny and Mason are childhood best friends who’ve quietly fallen in love. But after spending their first night together, Penny is diagnosed with cancer—and makes the agonizing choice to push Mason away to protect him from the pain of losing her.
690be20bffab2ea5a40fe66b.title: To My Romeo, with Love

690c09e2437f52eec40a0fac.synopsis: The mysterious secret agent Peter Rogers was awarded the National Medal of Honor by the President and had retired from the military. While dining out with his daughter Leslie, Peter is mistaken for a blind date by the beautiful CEO Sydney Greenfield, and the two unexpectedly get married. When his classmate and ex-girlfriend, who were unaware of Peter's true identity, encountered him again, they subjected him to various insults and ridicule. Upon hearing about this, Sydney publicly revealed that Peter was her husband, putting everyone to shame.
690c09e2437f52eec40a0fac.title: Daddy's Got Girls and Guns

690d4f180ea18882c301d49d.synopsis: In The Ghost of You and I movie, Lieutenant Ryan Cross is fighting on the front lines, but he doesn't tell his wife, Alice, for fear of worrying her. Tragically, Ryan is killed in action while trying to save his comrades. However, his lingering regrets cause him to transform into a ghost and return to his wife’s side. Back home, Alice, who thinks Ryan is just hiding from her, is convinced he's been cheating! Pissed, Alice decides to get back at Ryan by marrying another man. On the day of the wedding, Alice’s bridal car passes Ryan’s funeral procession.
690d4f180ea18882c301d49d.title: The Ghost of You and I

690d4f2bc93a882dd301aa1a.synopsis: Their families slaughtered each other, and they’re sworn to hate one another… but the pull between them can't be denied. Maeve, the alpha princess, enters Luperiom determined to survive the kingdom’s brutal war college. What she doesn’t expect is a fated bond with Saxon Blackmoor—the most powerful wolf there… and her enemy. Now, the one wolf she shouldn’t want might be the only one who can save her.
690d4f2bc93a882dd301aa1a.title: Bound to the Rebel Wolf

690d4f4012285b6b6f0df08a.synopsis: In Callsign Legacy movie, when lowly enlisted man Cole Summers sneaks into a Navy Flight Simulator and completes mission simulation that no one else can, the Navy realizes that he's their only hope to prevent WWIII... but first he must deal with crooked politicans, evil tech billionaires, and even his own disgraced family legacy.
690d4f4012285b6b6f0df08a.title: Callsign: Legacy

69143a1e3b4503c4ac04e8fe.synopsis: When ambitious casting assistant Cleo Marlowe risks everything to convince movie star Blake Wilder to act in her movie, she doesn’t expect him to say yes, or for the paparazzi to catch her walking out of his house. Branded as the girl who slept her way to a get ahead, Cleo becomes Hollywood’s favorite rumor. But while her reputation takes a nosedive, the notoriously cold and gruff Blake starts to show up for her in ways she never saw coming.
69143a1e3b4503c4ac04e8fe.title: How to Land a Movie Star

69163cfea0a95eb3a80f92c3.synopsis: It’s back to school for the cast of Taming My Bullies! Meg Bush, Cameron Porras, and Travis Owens face off in a series of games in this High School Challenge episode to see who really rules the school. Plus, they spill stories about flirting on set, first kisses, and even a few fights!
69163cfea0a95eb3a80f92c3.title: ReelTalk EP 48-Flirting, First Kisses, and Fighting

6916d8d9dd25ee45d80e29f7.synopsis: Diane makes a deathbed promise to her grandmother to have a baby—only to immediately uncover proof of her husband Miles' affair. Devastated, she ends their seven-year marriage. In a drunken rebound move (courtesy of her bold bestie Maggie), Diane spends a wild night with a gorgeous callboy named Eddie… but her night blindness hides a jaw-dropping truth: Eddie is actually Dominic—her and Miles'college classmate who's been secretly in love with her for years. After studying abroad, he's now returned as a ruthless billionaire… and he'll stop at nothing to win Diane back. By day, he's a powerful tycoon; by night, he voluntarily plays her devoted callboy, determined to make her fall for him.
6916d8d9dd25ee45d80e29f7.title: Fated To My Billionaire Call Boy

6916da7c686e13455b00b9b5.synopsis: After a passionate night together, Ava is shocked to discover that Edmund is the new CEO of her company—and she’s assigned as his secretary. Forced to keep their night a secret, she struggles to navigate their professional and personal boundaries. Meanwhile, her friend Chloe schemes her way into Edmund’s mansion by claiming to be the mysterious woman from that fateful night. As Chloe seduces Edmund and torments Ava, their schemes only bring Edmund and Ava closer. In a stunning twist, Ava learns she is the true heiress to a luxury hotel empire. With the truth revealed, Edmund and Ava finally claim their happily ever after.
6916da7c686e13455b00b9b5.title: Damn! The Duke Got The Wrong Girl

6916da7d686e13455b00b9b7.synopsis: Maid's Vendetta tells the story of Diana, whose perfect life was destroyed when her father had an affair, her younger brother died in a tragic accident, and her mother suffered a mental breakdown—all because of one woman. Swearing vengeance, Diana sets in motion a dangerous game of revenge. Twenty years ago, Diana lived a charmed life as the beloved heiress of a wealthy family—until her family tutor, Sophie, seduced her father and tore her world apart. Now, under the alias Raven, she infiltrates Sophie's household as a maid, determined to make her pay for ruining her family.
6916da7d686e13455b00b9b7.title: Maid's Vendetta

6916da7f686e13455b00b9b9.synopsis: Selina Murphy, a wealthy heiress, goes undercover as an intern at her fiancé's company—only to cross paths with Grace, a cunning opportunist from the wrong side of the tracks. Grace brazenly steals Selina's identity and, with the help of their coworkers, relentlessly bullies the "new girl." But Grace picked the wrong target this time. The real heiress is about to fight back.
6916da7f686e13455b00b9b9.title: Undercover Heiress

6916da80686e13455b00b9bb.synopsis: They mistook each other for the partner in the contractual marriage. After the flash marriage, they discovered that they were meant for each other.
6916da80686e13455b00b9bb.title: Flash Vows

6916da85686e13455b00b9c3.synopsis: After a one - night stand with a handsome stranger, Sarah, a young campaign intern, realized that he was her boss, Senatorial candidate Christopher. In a tough campaign, their affair would be a career - ending scandal for both of them, so she concealed her identity. But did Christopher fall in love with her or the role she was playing? Will their love story destroy them or can they survive the scandal and become a powerful couple in the political world?
6916da85686e13455b00b9c3.title: Campaigning For Love

6916da88686e13455b00b9c7.synopsis: After enduring six humiliating years of her husband Jake’s public infidelity, Anna finally snaps. She files for divorce and reignites her long-abandoned dream—reclaiming her status as a world-class pianist. Enter Ethan, her seemingly ordinary piano teaching assistant who’s actually a billionaire tycoon in disguise. With his unwavering support, Anna stages a breathtaking comeback, humiliates her ex-husband, and reclaims her glory. And as for Ethan? He gets the happy ending Jake threw away.
6916da88686e13455b00b9c7.title: Divorced Queen Returns to The Stage

6916da89686e13455b00b9c9.synopsis: Prince Philip of the young Kingdom of Lavinia went to the US to avoid being pressured into marriage. There he met and helped Anna, an American girl who had just been betrayed by her boyfriend. Philip claimed to be a royal gardener and agreed to a flash marriage with Anna. After their marriage, the two worked together to take on Anna's stepmother and stepsister, helping Anna successfully inherit her mother's company and obtain the authorization for royal portraits. In the end, Philip revealed his true identity, got his parents to accept Anna, and the two lived a happy life in California.
6916da89686e13455b00b9c9.title: Married a Gardener, Got a Prince

6916da8a686e13455b00b9cb.synopsis: Amelia, a young widow, was pregnant with the posthumous child of her late husband Daniel. She was taken back to the Tuscan estate of the ancient and powerful Di Maggio family in Italy for protection. At first, Anthony, Daniel's older brother, was hostile towards Amelia, seeing her as a threat. But through repeated conflicts and time spent together, he was deeply attracted to her resilience and sincerity. Under the pressure of family disputes and traditional responsibilities, Amelia and Anthony overcame suspicion and prejudice and gradually developed a sincere and passionate relationship. In the Tuscan sunshine and the shadow of the ancient estate, they jointly protected the unborn child and the future of the family while experiencing a new chapter of love for each other.
6916da8a686e13455b00b9cb.title: Irresistible love with my brother in law

6916da8b686e13455b00b9cd.synopsis: Evelyn, who had been severely hurt by her scumbag biological father and vicious stepmother, was saved by Francis, who had secretly loved her for years. Evelyn had plastic surgery and changed her identity. She carried out her revenge plan as Francis' sister. Even though Evelyn was focused on revenge, she couldn't help falling in love with Francis. After going through many hardships, Evelyn and Francis finally got married.
6916da8b686e13455b00b9cd.title: Secret Love With My Billionaire Revenge Partner

6916da8c686e13455b00b9cf.synopsis: Kate, an airline heiress, wanted to work as a regular flight attendant without revealing her true identity. But on her first day, Jasmine stole her identity and turned the crew against her. Meanwhile, Glen—the captain Kate was supposed to marry for business—fell for her without knowing who she really was. He even wanted to call off their arranged marriage! When Kate’s true identity was finally exposed, Jasmine got the humiliation she deserved—and Kate got her happy ending with Glen.
6916da8c686e13455b00b9cf.title: Heiress Hidden In The Clouds

6916da90686e13455b00b9d5.synopsis: In a tale of transformation and revenge, bullied high schooler Alexandra reinvents herself as "Lexi" with the help of childhood friend Dan, returning to expose her tormentors, reclaim her dignity, and find true love.
6916da90686e13455b00b9d5.title: The MVP's Plus Size Love

6916da93686e13455b00b9d9.synopsis: Against the backdrop of raging wildfires in Los Angeles, the contractual marriage between firefighter Liam and novelist Natalie is thrown into crisis due to misunderstandings, betrayal, and life-and-death trials. As the wildfires spread, Liam gradually realizes his true feelings for Natalie, while she reexamines their relationship through the pain. The two grow closer amid disaster and conspiracy, ultimately rekindling their love from the ashes.
6916da93686e13455b00b9d9.title: Wildfire Between Us

691a80c389691cf53d0e04fe.synopsis: Pregnant with Alpha Cyrus's child, the only thing that can save Ally Jones's life is the sacred fruit of the Arbor Vitae. But her true mate Cyrus only seems to care about another werewolf, Emma. As Ally's body grows weaker, will Cyrus choose her... just this once?
691a80c389691cf53d0e04fe.title: The Price of Loving You

691a80e9dd802345220ceb09.synopsis: In Operation Christmas Trap movie, six years ago, Winnie and Logan fell in love and had twin daughters. But after Selina sowed discord between them, a misunderstanding drove the couple apart. Six years later, with a little help from their twin daughters swapping places, the truth comes to light.
691a80e9dd802345220ceb09.title: Operation Christmas Trap

691a9cadc86ec5406f0bda5d.synopsis: In Too Late for Love: 15 Days After Miscarriage movie, Iris and Benjamin were once the ultimate power couple—total relationship goals for everyone, and loaded to boot. They went from college sweethearts straight to tying the knot, and he even gave her a kidney to save her life, swearing he’d love her forever. But by their third year of marriage? Benjamin was hooking up with his mistress out in the open, no shame at all. Crushed and done with his nonsense, Iris set a "15-day countdown" and quietly planned her divorce and escape. But his pathetic lies and the mistress’s bold-faced disrespect pushed her over the edge—she lost the baby. Completely broken, she finally took off, all by herself. Benjamin had no clue how much he’d hurt her until she was gone. That’s when his brutal "redemption tour" started—you know, when someone messes up bad and then begs for forgiveness, but it’s already too late. He offered a reward worldwide to find her, but Iris outsmarted him at every turn. His career and reputation? Gone in a flash. Even after he dumped the mistress, got on his knees to beg for mercy, and took a knife for Iris (ending up seriously hurt), he couldn’t melt her cold heart. In the end, he just had to watch—lonely and full of regret—as she built a new, happy life. And that’s when he finally got it: "Belated love ain’t worth squat"—affection that shows up too late? It’s totally useless.
691a9cadc86ec5406f0bda5d.title: Too Late for Love: 15 Days After Miscarriage

691d9ce58ec4a2044c092150.synopsis: On their anniversary, Tessa is finally ready to gift her boyfriend her virginity—only to discover he's already sleeping with her cousin. Meanwhile, her work life is no better, with a toxic manager who steals her ideas and makes her daily life a living hell. When she's blindsided with a terminal Leukemia diagnosis, she snaps: quits her job, dumps the cheater, and begins checking off the items on her bucket list. After a chance encounter at her lowest, captivating CEO Cassian Vaughn can't get her out of his head. Knowing she needs help, he offers her a deal: he'll fund the entirety of her last wishes if she does him the small favor of posing as....his fiancée!
691d9ce58ec4a2044c092150.title: Billionaire Completes My Bucket List

691ec6cd73a4ab3e37065193.synopsis: Mia Langford, a talented but financially struggling art student, never expected her quiet life to collide with power, desire, and betrayal. A single reckless moment in class—an impulsive gaze and a forbidden sketch—draws the attention of her professor, Wesley Winslow, a brilliant yet dangerous man whose presence alters the trajectory of her world. Before Mia can understand the shift, her manipulative stepmother arranges a sudden engagement between her and Wesley’s entitled son, Darius—an alliance designed entirely for wealth and influence. But everything changes on a fateful night when, drugged and blindfolded, Mia ends up in Wesley’s arms instead of her fiancé’s. What should have been a mistake becomes an irreversible entanglement—emotionally, physically, and morally. As their forbidden bond deepens, Mia becomes trapped between two powerful men—one who seeks to possess her and one who risks everything to protect her. Darius, driven by jealousy, control, and entitlement, escalates his obsession. He forces Mia into humiliation, threatens her reputation, and captures evidence meant to destroy her future, using blackmail and emotional warfare to keep her under his control. Meanwhile, Mia fights for dignity in a world determined to shame and silence her. Rumors spread on campus, classmates turn against her, and her image becomes a weapon used to dismantle the life she worked so hard to build. Wesley becomes her only refuge—but also her biggest contradiction: the man she should run from, and the only one she wants. Their connection grows from forbidden desire to something dangerously close to love—forcing both to confront their fears, ethics, and the power structures binding them. In a world where everything—her body, her name, her future—is being claimed by others, Mia must decide whether to surrender…or fight for her identity, her freedom, and her own voice.
691ec6cd73a4ab3e37065193.title: Creation Itself Is Love

691f7130a400c714ca0e2dfa.synopsis: Spend a day with Meg Bush as she gets red carpet ready for the International Short Drama Festival. Go behind the scenes of her glam process and catch the stunning dress reveal before she heads to the event. Stay tuned! You might spot some familiar faces along the way.
691f7130a400c714ca0e2dfa.title: ReelTalk EP 49-Red Carpet Ready with Meg

691fcad3e34279d3bf0a8e93.synopsis: In I Hate to Love My British Bad Boy movie, during her first year in high school, Hannah Morrow is losing her virginity to the powerful Jamie St. Clair in their prestigious private school’s library. Jamie breaks up with her in front of the whole school and she loses her scholarship. When the two are reunited their final year, they fake a relationship despite hating each other. But real feelings lay underneath their fake relationship. Will Hannah get back the boy who broke her heart? Or will she lose everything when their fake relationship is exposed?
691fcad3e34279d3bf0a8e93.title: I Hate to Love My British Bad Boy

692102b1d1572c3b2c014967.synopsis: Jax Carter, the bastard son of a disgraced housekeeper and a fight gym patriarch, secretly trains under three outlaw coaches. When he's entered into The Crucible, an elite, once-in-a-generation MMA proving ground, he must carry the weight of betrayal, shame, and thousands of pounds of hidden resistance training. As rivals rise and family tries to crush him, Jax must prove once and for all: he wasn’t born to break... he was built to fight.
692102b1d1572c3b2c014967.title: The Knockout King

6923bbb1bc38afa96f0f43c5.synopsis: In Once Upon A Breakup movie, after being abandoned on her birthday by her college boyfriend, Mia impulsively proposes to Carson, the charming but dangerous leader of the Moretti crime family. Though their relationship begins as a rash escape, it quickly turns into something real. But Mia’s ex refuses to let go. Obsessed, jealous, and spiraling out of control, he’ll stop at nothing to win her back, even if it means destroying the new life Mia’s trying to build with Carson. However, Mia isn’t looking back. She's thriving with Carson by her side and ready to show Aiden exactly what he threw away.
6923bbb1bc38afa96f0f43c5.title: Once Upon A Breakup

6923bbc3a1220fce8708b39f.synopsis: After being dumped by her ex, Nola unexpectedly finds herself in the arms of Ryan Laren—her ex’s future father-in-law, a man of immense wealth and power. Learning of her complicated bond with his daughter, Ryan tries to stay away. But Nola keeps breaking his rules, drawing him deeper into a dangerous attraction.
6923bbc3a1220fce8708b39f.title: Seducing Mr. Larsen

6923bbd68bc07cff53085ab4.synopsis: Carl Oliver, the legendary sharpshooter known as the King of Guns, broke the world record for longest confirmed kill then vanished from the public eye. He hid his identity, working as maintenance at a shooting range. He endures humiliation from the dismissive shooting club captain, Albert, unaware of his true identity. The shooting range is facing a hostile takeover. In order to protect Jane, the owner, and her daughter Rebecca, Carl steps up and shows his legendary shooting skills, drawing attention to his mysterious identity...
6923bbd68bc07cff53085ab4.title: American Sniper: The Last Round

6923bcc2a37f3ee825092cd5.synopsis: A deranged female flight instructor obsesses over her handsome student, using her piloting skills to destroy the people in his life and seduce him into loving her.
6923bcc2a37f3ee825092cd5.title: Deadly Mile High Club

6923c6289c16eb72620ef564.synopsis: Law student Lily Wingrove has run out of options. Her mother is dying, and the bills keep coming. Desperate, she signs a contract with young mafia boss Eric Moretti, offering her body in exchange for money. Eric moves fast. Money appears. Threats disappear. He is ruthless but magnetic, and every time he saves her, his power pulls her closer. Then he places her in the world of his sworn rival, star prosecutor Daniel Hayes. To the city, Daniel is justice itself. To Lily, he is patient, kind, and everything Eric is not. He protects her with law instead of fear. His love feels pure, even healing. But something beneath his perfection feels wrong. He knows too much, reacts too quickly, and his care sometimes feels like control. Now two men fight for her in opposite ways: one through dominance, the other through devotion. As her mother’s time runs out, Lily must decide who to trust before both the devil’s power and the angel’s secret destroy her.
6923c6289c16eb72620ef564.title: Mafia Boss Owns My Body

6924200211e56d83a80583cc.synopsis: In The One I Never Forget movie, five years ago, a tragedy that claimed the lives of loved ones from both sides forced Sofia​ and Justin​ apart, a separation further complicated by Doris's​ lies, Sofia's miscarriage, and Justin's severe injury. Five years later, Sofia returns to Los Angeles as a renowned journalist, while Justin has become a baseball superstar. Their reunion is fraught with conflict, fueled by misunderstandings (Sofia falsely claims to be married; Justin mistakenly believes Sofia left him for money), obstructions (continued opposition from Doris and schemes by Esther), and danger (Esther's plot to commit murder). Ultimately, Justin uncovers the whole truth about the past, Doris confesses her wrongdoing, and Esther is exposed for her crimes and arrested. Transcending their pain, Sofia and Justin achieve dual fulfillment in their careers (Sofia completes her major report; Justin wins a championship) and in love. Their story highlights how honesty and forgiveness can allow love to be reborn from the ruins of lies and violence.
6924200211e56d83a80583cc.title: The One I Never Forget

6927a3f9e7f4adf8670b0251.synopsis: We’re giving thanks with the dynamic duo, Sarah Moliski and Aaron Oberst! Join them as they catch up over a delicious Thanksgiving dinner, share what they’re grateful for, and reminisce about their time working together on Her Double, His Trouble. They even unwrap some special gifts from Laifen. Tune in. You might just win 100 coins to watch even more on the ReelShort app!
6927a3f9e7f4adf8670b0251.title: ReelTalk EP 50-Happy Reelsgiving!

6927f33413f454d0280ff0d7.synopsis: Hannah, a Farm-raised Ballerina, uses a contract engagement to secure her place in the prestigious Hargrove Ballet Company, but she's interrupted by Jack, a handsome assassin, who coerces her to help him. He's a dangerous obstacle, until Hannah discovers he could actually give her everything. As she finally surrenders, he pulls away... But when they face death together, they realize, life's too short to waste true love.
6927f33413f454d0280ff0d7.title: Love Is a Dangerous Dance

6927f357e88b7499a30d49ea.synopsis: In The Prince's First Love movie, Lucas never expected to kiss a prince—least of all in front of the entire school. What began as a feud with Prince Nicholas turned into a forced friendship, and that into something far more complicated. Every glance, every brush of hands, pulls them closer... but Nicholas is torn between his royal duty and his growing feelings for the boy he once called an enemy. Neither dares to speak the truth—until the moment it can’t be hidden.
6927f357e88b7499a30d49ea.title: The Prince's First Love

6927f387c28b39cdd0021af3.synopsis: Nicole loses everything the night she’s framed—her freedom, her child, and the love of her life. Seven years later, she returns as a nanny in the very house that once destroyed her. Ethan, her ex-fiancé, still haunted by the woman he once loved, starts to feel something for the new nanny—without knowing it’s her. Secrets simmer, memories resurface, and Lila, their stolen daughter, is the unexpected thread pulling them back together. He doesn’t remember her. But his heart never forgets.
6927f387c28b39cdd0021af3.title: Daddy Forgot, but Mommy Remembers

6930f3b01cc54679ca078825.synopsis: In Rented a Billionaire Husband for Christmas movie, seven years ago, they shared one night. Now they’re fake-married—with a child he doesn’t know is his.
6930f3b01cc54679ca078825.title: Rented a Billionaire Husband for Christmas

6931fdc264bfdd136302d647.synopsis: Who doesn’t love a little nostalgia? Watch as our vertical stars relive their favorite ReelTalk moments with ReelTalk OG Rachel Bencosme. Luke Charles Stafford, Richard Sharrah, Autumn Noel, and Haley Lohrli get heartfelt, hilarious, and everything in between.
6931fdc264bfdd136302d647.title: ReelTalk EP 51-Flashback Friday

69362dca0f1ca1629406d3d7.synopsis: "Retired special forces soldier Cole Slade—codename “Reaper”—goes into hiding as a security guard to fulfill his fallen comrade Alexander’s last wish: protect his younger sister, Victoria. On Victoria’s wedding day, the groom runs away, the guests vanish, and a carefully planned corporate conspiracy comes to light. When the proud Victoria forces Cole into a fake marriage, they’re pushed into an uneasy alliance against their sworn enemy, Tristan—an ambitious man set on taking over the Kingsley family’s tech empire. As Cole’s lethal battlefield instincts resurface—from a bloody fight in the church to displays of overwhelming power at high-society banquets—they face not only Tristan’s deadly retaliation, but also the shocking truth that Victoria’s uncle, Conrad, is the mastermind. When a bloodstained dog tag reveals what really happened to Alexander, Cole must use the most extreme measures to protect this marriage—born from a lie—through both corporate warfare and gunfire."
69362dca0f1ca1629406d3d7.title: Understated Guardian King

69362e9306cdcec2b60d306a.synopsis: In Ex-Husband Roll Out of My Life movie, Trina, a housewife betrayed by her husband and humiliated by her entire family, finally finds the strength to leave a loveless home. Thus begins her countdown to freedom.
69362e9306cdcec2b60d306a.title: Ex-Husband Roll Out of My Life

6937760c0dbba5e2ee0f4a43.synopsis: Natalie's conniving grandmother and sister marry her off to a rural farmer, Rhett. He's a single father, looking after a mute daughter, Ellie. Natalie's presence isn't taken kindly, as she is shunned by Ellie and the woman next door. Over time, she learns the woman next door is actually abusing Ellie. She develops a bond with Ellie, which deepens when Ellie speaks up for the first time to save her. But as Natalie starts settling in, new troubles arise. Ellie is bullied at school, and Natalie gets tangled in conflicts involving both her old and new families. She vows to protect the hard-won love and family she's built.
6937760c0dbba5e2ee0f4a43.title: In Love with a Single Farmer-Daddy

69377d8c7fce15132e076e63.synopsis: In Monster in His Eyes movie, based on the book MONSTER IN HIS EYES by J.M. Darhower! Karissa Reed, 19, is trapped by her controlling mother and abusive ex, Tommy, but her world shifts when Naz Conti, a dangerous ex-con mafia boss, rescues her. Drawn to his danger, she challenges him to let her be his, with every kiss and daring move, risking everything for desire, curiosity, and forbidden love. Can she survive his world, and dare to love the man everyone warns her to fear?
69377d8c7fce15132e076e63.title: Monster in His Eyes

693a26b23f605a1a2301c3b8.synopsis: ReelTalk Backstage is back and reloaded for the action-packed new series American Sniper: The Last Round. Join Marc Herrmann, Jesse Morales, and Aaron Russell as they take you behind the scenes for explosive moments you won’t find anywhere else. Find out their super powers and maybe even some first impressions of each other!
693a26b23f605a1a2301c3b8.title: ReelTalk EP 52 -Backstage: American Sniper: The Last Round

693b8e4d64a3329d740a60c9.synopsis: Driven to despair after losing both her husband and baby, Vivienne only lives for one thing - REVENGE! But simple murder doesn't torture enough. Why not steal her husband and make her watch!
693b8e4d64a3329d740a60c9.title: Your Husband Is Mine

693b8e7d692897a1a4073d7c.synopsis: In Seduction Cove movie, Seduction Cove is a show designed to test couple's loyalties with hot baddies, cash prizes and insane challenges. After Hayley's cheating ex runs off with her sister, she's reunited with Adam, a man who saved her from a near death experience. Will the reunited soulmates survive Seduction Cove?
693b8e7d692897a1a4073d7c.title: Seduction Cove

693b8f146a2054699d00944d.synopsis: In Reborn for the Lycan King movie, reborn after her stepsister’s deadly betrayal, Diana shoots an arrow to choose her mate. It lands on Alexander, the hidden Lycan King. But with Ivy still plotting and her bond with Alex unclear, Diana must fight to change her fate—before it’s too late.
693b8f146a2054699d00944d.title: Reborn for the Lycan King

69411cf6384e5d3fe50c93de.synopsis: Student Body President Kaden Russell just made an enemy of Star Quarterback Donovan Miller. When the two clash over school activity funds, Donovan goes too far with a cruel remark. As revenge, Kaden dyes the football uniforms rainbow. But when the prank gets Donovan injured during a game, Kaden is sentenced to serve as Donovan’s “waterboy”. The forced proximity stirs up feelings Donovan never expected, and when their rivalry turns romantic, both boys have to decide what they’re willing to risk for love.
69411cf6384e5d3fe50c93de.title: Waterboy

69426f2c776d01014f056a25.synopsis: In Golden Feather: Temptation Game movie, at the Golden Feather Academy, after being rejected, Queen Celine offers her playboy stepbrother Leo a night with her if he can seduce and destroy the boy who refused her—the president's son, Logic. But when Leo's fake pursuit turns real, Celine loses control of Leo forever...
69426f2c776d01014f056a25.title: Golden Feather: Temptation Game

69449f2795b99db0dd02c040.synopsis: Happy Holidays, Hollywood! The first annual ReelShort holiday shoot is here. Your favorite lead stars come together to reflect on their journeys in verticals, share dream collaborations, and spread festive cheer in this must-watch holiday special.
69449f2795b99db0dd02c040.title: ReelTalk EP 53-Happy Holidays, Hollywood

694518d010b7c5bc87065fff.synopsis: Legendary gambler Henry Smith is framed by his nemesis and fellow gambler, Lip Orville, and forced into hiding after Lip kills his brother, David. On the run and out of options, he’s saved by Sophia and assumes a new identity——Carl, a janitor at an underground casino (a speakeasy officially) in Chicago. But when Lip returns, now allied with the mafia, and the infamous mob boss, Don Bazzini, Carl is dragged back into the dangerous world of gambling. At the same time, Carl/Henry begins plotting his revenge.
694518d010b7c5bc87065fff.title: The Last Gambling God

6945b6f11429aa92890398aa.synopsis: There was a time when Nina believed her happiest moment would be walking down the aisle with Evan, her college sweetheart. But betrayal shattered that dream, teaching her that true love and forever were rare illusions. After their divorce, she vowed never to give her heart away again. Then Damon—Evan’s youngest uncle—stormed into her life, refusing to let her run. She tries to keep her distance, not wanting ties with her ex’s family, but Damon’s relentless pursuit leaves her breathless.
6945b6f11429aa92890398aa.title: Swapped My Ex for His Billionaire Uncle

694a7051cfaa1f0d7e00d662.synopsis: In CEO and the Country Girl movie, when her sister betrays her and a ruthless CEO targets her family farm, fiery small-town cowgirl Avery Rogers clashes—and sparks—with Tyler Sinclair, the corporate heir sent to take her land. But as lust and loyalty collide, a small-town cookout—Tyler’s bold bid to save Avery and her father’s legacy—turns enemies into something dangerously close to lovers, and turning their worlds upside down.
694a7051cfaa1f0d7e00d662.title: CEO and the Country Girl

694aea21e7b4a4d2ab0d7d5f.synopsis: In The Words movie, based on the novel by Ashley Jade. 4 years ago, rocker bad-boy Phoenix broke nerdy good-girl Lennon's heart and stole her song to escape his abusive father. Now he's a famous rockstar, spiraling into drugs and alcohol, she's hired to keep him sober for 8 weeks on tour. Can Lennon and Phoenix heal old wounds, or will their past stand in the way of their second chance at love?
694aea21e7b4a4d2ab0d7d5f.title: The Words

694b2440aef92798df032b95.synopsis: In My Sister is The Warlord Queen movie, abandoned by their parents, the Blackwood sisters, Catherine and Grace, grew up with only each other to rely on. As adults, both built successful lives. But at Grace’s engagement party, Catherine shows up straight from an undercover mission, still dressed as a janitor, and becomes the target of ridicule from Grace's in-laws and former classmates. When her sister is betrayed and humiliated by her fiancé, Catherine reveals her true identity as the Warlord Queen, and makes everyone regret underestimating them.
694b2440aef92798df032b95.title: My Sister Is the Warlord Queen

694c357b064f1471500ea852.synopsis: After witnessing her mother's murder at the hands of gods, Aria believes one thing: gods are heartless. One day she kills a mysterious golden lamb to feed her starving family—unaware that it's a sacred creature of Olympus. She comes face-to-face with her mother's killer, the Immortal Champion of Olympus - Kairos, who brings her back to Olympus to face justice. Through her journey, she learns of her real identity, the strength that she holds, and the heartbreaking truth behind Kairos' violent history. Together, they face danger, overcome trauma, and learn to accept their Fates that bind them together for eternity.
694c357b064f1471500ea852.title: The Daughter of Zeus

694ca70f258abb75d706192c.synopsis: The Next ReelStar is a reality competition series where men representing states across the country compete for a breakout lead role at ReelShort, with fans having the power to decide the winner. Under the mentorship of judges Jesse Morales and Nicole Mattox, contestants join Team Jesse or Team Nicole, each striving to develop their star quality. Through a series of high-stakes challenges, they’ll showcase their talent to impress a powerhouse panel of vertical industry professionals. For the first time in a vertical unscripted series, fans will have the power to vote in the finale, deciding which finalist is crowned The Next ReelStar.
694ca70f258abb75d706192c.title: The Next ReelStar

6952227b0e44c1fbe20f2d4c.synopsis: He’s her Hot Boss. She’s his employee. But when she sends him a pic of her boobs by mistake, desire, scandal, and secrets turn the office–and her heart–upside down.
6952227b0e44c1fbe20f2d4c.title: Help! My Hot Boss Has My Nudes!

69533f4e68989593f20bdcef.synopsis: In the movie Wrong, based on the novel by Jana Aston, Sophie Tisdale has a foolproof plan to lose her virginity before senior year ends...until someone informs her that her partner-to-be has a bet on whether he can film taking her v-card. That someone being Luke, her gorgeous coffee shop regular....slash her new pelvic examiner. How wrong is it to have a thing for your campus gynecologist...and why doesn't Sophie really seem to care?
69533f4e68989593f20bdcef.title: Wrong

69533fa40d738245c80f63ab.synopsis: Reborn after Felicia’s past-life bullying—where her identity was stolen and it ultimately led to her death—Arya is determined to claim her rightful place as a mafia heiress. She sets out to outwit and humiliate Felicia at every opportunity, protect her friends, move deftly under the radar while unleashing her past-life combat skills, when everyone gonna realize she is the real mafia heiress？
69533fa40d738245c80f63ab.title: Out of My Way! The Reborn Mafia Queen Is Here

6954398642e82a4d030a27da.synopsis: ReelTalk’s 2025 Year in Review highlights everything our vertical stars loved, learned, and lived for this year. This New Year’s special brings us together to relive the memorable moments of 2025 and set our intentions for 2026. Come celebrate and tune in!
6954398642e82a4d030a27da.title: ReelTalk EP 55-2025 Year in Review

6959ff61906534418c0d2861.synopsis: In Nanny to My Hot Bully movie, Abbi is Felix's rival... and nanny. Things take a complicated turn when she moves into his house to care for him and his sister and Felix and Abbi realize their feelings for each other. Can Abbi hide her feelings for Felix to keep her nannying job?
6959ff61906534418c0d2861.title: Nanny to My Hot Bully

695f17baf52a835e5306ca5c.synopsis: Elena is chair of the Cooper Group. She handed the company over to her husband, Dalton. Elena returns to board of directors after a 5-year absence, but no one at the company recognizes her anymore. Elena is met with a workplace full of gossip, bullying, and rumors. Many speculate that "Dalton's wife" is some old hag. Flora, Dalton's secretary, has repeatedly, unsuccessfully tried to seduce him. One day, Flora sees Dalton and Elena sharing affection, and believes Elena to be his mistress. Then, she finds out Elana is pregnant. Wanting to be Dalton's mistress herself, Flora sets her sights on tormenting Elena, and forcing her out of the picture.
695f17baf52a835e5306ca5c.title: Now You Know Who I Am

69605a89690575aa7b0f7ba4.synopsis: We’re starting off our first episode of the new year with James Marchioni from Bastard King of the Cage! He gets real about training for the role and accidentally getting injured on set during a stunt scene. Sarah and James also talk about the key to achieving your fitness goals this year and what to be grateful for. Tune in for an episode that will inspire you to start the year strong!
69605a89690575aa7b0f7ba4.title: ReelTalk EP 56-Workout Routines and Getting Punched?!

69607a5875040ae49106f808.synopsis: In Love in the Ashes of us movie, Nina and Easton have been in love for ten years. She stands by him through everything, from his days as an unknown student to becoming a billionaire. But just as Easton reaches the height of his success, Nina catches him getting too close with his business partner, Candice. With Candice stirring the pot, Nina finally gives up on him completely. One day, the three of them board the same flight. Mid-air, the plane experiences a sudden emergency. During the crash landing, Easton chooses to protect Candice—leaving Nina, who is pregnant with twins, in critical danger...
69607a5875040ae49106f808.title: Love in the Ashes of us

69607a80f63b8b86be040acb.synopsis: Lila is five when her uncle Harold and aunt Karen abandon her. Jonathan, a kind billionaire, finds her and takes her home. He adopts her, and from that day, the house feels brighter. Lila brings luck and warmth. Noah, Jonathan’s son, has not spoken for a long time; with Lila by his side, he finally finds his voice. At an auction, she helps Jonathan win a hidden treasure chest. She even “talks” with the family dog and follows the hint to help Noah find his missing violin. When danger rises, Lila “forces” Harold and the schemer Vivienne to tell the truth. The lies fall apart. She helps the family get out of harm’s way, exposes the schemes, and leaves Harold, Karen, and Vivienne with nowhere to hide.
69607a80f63b8b86be040acb.title: Daddy I'm Your Lucky Star!

69607aa7d673539a86043fab.synopsis: In Sisterhood of Lies Pledge for Revenge movie, after Ashlyn dies in a sorority hazing “accident,” her identical twin sister June takes her place to get revenge on the real killers — Ashlyn’s back-stabbing bestie and her frat-bro boyfriend.
69607aa7d673539a86043fab.title: Sisterhood of Lies: Pledge for Revenge

69685874f215dd101d0d5356.synopsis: For sixteen years, Angelica has lived with a guilt she never deserved — her mother died giving birth to her. Neglected by her father, Martin, and despised by her brother, Christopher, she holds on to the only warmth he ever showed her. But when their cousin Madison moves in, even Christopher turns on her, wishing she were the one who had died. And in a way, he gets his wish when Angelica is diagnosed with cancer. But after her death, it’s Christopher’s world that begins to fall apart.
69685874f215dd101d0d5356.title: Dear Brother, You Loved Me Too Late

6968674a59095c2b4e0e5bd7.synopsis: In Ms. CEO's Baby Daddy Is the Merchant of Death movie, Connor Reed, the most powerful arms dealer in the world, saves a Charlotte Hayes and spends the night with her while he is undercover. Four years later, while still hiding, Charlotte shows up... with their child. Now Connor must keep both of them safe... without revealing his true identity.
6968674a59095c2b4e0e5bd7.title: Ms. CEO's Baby Daddy Is the Merchant of Death

69698269996bd9e2d300c73a.synopsis: 18-year-old Blair Beaumont is the genius heiress of the richest family in the U.S. After spending three years preparing to take over the family business, she's ready to return home and announce herself the next successor. But Blair's world shatters once she sees her mother, once beloved in the household, now being beaten and branded a 'homewrecker' by Blair's three older brothers. Even her father has turned against her, replacing his wife with the family maid as 'Mrs. Beaumont.' What happened during Blair's absence? Can she expose the truth behind her family's betrayal and get justice for her mother?
69698269996bd9e2d300c73a.title: The Heiress Is Back, Three Brothers on Their Knees

6969829c8497ab0bef0e7956.synopsis: In The Vampire Prince's Bride movie, Scarlett was a lonely orphan, living in the streets when the Vampire Lord Sean saved her. Moved to pity, Sean took her home as his Thrall and lover, swearing a Blood Oath and promising to keep her safe. Their happy, loving days came to an end when the sexy, dangerous human girl Chelsea swooped in, seducing Sean away. Not only did Sean Turn Chelsea into a vampire, he let Chelsea drink from Scarlett as well. Obsessed with his new lover, Sean missed the night of their Blood Oath, leaving Scarlett to die. Humiliated and hurt, Scarlett finally chooses to live for herself, risking her life to leave Sean behind and sever their bond as Thrall and Master. As her life hangs in the balance, Vampire Prince Alder suddenly appears to save her. Grateful and intimidated by his kindness, Scarlett doesn't realize her new prince charming is someone she's helped before.
6969829c8497ab0bef0e7956.title: The Vampire Prince's Bride

696983a516ec5a60360f382e.synopsis: The Next ReelStar Reunion is bringing the contestants together to catch up with Samantha Drews. They reveal what really went down on set, discuss behind the scenes drama, and share funny memories. The contestants also tell you why they deserve your vote. Who are you rooting for? Let us know in the comments!
696983a516ec5a60360f382e.title: ReelTalk EP 57-The Next ReelStar Reunion

6969ec89b489868c71008815.synopsis: In The Billionaire's Fake Wife movie, when an explosion destroys Dr. Jen Connor’s lab, billionaire heir Roman Johnson rescues her and her comatose sister. Jen offers Roman one impossible deal: she'll pose as his sweet, old-fashioned fiancée for one weekend, so his cold, powerful father may restore the foundation funding she desperately needs. But inside the lavish Johnson estate, Jen faces ruthless tests from staff, family and Roman’s venomous ex-fiancée Kim, who begins to suspect the truth. As romantic tension builds between Jen and Roman, so does the risk of discovery. What starts as a lie becomes dangerously close to real love, just as Kim uncovers the secret Jen hoped would stay buried.
6969ec89b489868c71008815.title: The Billionaire's Fake Wife

69701887c4f8492dc30528bf.synopsis: Olivia Beckett’s perfect life is unraveling—her family’s broke, college is slipping away, and her high school sweetheart has turned violent. Enter Sebastian “Bash” McDaniels, a rising boxer working nights at a bar to escape his past. When he rescues Olivia from her ex, their connection sparks, but as danger closes in, Bash must choose between his dreams and saving the girl who could break him.
69701887c4f8492dc30528bf.title: Fix You

6972b1a71dbf9b15000e45d0.synopsis: Noah Fearnley gets real as he opens up about his struggles as an actor and the things that matter most to him. Joined by his good friend and host, Sarah Moliski, the two relive hilarious memories and play a round of hot seat questions that prove they’re definitely not strangers. Expect honesty, laughs, and all things Noah in this heartwarming episode.
6972b1a71dbf9b15000e45d0.title: ReelTalk EP 58-Noah Fearnley Opens Up About Who He Really Is

6972c116134e8c31690e1c3d.synopsis: In The Hitwoman movie, Madeline Archer, assassin, doesn't want bloodshed—but if she stops killing, her little sister dies. When Maddie is forced to take a contract on Hayden Kent, she runs into two problems. One, he's the District Attorney. And two–he was her first and only love. And he wants her back.
6972c116134e8c31690e1c3d.title: The Hitwoman

6972cc1f658e4f63f202b994.synopsis: In Their Brother Lost in Space movie, Timothy, adopted by the wealthy Snyder family, grows up devoted to his three older sisters — until the day their biological son, Matthew, returns and turns them against him with lies and manipulation. Cast out and blamed for things he never did, Timothy still repays their kindness: he saves them, sacrifices for them, and even secretly volunteers for Project Hail Mary, a mission to save humanity by sending one person with a rare gene into find a new planet. Only after he's gone, do the Snyders discover the truth about Matthew's schemes and Timothy's sacrifices. Thirty years later, Timothy succeeds on Planet Artemis, honored as a hero while his grieving family lives with the cost of their betrayal.
6972cc1f658e4f63f202b994.title: Their Brother Lost in Space

69770e81a4e43888c903e8a4.synopsis: Lila Cobb once saved Alexander Vaughn, the hottest hockey player. One night of passion between them left her unexpectedly pregnant. Eight months later, Lila was cast out of her family and gave birth to a premature baby boy. Struggling to pay the hospital bills, she worked herself to the bone. Meanwhile, Alexander has been searching for Lila all along, determined to give her and their child all the love he has. But will he be able to find them before it’s too late?
69770e81a4e43888c903e8a4.title: Puck Me Baby One More Time

69770f5f0575988220032621.synopsis: In Backstage Romance with the Popstar movie, Rockstar Dexter Hayes thinks he found his next hit when he dumps his loyal assistant Casey for rising star Scarlett Hart. What he doesn’t know is that Casey is living a double life as Echo, the mysterious super-producer who built his career and secretly owns his label. As the truth unravels, can Dexter and Casey can find their way back to the music, and to each other?
69770f5f0575988220032621.title: Backstage Romance with the Popstar

69770f8ddeaf17de7608b2e0.synopsis: She’s a stripper trying to escape her past and survive. He’s the billionaire who never forgot her. She never thought she’d see him again after high school—until he walks into her club and proposes. Now she must hide their marriage from everyone who could destroy them both… and find out if he truly loves her, or just loves owning her.
69770f8ddeaf17de7608b2e0.title: A Vegas Happily Ever After

697b1b1c3ff58feee100e247.synopsis: Reeling from her husband’s infidelity, Kate seeks solace in what she thinks is a counseling session, only to end up in a passionate night of mistaken identity with Chris, a captivating young painter. But morning brings a scandalous revelation: not only is her new lover the elusive art prodigy CH Skywalker, he is also the son of her best friend, Linda. As a vengeful ex-husband and jealous rivals conspire to expose their secret, Kate finds herself trapped in a web of forbidden desire and betrayal.
697b1b1c3ff58feee100e247.title: In Love With My Bestie's Son

697b247d72205da95501bcf1.synopsis: In Kissed by Claw and Fang movie, Ivy, a human teenage girl, suddenly finds herself homeless after her family goes bankrupt. She's forced to live in her car-- a shameful secret she needs to hide from the vicious bullies at her elite private highschool. One day, she discovers that she's the mate of both Sebasian, the werewolf heir, and Zane, the vampire prince. These two supernaturally handsome boys have opposite personalities: one as passionate as fire, and the latter as cold as ice. Which one is her true love? Ivy later discovers that there's more to her real identity than she thought. It's a secret that could destroy everything.
697b247d72205da95501bcf1.title: Kissed by Claw and Fang

697b24bc7b22e7c7a60b80c7.synopsis: Christy Lane, famous violinist, is forced to betray the love of her life. Pregnant and destitute, an illness slowly robs her of her ability to perform. All she has left now is an instrument she can no longer play--and a seven year old daughter, determined to bring Daddy back.
697b24bc7b22e7c7a60b80c7.title: When Love's Sorrow Plays Again

697b24d9f7ba087a7d0356e6.synopsis: In In the Palm of His Hand movie, College senior Shelby Yates accidentally saves the life of billionaire ex-mafia CEO Matteo Franconi. He immediately falls in love with her and pressures her to marry him. Is he as dangerous and cruel as he seems? Or is there a soul inside the man worthy of her love?
697b24d9f7ba087a7d0356e6.title: In the Palm of His Hand

697b24f847c106823209fc33.synopsis: The richest man in the world's missing one last thing — his childhood sweetheart. He's determined to marry her, but never realizes she's right beside him! He searches everywhere for the girl who captured her heart. When will he realize he's already married to his Mrs. Right?
697b24f847c106823209fc33.title: Find Your Way Back to Me, My Childhood Sweetheart

697b266242ad1e259f0e16db.synopsis: In Tutoring My Rival Boy movie, Life isn't easy for Chris Blanning, valedictorian at a snobby private school. It's hard enough dealing with bullies already, but when his scholarship isn't enough to cover tuition, he's got to tutor his worst enemy — Lucien Alaric, the spoiled bad boy he just saw trying to seduce their teacher into changing his grades! Even worse, Lucien's figured out his deepest, dirtiest secret in return. All he can do is keep his friends close, and enemies closer — but maybe Chris is getting a little too close...
697b266242ad1e259f0e16db.title: Tutoring my Rival Boy

697c01ec6c9010b34703bca7.synopsis: Luke Charles Stafford invites us to the gym for an up-close look at his workout routine. Ever wondered the secrets to building an alpha body or how much training it takes to play the dreamy lead? Get ready to break a sweat and tune in for an episode that’ll have you moving!
697c01ec6c9010b34703bca7.title: ReelTalk EP 59-Luke Spills His Workout Secrets

697c2095df5bfc16ff08c8aa.synopsis: In Mafia Mamma's Hot Lover movie, betrayed housewife Maria’s life is upended when she unexpectedly inherits a vast mafia empire at her grandfather’s funeral, transforming from a dismissed “middle-aged housewife” into the “Godmother” of the St. Clair crime family. As she navigates her new role—seeking peace in a world of violence—she rekindles a forbidden love with Richard, her childhood crush and the family’s trusted advisor. But Richard is secretly the long-lost heir of their greatest rival, torn between blood and loyalty. Forced to publicly oppose each other while secretly allying, they must survive assassinations, family treachery, and their own hearts to expose the true mastermind behind the conflict, end the bloody feud, and claim both power and love.
697c2095df5bfc16ff08c8aa.title: Mafia Mamma's Hot Lover

698544a5524bab6f6f03e13c.synopsis: Ever wondered what it’s like to spend a day on set with a vertical actor? Savannah Coffee and Blake Lewis take us behind the scenes of their morning routines, sharing their favorite Laifen products that help them get ready for a long day on set. Get the inside scoop on all the glam in this week’s episode of ReelTalk.
698544a5524bab6f6f03e13c.title: ReelTalk EP 60-Spend a Day with Me on Set

698e68c49622da8bce0300d2.synopsis: Take a romantic long walk on the beach in this ReelTalk Valentine’s Day special! Jesse Morales and Seth Edeen open up about their dating styles and it just might make you fall head over heels all over again.
698e68c49622da8bce0300d2.title: ReelTalk EP 61-Beachside Valentine's

699480c623c5511b8f0cf7f4.synopsis: By day, Brooklyn is a broke college student from the trailer park. But online, she’s Echo—a fearless gamer gunning for the $50,000 Blackgrove Reign tournament prize, her one shot at freedom. To win, she has to dethrone Thorne, the reigning champion. What she doesn’t know? Thorne is really Ethan—the hot, cocky frat king who also happens to be her TA… and her best friend’s older brother. After they butt heads in real life, Ethan discovers Brooklyn is Echo and enters the game to toy with her—only to find himself drawn to her skill, fire, and spirit. Online, they become unstoppable partners. Offline, they’re bitter rivals. When will Brooklyn realize Ethan is Thorne, and can these sworn enemies stop fighting long enough to see they’re perfect for each other?
699480c623c5511b8f0cf7f4.title: Outplayed

6994c7def370c522ef066652.synopsis: In The Billionaire and the Baby Trap movie, to get out of her loveless marriage, Elara needs to get pregnant, but her husband refuses to touch her. One fateful night, she finds herself in Cole's arms, not knowing he's a secret billionaire CEO -- and her husband's uncle. When will Elara realize Cole's identity -- and that he's just the Mr. Right she's been looking for.
6994c7def370c522ef066652.title: The Billionaire and the Baby Trap

6997b6c7345c5a613e0de2e7.synopsis: #CrocsPartner We’re keeping the romance alive! Savannah and Micheal from our new show Charmed to Meet You spill all about dating apps and what their Jibbitz charms might be signaling to potential matches. Plus, don’t miss the juicy tea on their ideal types and who they’d write a love letter to using Jibbitz charms!
6997b6c7345c5a613e0de2e7.title: ReelTalk EP 62-Dating App Confessions

69990ddfa1b763a13b0e97fe.synopsis: Isaac Kane is a single father with a dark secret: he was once the most feared killer on the planet. After making a vow to his dying wife to never kill again, he now spends his days as a down-on-his-luck single father. But when his daughter is kidnapped by a major crime family, he must break his vow... and kill his way through the Russian Mafia, while re-taking his place as a near-mythic killer that haunts the nightmares of the wicked.
69990ddfa1b763a13b0e97fe.title: Return of the Reaper

699a3b6b850d2b8e8208155f.synopsis: Maria’s perfect life crumbles when she discovers her fiancé's affair. Determined to take control, she confronts betrayal, finds herself drawn to Alec, her long-lost ex and now a billionaire. As their paths collide, old feelings awaken, and Maria discovers that love can be unexpected, passionate, and impossible to ignore.
699a3b6b850d2b8e8208155f.title: Cancel the Wedding, Queen Moves On

699d47ee9911429e390e3cbc.synopsis: In Tempting the Mafia Twins movie, Genesis discovers her mob boss husband, Kiefer's affair, and loses one of her twin babies due to his mistress' schemes. Genesis reports him to the authorities and flees while still pregnant. Seven years later, Genesis runs into Kiefer on the street. She thinks her murderous husband is going to kill her, but when Kiefer drags her back home against her will, she realizes the truth: Seven years ago, it was all a misunderstanding. Kiefer O’Reilly, the ruthless mafia boss, only wants one thing—to win Genesis’s love back.
699d47ee9911429e390e3cbc.title: Tempting the Mafia Twins

699def8dc8ae4aecf6097b59.synopsis: In Vicious movie, after Vicious bullies Emilia out of town, he reappears years later with an offer she can’t refuse: A job that could keep her afloat. But Vicious is haunted by a past of abuse, and trusting him could drag Emilia back into the world that once broke her... Can she let herself fall for him?
699def8dc8ae4aecf6097b59.title: Vicious

69a0d16b1535460c9b051a0f.synopsis: Introducing the ReelHotline on ReelTalk! For the first time ever, fans can call their favorite vertical stars and ask the burning questions they’ve been dying to know. In this episode, Jesse picks up the phone and shares stories and secrets you’ve never heard before.
69a0d16b1535460c9b051a0f.title: ReelTalk EP 63-ReelHotline with Jesse

69a1e36416c5b054630ec69a.synopsis: In My Duplicated Husband movie, for five years, Esther has been trapped in an abusive marriage. Her husband, Carl, cheated on her, was physically violent, and indirectly caused the death of their daughter. On their fifth wedding anniversary, during another violent confrontation, Carl dies accidentally. In shock, Esther buries his body in the backyard and goes to sleep. The next morning, Carl appears in front of her again — alive and behaving like the caring, gentle man he once was when they first fell in love. His personality no longer matches the abusive husband she buried. Esther begins to question what is happening. Did Carl somehow return from the dead, or has someone replaced him?
69a1e36416c5b054630ec69a.title: My Duplicated Husband

69a4f02402dfa284670b428a.synopsis: Caspian's the best special forces soldier the world's ever seen. Desperate to find out what happened to his parents, he takes on a dangerous mission — protect the genius CEO who found the cure for cancer, Chloe Brooks. Under constant attack from greedy men who want to take her cure for their own profit, Chloe will do anything to keep DIVINIA, the miracle drug, and her sister Iris safe. The only one who can help her? Caspian, who saves her time and time. But who IS he? Why is he so good at fighting? And can Chloe trust him, when their first meeting ended with a steamy one night stand!?
69a4f02402dfa284670b428a.title: The Magnificent Bodyguard

69a5454af5f994c29609a831.synopsis: Christopher Balcazar is the secret king of Imperial Andes Business Group, Inc. and the richest man in the world, but when he returns from the battlefield, his girlfriend brutally abandons him, thinking he's a clown. How will the king of all men make her regret it?
69a5454af5f994c29609a831.title: I'm The One In Charge

69a9f2a9fe44bba000089d28.synopsis: Sky Kawai and Declan Clifford from Waterboy get candid as they play a round of “Who’s Most Likely To?” From revealing who’s the better kisser to debating who rocks booty shorts best, they drop behind the secrets from the set of ReelShort’s hit LGBTQ series. Tune in for laughs, playful roasting, and insider stories you didn’t see on screen.
69a9f2a9fe44bba000089d28.title: ReelTalk EP 64-Waterboy Duo Reveal Who’s Most Likely To

69aa7b78ee4d18d28207d022.synopsis: In Too Late Alphas movie, Aria was the beloved heiress, but on her birthday, she was abandoned by her two Alpha fiancés, Adrian and Julian. The scheming maid Selena took her place, using a potion to fake a mate bond and steal their trust. Drowned, forgotten on her birthday, even wounded by their own hands—Aria's heart turned to ice. Just as everyone thought she would submit, she declared: "I will marry Damien, the Alpha of the Blood Moon Pack!" The new engagement freed her and brought her a powerful guardian. When the truth was revealed, the regretful Alphas realized they had lost Aria forever—she was now the Luna of another pack.
69aa7b78ee4d18d28207d022.title: Too Late, Alphas

69ab77dad2f2cfe8f2089395.synopsis: In Breathe movie, Sadie White takes her mom’s housekeeping job at the Stone family beachside mansion and accidentally saves global pop star Jax Stone from a mob of fans. Their worlds collide through forbidden chemistry, steamy tension, and explosive jealousy as Sadie is swept into Jax’s glamorous — and dangerous — life. But fame, sabotage, viral scandals, and heartbreak threaten to tear them apart. As Sadie discovers who she is outside of the chaos, she and Jax must decide whether love can survive the glare of the spotlight.
69ab77dad2f2cfe8f2089395.title: Breathe

69ae3bf4fe655b0dec0c3f53.synopsis: Christopher Balcazar is the secret king of Imperial Andes Business Group, Inc. and the richest man in the world, but when he returns from the battlefield, his girlfriend brutally abandons him, thinking he's a clown. How will the king of all men make her regret it?
69ae3bf4fe655b0dec0c3f53.title: I'm The One In Charge

69aefec9d6db6f96240ff7b4.synopsis: In The Cooking Queen A Recipe for Divorce movie, Tiffany, once the legendary “Queen of Cuisine,” gave up her fame to support her husband Barry. But Barry betrays her, siding with his mistress Sera and treating Tiffany as if she's worthless. Heartbroken, Tiffany wanders aimlessly until fate leads her to Claude’s small restaurant.
