There, her hidden talent is reignited, and she dazzles her critics with her culinary prowess. Then, she crosses paths with Barry once again.
69aefec9d6db6f96240ff7b4.title: The Cooking Queen: A Recipe for Divorce

69b348af4cef791c6807cc79.synopsis: Kasey Esser and Vanessa von Schwarz from Your Husband Is Mine are back on our screens for some fun and games. Watch the couple put their relationship to the test as they see how well they really know each other. From non-negotiables to pet peeves, they’re revealing it all! You might just learn a few things about them you didn’t know before.
69b348af4cef791c6807cc79.title: ReelTalk EP 65-How Well Do Kasey and Vanessa Know Each Other?

69b34991f0e1f3b6030b4974.synopsis: In Pucked in the Friend Zone movie, when Reese unexpectedly reunites with her ex-best friend and first love Grayson four years after he broke her heart, she agrees to pose as his fake girlfriend for his sister's wedding. But as old feelings threaten to bubble out, Reese must decide if a chance at true love is worth the risk of repeating history.
69b34991f0e1f3b6030b4974.title: Pucked in the Friend Zone

69b4ca382fa7f9e12b00f674.synopsis: When young and fiery Eddie is forced to work for and spy on her father’s ruthless rival Trent RexRoth, their hatred sparks into a forbidden desire - an age gap love that could ruin them both.
69b4ca382fa7f9e12b00f674.title: Scandalous

69b883090fe6e918cf0a6741.synopsis: When brilliant scholarship student Zoey Whitmore starts receiving mysterious gossip posts that predict her future with terrifying accuracy, her world implodes: her mom is arrested, her boyfriend betrays her, and she becomes the obsession of two powerful rivals — a royal heartthrob and a mafia prince. Each post helps Zoey overcome the bullying of her private school peers, but each victory leads to a new, even harder challenge. With the help of her "Gossip Godmother", can Zoey rewrite her fate one future post at a time?
69b883090fe6e918cf0a6741.title: Gossip Godmother

69b88396a5b6d3639400d47f.synopsis: In Meet My Brothers movie, Catherine Rowen spent three years as a contract wife, treated like a servant and discarded the moment her divorce papers were signed. Pregnant, humiliated, and threatened by her husband’s mistress, she hits her lowest point, until a helicopter lands, revealing the truth: she is the long-lost daughter of the powerful Lane family, rightful sister of Dominic, Connor, and Liam.
69b88396a5b6d3639400d47f.title: Meet My Brothers

69b8bbabff492f44ca032149.synopsis: In Stop That Homeless Man Is an American Hero movie, Ethan escorts his fallen comrade's ashes back home. On the way, he gets stopped by the local Sheriff who accuses Ethan of being a homeless vagrant. Ethan gets dragged in for questioning at the police station. They humiliate and torture him, but Ethan endures because he must protect his friend's ashes. But then, the sheriff goes too far. He desecrates the ashes! Just when things are about to take a turn for the worse, Ethan's old army subordinate– now the Director of the FBI– appears! Will Ethan's true identity as an American hero finally be revealed?
69b8bbabff492f44ca032149.title: Stop! That Homeless Man Is an American Hero!

69b9e726e7069f23f9031a37.synopsis: High school senior, Isabel, will soon die from a serious heart condition. She has a secret crush on her best friend Alex, and plans to confess her feelings to him after graduation. However, a huge misunderstanding in the middle of senior year ruins their friendship. Alex now holds a grudge against Isabel. He even lets her classmates bully her. Ten years later, Alex finds a collection of short vlogs that Isabel left for him. The videos reveal a shocking truth, a truth that completely changes Alex's world.
69b9e726e7069f23f9031a37.title: The Summer My Heart Stopped

69bffcaa7bf40980510e0d6b.synopsis: In Corrupting My Billionaire Boss's Heart movie, when Lyla Walker starts working at the world's most elite country club, she unwittingly brings chaos and temptation to her buttoned-up billionaire CEO Royce Kennedy. She's ready to risk everything for their forbidden relationship, unaware of the promise he made to her dying father.
69bffcaa7bf40980510e0d6b.title: Corrupting My Billionaire Boss's Heart

69c0a20b1dd01a41ad0fdca1.synopsis: Ivy is a high-school sophomore with the voice of an angel. She's also a super wealthy heiress, but she hides her identity in the hopes of making real friends at school. After becoming besties with Vanessa, she thinks she's made the right choice. But, Vanessa actually treats Ivy like a total tool! Vanessa even guilt-trips Ivy into being her voice double. But, things start to fall apart after Ivy catches her boyfriend cheating on her with her bestie! Heartbroken and betrayed, Ivy seeks help from her childhood bestfriend and star quarterback, Blake. Will Ivy be able to reclaim her spotlight?
69c0a20b1dd01a41ad0fdca1.title: Mic Drop Diva

69c0a237f86334e9ff0acfd6.synopsis: In The Day the Champion Racer Lost His Bride movie, for five years, Alexis poured her entire heart into Ryder Kane—the golden boy of the racing world. She thought they were building a future together. But on the day she planned to propose, she learned the truth: Ryder never saw her as a partner. Just a placeholder. A “practice girlfriend.” Shattered, Alexis accepts an unexpected proposal from billionaire Everett Hale—and cuts Ryder out of her life for good. Now Ryder is forced to face the fallout. Will he let her walk away… or will losing her push him into a spiral of obsession, regret, and the fight of his life?
69c0a237f86334e9ff0acfd6.title: The Day the Champion Racer Lost His Bride

69c0a24ec1a92e4f5603fd9f.synopsis: On their wedding night, the CEO of the Walker Group, Griffin Walker, is tied up to a chair and forced to witness his wife Isabella cheat on him with three men at the same time. Enraged, he seeks revenge, but Isabella stops him in his tracks with a single photograph. For the next eighteen years, Griffin willingly raises Isabella's twins - a boy and a girl - born from her and one of those men, Ethan. He endures humiliation and mockery from them and is forced to transfer his company and all assets to the twins when they turn eighteen. Everyone thinks Griffin is held captive by that single photo, but at the moment Isabella's family celebrates their triumph, Griffin finally reveals the truth...
69c0a24ec1a92e4f5603fd9f.title: The Photo that Changed Everything

69c0a262b5d57818100485ef.synopsis: In Hating and Loving My Adopted Brother movie, after Abigail's parents both die in an accident, she gets adopted by her dad's friend. She transfers to a new high school and clashes with Chris, who acts like a total selfish prick — only to discover that he's her new adopted brother! Living under the same roof, she falls for him... but does he like her back?
69c0a262b5d57818100485ef.title: Hating and Loving My Adopted Brother

69c0a298c87f09a7e10d8ffe.synopsis: Hannah gave up everything for her fiancé, only to be brutally betrayed and abandoned in the States. Desperate to stay, she flash-married Alex, the "street thug" she accidentally saved with a single kiss during his escape. Passion ignites as Alex shields her from her vengeful ex and every threat. As their new life unfolds, Hannah starts to realize Alex might be more than just a street stranger...
69c0a298c87f09a7e10d8ffe.title: Married The Mafioso I Saved

69c0a2a5f468bb5e37047f72.synopsis: In The Comeback Play movie, once a legendary player, a disgraced alcoholic starts coaching his estranged son’s underdog NBA team, determined to prove to his haters that he can save the team and still be the God of Ball.
69c0a2a5f468bb5e37047f72.title: The Comeback Play

69c0a2b3f2e814722a05379e.synopsis: Ella fell in love with Holden, the Alpha of the High Mountain Wolf Clan, when they were children after he promised to protect her. Due to a witch's prophecy about destined mates, she became his Luna. However, Holden mistakenly thought she married him just to be Luna, so he grew to hate her. Due to the scheming of Ivy, Holden's childhood sweetheart, Ella thinks they're romantically involved and overhears Holden's plan to abort Ella's unborn child. She divorces him and leaves with the baby, then reuniting with her own clan, the Silver Snow Clan, and learns she's their long-lost princess.
69c0a2b3f2e814722a05379e.title: Divorce Tears from the Alpha, but I Shine Alone

69c0a2c0679a90fdc80d4ec2.synopsis: In Lucifer's Bride movie, the King of Hell, Lucifer, hides his true identity and comes to the human world in search of the girl who keeps appearing in his dreams. He unexpectedly saves Angela from mortal danger, only to be forced to leave. When he returns, Lucifer realizes Angela is the one he’s been searching for—but she is once again facing a life-or-death crisis. Unable to use his magic powers, can Lucifer overcome escalating threats and protect her?
69c0a2c0679a90fdc80d4ec2.title: Lucifer's Bride

69c0a327d4ec88728c059554.synopsis: Family outcast Ella Davenport's father arranges for her to marry a scumbag, but when she shows up to sign the papers, she realizes she's already married. And this mystery hubby isn't just anyone - it's smoking-hot CEO Cole McBride! Cole refuses to believe that they're really married, but with his aging grandmother taking an instant liking to Ella, getting rid of her might prove harder than he thought. Can this accidental couple take the unlikely path from mystery marriage to real love??
69c0a327d4ec88728c059554.title: My Double Proxy Marriage to a Billionaire

69c0a33b8189b0616e0020e1.synopsis: In Silicon God Strikes Back movie, Leon is a genius engineer who has a special knack for creating computer chips. His life was perfect – great job, loving wife – until one day, his family doctor informs him that his wife has stage four cancer! Leon does everything he can to save her, but soon realizes that his wife isn't who he thought she was. He decides to change his entire life. He's ready to prove that his talents can dominate the tech world.
69c0a33b8189b0616e0020e1.title: Silicon God Strikes Back

69c0a350789b84f50b0c232c.synopsis: In She's Not Homeless She's Healer Goddess movie, Everyone accuses Trixie of being a gold-digging prostitute because of her hobo clothes. Little do they realize that she's the ONLY ONE who can cure the hottest and richest man in the nation - war hero, Lysander Armstrong! (And win his heart too)
69c0a350789b84f50b0c232c.title: She's Not Homeless, She's Healer Goddess!

69c0a362451b1ea26300fc5f.synopsis: After Romeo Costa ruins Dallas Townsend's reputation at the debutante ball and forces her into a marriage, Dallas makes a new plan: seduce him, break his rule, and get the family she’s always dreamed of. But Romeo is not easy to break. And Dallas isn't the type of girl to give up.
69c0a362451b1ea26300fc5f.title: My Dark Romeo

69c12378a443620f8e030532.synopsis: In Her Final Bet movie, Scarlett Spades, a seemingly ordinary housewife, is secretly the last heir of the murdered Gambling King, forced into hiding since her family was wiped out. When her devoted husband is framed by a rigged casino and driven to the edge, Scarlett is dragged back into the underworld she swore to abandon. Playing the naïve "lucky girl", she seduces cheaters into arrogance and destroys them with impossible wins—until her revenge awakens the true mastermind behind her parents' deaths, and one final bet demands blood, love, even her life...
69c12378a443620f8e030532.title: Her Final Bet

69c588478f4cedad8805dfbf.synopsis: Seth Edeen returns to the ice in this exciting episode of ReelTalk Backstage. Follow along as he takes us inside his new show Pucked in the Friend Zone, showing how he prepares for game day and what it really takes to suit up for hockey. His co-stars also dish on why hockey players are so irresistible and share behind the scenes tea from set. Catch all the action now!
69c588478f4cedad8805dfbf.title: ReelTalk EP 67-Backstage: Pucked in the Friend Zone

69c66c0c03e82c80ed093e46.synopsis: In My Secret Lover Is His Brother movie, to forgive Piper's family debt, she's promised to marry one of the Bellfort brothers. Will she choose the star lacrosse player Drew? Or the handsome loner Noah? How can she decide when she has a connection with both?
69c66c0c03e82c80ed093e46.title: My Secret Lover Is His Brother

69cebf23cd56b63d7c0063c9.synopsis: We’re reuniting the stars of Wrong! and How to Break a DILF for an episode that will keep you spinning. Richard Trotter and Miah Green take on a playful game of Spin the Bottle with a Truth or Dare twist. From first kisses to first impressions, they reveal what they're really like off-camera, who’s got the best word on beat skills, and maybe even show off a little pole dancing.
69cebf23cd56b63d7c0063c9.title: ReelTalk EP 68-Richard & Miah Play Spin the Bottle

69d83718ca7a94dcd706851b.synopsis: Step into the confessional. Sister Sarah is here to hear your secrets and offer her blessing. In this episode of ReelHotline, fans call in with their voicemail confessions, sharing their most guilty, messy, and surprising truths. Nothing is off limits and some of these sins might be a little juicier than expected. Will Sarah grant forgiveness or call them out?
69d83718ca7a94dcd706851b.title: ReelTalk EP 69-ReelHotline with Sarah

69d918f2b996ba0ba60e8597.synopsis: After Nora's stepsister Bianca steals her AI-matched partner, Nora is forced to marry a janitor and becomes the laughingstock of her family. Little does she know that the janitor is the billionaire behind the AI matchmaking system, using their marriage to test her true feelings...
69d918f2b996ba0ba60e8597.title: The Janitor Billionaire & His Swapped Bride

69d91aac64eba2f58b0ac51c.synopsis: In Ace The Golf King's Reconquest movie, "Lion" was once the Grand Slam champion that ruled the world of golf. Devastated by the loss of his wife, he disappears to take care of their baby daughter at the peak of his career, leaving behind his insurmountable legacy. Hiding away as a gardener, "Lion" pulls weeds and mows the lawn at a golf club to make a living. Desperate to give his daughter a better life and pay for her tuition, "Lion" steps back on the golf course to reclaim his former glory! The roar of the mighty "Lion" will be heard around the world!
69d91aac64eba2f58b0ac51c.title: Ace! The Golf King's Reconquest

69d91abd6d72cb24d6089473.synopsis: Head over heels for Ethan Sutton, it-boy of Lowell Private Academy, Maddie Sinclair has always put him first. But when she finds out he's been cheating on her with heiress Vanessa Archibald, Madeline hatches a grand escape plan with Ethan's opportunistic mother. Will Ethan capture her heart back before it leaves permanently for London, or will Rhys Wyndham, mysterious new bad boy from London end up sealing the deal before Maddie even boards the plane?
69d91abd6d72cb24d6089473.title: Private School Playboys

69d91acc42de055eb105ab81.synopsis: In Runaway Single Mom Safe in His Arms movie, single mom Maria escapes abuse and fights to protect her daughter, Judy. From factory struggles to elite schools, she faces enemies, family betrayal, and unexpected love. When billionaire Levi enters her life, everything changes...
69d91acc42de055eb105ab81.title: Runaway Single Mom, Safe in His Arms

69d91ada60fde4d6ec0efc04.synopsis: Ellie wants to be a world famous model, but no one'll give a chubby girl a chance. She has a one-night stand with fashion company CEO Eason, raising their son Lucas alone. Hoping to land a job as a model, she answers HALE Group's casting call only to discover that the boss interviewing is her baby daddy, Eason Hale himself!
69d91ada60fde4d6ec0efc04.title: XL Stands for Xtra Love

69d91ae716a9a0df82015651.synopsis: In Cyberking Reclaims His Throne movie, Max Lennox is the world's number one hacker, CYBERKING. Just when he's about to uncover the Pentagon's secrets and expose them to the world, he gets betrayed by his girlfriend, who shoves him off the roof! He miraculously survives, but loses all his memories... except for his genius hacking skills. He gets saved by a kind-hearted programmer, Suki Ruskin. Together, they try to get Max's memory back, hoping to figure out who did this to him. Will he ultimately reclaim his throne as The CYBERKING?
69d91ae716a9a0df82015651.title: Cyberking Reclaims His Throne

69d91af7ff2f5a4b160bb1e3.synopsis: The Sherwoods are the most respected witches in all of Witchingdom, and as heir it's Leona's duty to protect her family's ancient wand and enter an arranged marriage. But all her plans go up in pixie dust when she crosses paths with notorious bad-boy witch Erik Svensen... and ends up magically bound to him in an unbreakable marriage! To undo her mistake and preserve her family legacy, she must accompany Erik on a magic-filled road trip to get him to cast a divorce spell, but the longer she spends with her husband, the more she feels all her walls and duties come crashing down.
69d91af7ff2f5a4b160bb1e3.title: Head Witch in Charge

69d91b034e68ac09390185be.synopsis: In the End of the World, Start of My Empire movie, after World War III, Arthur Morgan is reduced to scraping by in the chaos, surviving on scavenged goods while being bullied and robbed by former high school classmates—until a chance discovery of alien technology changes everything. He rescues three women who become his wives and sets his sights on using this power to rise as the King of the Wasteland.
69d91b034e68ac09390185be.title: End of the World, Start of My Empire

69d91b111840476dfa0eba40.synopsis: Inspired by the novel by Tijan. After a devastating senior year of high school, Kennedy made two rules for herself. 1. No one will know she's related to her brother and 2. She will never fall for another one of her brother's rivals. When Shay Coleman barges into her life with his irritating and irresistable charm, she's treatened to break both of them...
69d91b111840476dfa0eba40.title: Hate to Love You

69d91b270f63b3f86a055321.synopsis: Believing that Celeste had indirectly caused his sister Gloria’s tragic death in prison, Byron let love curdle into hatred. For five years, he tortured Celeste’s body and soul—until the day he learned she was dead. Only then did regret set in.
69d91b270f63b3f86a055321.title: Don't Watch Me Waste Away

69d91b3ee15105112e0dc022.synopsis: Aria won Luca’s love in an arranged mafia marriage, but when she secretly helps her sister flee the life, she betrays him. With their families at war and a baby on the way, Aria must decide whether love can survive when loyalty is paid for in blood.
69d91b3ee15105112e0dc022.title: Bound by Love

69d91b64f25269180009b384.synopsis: In Djinn Under Contract Movie, Eli Baran is a genie in a magic lamp who can grant three wishes. After thousands of years, a billionaire uses his last wish to grant Eli freedom– but on one condition: Eli must marry his granddaughter, Christine Parrish, for five years! To fulfill the wish, Eli transforms into a human, marries Christine, and secretly helps her become a successful CEO. However, Christine ignores and constantly belittles him during their marriage. When the five years are almost up, Eli starts to realize that Christine might never truly love him. Then, when Christine's old flame reenters the picture, Eli's heart is completely shattered. Now, Eli is faced with a tough decision– should he stay by Christine's side once the final wish is granted, or is it time to for him to divorce Christine and finally live his own life?
69d91b64f25269180009b384.title: Djinn Under Contract

69d91b7760fde4d6ec0efc06.synopsis: In The Seduction Game movie, when a brilliant, dirt-poor teen earns a scholarship to an elite prep school, she becomes the target of a cruel queen bee and her bad-boy pawn who’s tasked with seducing and destroying her before Ivy League admissions are announced — but what no one expects is that the girl from the trailer is playing them all, and she might just take the crown, the scholarship… and his heart.
69d91b7760fde4d6ec0efc06.title: The Seduction Game

69d91b89a61a85c6f30a4e80.synopsis: Once enemies, now lovers, Rowan and Emma face new challenges as a couple: an heiress fiancée who'll stop at nothing to win Rowan over, an overbearing mother obsessed with the status quo, and Emma's own fears that she'll never fit into Rowan's world. Emma used to believe their hard-won love could triumph over their differences... but what if leaving Rowan is the right choice?
69d91b89a61a85c6f30a4e80.title: Taming My Bullies 2

69d91b958836620d0a0d5bdf.synopsis: The Master of Magic, Daniel Angier, went into hiding after losing his brother in a tragic casino heist gone wrong. But after reconnecting with a close friend of his brother’s, Daniel sets out to reclaim the title of the Master of Magic in order to save his childhood orphanage.
69d91b958836620d0a0d5bdf.title: Don't Blink, You'll Miss It

69d91bb436000f5c4603b71f.synopsis: In Falling for My Nemesis Stepbrother movie, Nicole has always been the good girl. While Kane, her stepbrother, is the opposite. To the world, he’s a dangerous bad boy. To Nicole, he’s the boy she never stopped loving. On the night of a deadly street race, Nicole runs into the road to stop Kane from destroying himself, while Kane fights feelings he knows he shouldn’t want.
69d91bb436000f5c4603b71f.title: Falling for My Nemesis Stepbrother

69d91bcb9f6094e9250565a5.synopsis: In the When Forever Fell Apart movie, for their sixth anniversary, Natalie wants to surprise her husband Ethan, so she goes to the clinic to check on the sperm he stored… only to find out he took it out long ago! Turns out, he donated to his ex and childhood crush so she could have his baby! And now that woman is back—with the child. Worse, Ethan actually brings them into their home, as if they belonged there. After being let down again and again, Natalie finally makes up her mind. She’s done. She wants a divorce. She’s walking away. For good. Will Ethan manage to save their marriage before it's lost forever, or will Natalie disappear before Ethan realizes that he's lost a truly good woman?
69d91bcb9f6094e9250565a5.title: When Forever Fell Apart

69d91bd627497358110ee7ce.synopsis: In Double Life of a Cell Block King movie, Harrison hits rock bottom after a betrayal by his own stepfamily. He deliberately goes to prison to gather evidence of his stepfamily’s crimes. After his release, a sudden marriage ties his fate to Sophia, and the two are quickly pushed to the margins, facing humiliation, poverty, and open scorn from those in power. As Sophia chases a chance at a new future, Harrison is repeatedly branded as a ex convict—until a single moment inside the Maple Group building signals that everything they believed about him may be wrong.
69d91bd627497358110ee7ce.title: Double Life of a Cell Block King

69d91be663ac6594310ce48b.synopsis: Rowan and Emma's relationship reaches a new stage, but new challenges lie ahead. Will they finally get their happy ending? Emma and The Big Four's story is coming to its finale. Stay tuned for the ending you've been waiting for.
69d91be663ac6594310ce48b.title: Taming My Bullies 3

69d91bfc493c1bdb3e018ee6.synopsis: In Power Lies and Marriage movie, Aurora may seem like an ordinary housewife, but in reality, she is the only daughter of the impossibly powerful Redmond family. On their wedding anniversary, she catches her politician husband, Shawn, cheating with her best friend, Tiffany, in his office. She also learns that her late young daughter was denied her life-saving transplant because of them. After learning the truth, Aurora contacts her family and decides to leave Shawn. She secretly gets him to uniwttingly sign a divorce agreement. Completely unaware of what’s happening, he continues his endless string of betrayals, practically rubbing her face in his affair. Aurora endures humiliation and anger. She plots her revenge. She exposes her cheating husband in front of the public at a campaign event, revealing his true nature to all of his supporters. She decides to run against him in the gubernatorial election, not only to end his political career, but to usurp it.
69d91bfc493c1bdb3e018ee6.title: Power, Lies, and Marriage

69e0b7f139a61953f9025ea7.synopsis: In the Love Under Fire movie, When a disciplined former Secret Service agent is forced to partner with a reckless global pop star after his daughter is kidnapped by her obsessive ex, their race across the Philippines ignites a volatile romance- one that forces them to choose between control, trust, and the people they love most.
69e0b7f139a61953f9025ea7.title: Love Under Fire

69e13d6661d01cba1a00b545.synopsis: Brace yourself, dark romance lovers. A special reading of a chapter from Bound by Honor, ReelShort’s hit adaptation of Cora Reilly’s book, is finally here. If you’re a fan of the book or the series, you won’t want to miss this intimate reading by Rhett Wellington, bringing Luca to life in a whole new way.
69e13d6661d01cba1a00b545.title: ReelTalk EP 70-Bound by Honor: A Special Chapter Reading with Rhett Wellington

69e6368af5d1c8622c099106.synopsis: In Lady CEO's Fatal Contract movie, after a heart transplant, Violet learns her donor, Eve, died at the hands of her boyfriend, Liam, a famous artist. Seeking proof, Violet signs a BDSM contract to become his servant, but Liam doesn't abuse her—he protects her with a tenderness that terrifies her. When her ex-husband uncovers her lie and blackmails her, Liam quietly makes him disappear. Now Violet faces an impossible truth: she came to destroy a monster, but he may be the only one who truly owns her.
69e6368af5d1c8622c099106.title: Lady CEO's Fatal Contract

69eac93a1665d9d2e30fbd1e.synopsis: Maria Barseghian and Nate Flores from Once Upon a Breakup hit the streets of LA for the ultimate foodie date. Maria takes Nate through her go-to spots from trendy coffee shops to smash burger joints, ending with a little friendly competition at the arcade. Great food, real chemistry, and a day that gets a little more intimate with every stop.
69eac93a1665d9d2e30fbd1e.title: ReelTalk EP 71-Maria and Nate's First Date

69ee144b9145b171320d315a.synopsis: The night before the State Championship final, cheerleader Jessica invites the Maple Giants football team to party with her at the bar. Katlyn, as the team's manager, puts her foot down and demands they get a good nights rest instead of going out and drinking. The next day, the Maple Giants win the championship, only to be greeted with terrible news — Jessica went out alone last night, was assaulted and broke her legs. The team, led by Logan, pins the blame on Katlyn, claiming that if she hadn't stopped them from going to Jessica's party, Jessica would still be safe! Logan demands that Katlyn suffers the same fate and breaks her leg. While trying to escape, Katlyn falls off the roof and dies. The football team even frames her as a bully. Katlyn suddenly wakes up the night before the Championship Final! Not about to waste her second chance at life, Katlyn swears to herself she'll never help these dumb jocks again. Instead, she'll watch and enjoy as they bring about their self-destruction!
69ee144b9145b171320d315a.title: Reborn to See the Football Stars Ruin Themselves

69f3ed48faeb4f798601aad9.synopsis: Two major forces in verticals finally collide. Jen Cooper of Vertical Drama Love joins Nicole Mattox for an intimate conversation on the state of verticals. From where the industry is headed to what audiences are really craving, nothing is off-limits. It’s an unfiltered deep dive into the conversations creators, actors, and fans have been waiting for.
69f3ed48faeb4f798601aad9.title: ReelTalk EP 72-Vertical Drama Love Unfiltered

69fa0a977e9368c0730c1459.synopsis: In the Rejected Luna Is the Alpha Queen movie, after her Moonshadow Pack was slaughtered by rogues, Arya, the werewolf warrior, hides her immense power to honor her mother's dying wish. She marries Alpha Micah, and hides her strength. But then, Alpha Micah breaks his vows and returns from war with a new mate, Vera, and demands that Arya share her Luna title with her. Faced with Vera, Micah, and his family's cruelty, Arya can no longer bear it. She leaves Micah and unleashes the immense power of the White Wolf, reclaiming what is hers with the help of Lowe, the Lycan King. After separating from Micah, Arya discoveres that Vera not only stole Micah from her, but is also the traitor who slaughtered her parents and the Moonshadow Pack. Arya rushes to the battlefield to face her betrayers, and in the process, finds love in Lowe, the Lycan King.
69fa0a977e9368c0730c1459.title: Rejected Luna Is the Alpha Queen

69fa1e880683f8510b02930c.synopsis: War hero Harrison returns from war to discover his sister has died by her fiancé, Karter's hand. Harrison infiltrates Karter's banquet wearing his worn fatigues, announcing to Karter that his punishment will arrive in 3 days. Eventually, he reveals his true identity as the Director of FBI, and achieves his ultimate revenge.
69fa1e880683f8510b02930c.title: The Warlord Returns

69fb80fb9feee94a1309f720.synopsis: Seraph was a princess cherished by her family her entire life, until her sister was murdered. When her husband and best friend helped the killer escape justice, she was forced to grow up overnight.
69fb80fb9feee94a1309f720.title: Your Love Broke My Heart

69fc97f7f35208d08800c854.synopsis: In My Boss Loves Me Too Much movie, Ella planned to challenge herself by taking a new job after years of managing crises, but her world is turned upside down when her new boss, Christian, drags her in a fake marriage! What starts as a simple arrangement soon becomes something far more intense. Every touch, every kiss, draws Ella deeper into his world. But what she doesn’t know is that Christian has been playing a dangerous game all along, determined to make her his forever.
69fc97f7f35208d08800c854.title: My Boss Loves Me Too Much

69fd0c482d20ccc4be08afe5.synopsis: We’re hitting the road for festival season! Cole Gerdes and Mellisa Goodwin hop behind the wheel for a special carpool karaoke-style Finish the Lyrics challenge. Can they recognize the songs or will they completely flop under pressure?
69fd0c482d20ccc4be08afe5.title: ReelTalk EP 73-Can Vertical Actors Sing a Justin Bieber Song?

69fd0d45fe565cebed0b600b.synopsis: For Mental Health Awareness Month, Gabrielle Brown opens up about the unglamorous side of the industry and overcoming hardships. From setting boundaries to navigating healing after marriage, Gabrielle discusses growth, resilience, and protecting your peace. Tune in for a vulnerable discussion on mental health and advice for anyone navigating a difficult time.
69fd0d45fe565cebed0b600b.title: ReelTalk EP 74-Gabrielle Brown: Surviving Betrayal and People Pleasing

69fd0d804bd18783fa0c5c1c.synopsis: Join Savannah Coffee and Chris Quartuccio as ReelTalk goes international for its first-ever ReelTrip to Thailand. From the vibrant streets and skyline of Bangkok to iconic landmarks like Wat Pho, these costars dive into Thailand’s culture through unforgettable food, shopping, sightseeing, and makeovers. Experience the flavors, fashion, and beauty of Thailand through their adventure abroad.
69fd0d804bd18783fa0c5c1c.title: ReelTalk EP 75-ReelTrip: Thailand

69fd0ddb105a230d0c0da6c3.synopsis: Our iconic enemies-to-lovers is back and better than ever! Go behind the scenes of Taming My Bullies 2 and discover how Meg's signature look comes together. Cam also gives the inside scoop on filming some of the shirtless swimming scenes, while the director breaks down the inspiration behind key shots and what it really takes to bring this story to life.
69fd0ddb105a230d0c0da6c3.title: ReelTalk EP 76-Backstage: Taming My Bullies 2

69fd0dfdb6f786ada703b918.synopsis: Four breakout stars from ReelShort’s hit LGBTQ series come together for an intimate Pride Month special short video, sharing their most genuine crush confessions through cinematic monologues inspired by real emotions, memories, and love stories. Set against dreamy summer nights, camcorder footage, and coastlines, Crush Confessions captures the quiet ache of longing, youth, and the moment every love song finally starts to make sense.
69fd0dfdb6f786ada703b918.title: ReelTalk EP 77-Love Whisper

69fd0e2ced0c035c1a0f2e52.synopsis: Spend a day shopping with Cam! Follow along as he searches for Hironos at Pop Mart, shows off his nerdy side, and opens about his journey from modeling to acting. This is a side of Cam you won't want to miss!
69fd0e2ced0c035c1a0f2e52.title: ReelTalk EP 78-Day in the Life of Cam: Pop Mart & Untold Stories

69fd0e55314c2ba12f081ad8.synopsis: What better way to celebrate Father’s Day than with a very special announcement: Jackson Tiller is going to be a girl dad! In this heartfelt episode of ReelTalk, Jackson sits down with Sarah Moliski for an emotional conversation about fatherhood, family, and life in the spotlight. From preparing to welcome a daughter to balancing a growing career with being a devoted husband and father, Jackson opens up about the moments that matter most.
69fd0e55314c2ba12f081ad8.title: ReelTalk EP 79-Jackson Tiller Is a Girl Dad!

69fd0e6cfa888249920d5ef5.synopsis: BroTalk is BACK! The Big Four from Taming My Bullies are taking over the pool. Cam Porras is hosting a pool party with friends (Travis Owens and Grant Garcia) when a mysterious lifeguard (Luke Dodge) crashes the fun and starts enforcing strange beach rules. Plus, stick around as the cast answers the burning questions fans have been buzzing about.
69fd0e6cfa888249920d5ef5.title: ReelTalk EP 80-BroTalk: Pool Party

69fea8733a6caa4b4309439b.synopsis: It’s the ultimate golf showdown! You know Marc Herrmann as one of the biggest stars in microdramas but what you might not know is that he has a serious golf background. Now, he’s stepping onto the course to take on a Head Golf Professional. Can Marc beat him and win a lifetime driving range membership or will he be forced to face a punishment?
69fea8733a6caa4b4309439b.title: ReelTalk EP 82-Marc vs Golf Pro

69fecf5b20ab8d80080befaf.synopsis: Mafia Camorra family boss Michael is assassinated, forcing his 20-year-old only daughter, Gloria, to take over the family business. While dealing with internal and external threats to the clan, she falls in love with Theo, her late father's close friend and a 34-year-old former FBI agent turned bodyguard. After spotting her own photo inside Theo's pendant, she becomes convinced that he loves her back—only to later discover that the photo is actually of her mother. As their romance intensifies, Theo's past as an FBI agent leads Gloria to suspect he may have been involved in her father's murder, plunging their relationship into crisis.
69fecf5b20ab8d80080befaf.title: Mafia Heiress’s Forbidden Obssession

69ff6d59e6f8dfe13a0feb62.synopsis: Ever wondered what a grandma would think of ReelShort's steamiest scenes? We put her to the test with Bound By Love, and her hilarious reactions did not disappoint. Stick around for a surprise appearance from special guest Rhett Wellington!
69ff6d59e6f8dfe13a0feb62.title: ReelTalk EP 83-Grandma Reacts to Bound By Love

69ff6d7cede0e22567066f36.synopsis: Autumn Noel returns for an intimate catch up with her best friend, Amanda Liguori. From prioritizing her mental health to creating new music and embracing a new style, Autumn opens up about everything she's been working on behind the scenes. Then, the bestie duo heads out for a fashion challenge as Autumn attempts to build the perfect outfit for Amanda. Will her styling skills earn Amanda’s approval, or will the fitting room have the final say?
69ff6d7cede0e22567066f36.title: ReelTalk EP 84-Day in the Life of Autumn

6a017e1b1c1dd49c430ae6b6.synopsis: Inspired by the novel by Tijan. Emma killed a mafia prince to save her best friend, and now the city wants her dead. There’s only one place left to turn: Carter Reed - the most feared man in the city and the man her dying brother trusted with her life. Carter promised to protect her from monsters, even from himself. But the more time she spends under his protection, the more Emma realizes she’s falling for a monster. And the more Carter wants the one woman he swore to never touch. Will they give in, or will their enemies catch them first?
6a017e1b1c1dd49c430ae6b6.title: Carter Reed

6a02bf5a631c8645a00bc6c9.synopsis: Sofía is short on money and desperate to pay her mother's expensive medical bills. Her relatives agree to help her on the condition that she marries the billionaire Samuel, who is in a coma after a near-fatal car accident. However, it won't be long before the infamous Samuel wakes up from his coma and discovers he's engaged to a complete stranger.
6a02bf5a631c8645a00bc6c9.title: Wake Up, My Billionaire Husband

6a02ed06ab20a7f49c084c9f.synopsis: Trapped in an arranged marriage with Luca, the cold and dangerously seductive heir to the New York mafia, Aria, the innocent little princess of the Chicago mafia, must decide whether giving her body—and perhaps her heart—to a man born of violence is her greatest betrayal or her only chance of survival.
6a02ed06ab20a7f49c084c9f.title: Bound by Honor

6a06477801cfe98f60076ded.synopsis: Based on the novel by L. Steele. After her fiancé cheats on her, Vivian flash marries a hot silver fox… only to realize he’s her ex’s dad. The deal is simple: two weeks of marriage, a CEO title for Quentin and enough money for Vivian to save her sick dad. But as her ex keeps humiliating her and his dad keeps saving her, Vivian's fake marriages starts to cross very real lines.
6a06477801cfe98f60076ded.title: The Imperfect Marriage

6a0671cb10666b879b076b3a.synopsis: In Stableboy movie, openly gay city kid Evan Brooks is sent to a Midwest ranch with one condition: compete on the high school rodeo team or lose his dream of culinary school in Paris.
6a0671cb10666b879b076b3a.title: Stableboy

6a0ac84fb7d7d2bfe20421a5.synopsis: Ten years ago, Elara was adopted by the Alpha of the Stormfang Pack and was destined to choose one of his five sons as her mate. However, the five brothers fall for a manipulative omega maid named Jenny, who schemes to humiliate and torment Elara. Heartbroken and exhausted, Elara publicly rejects her mate bond with the five brothers on her eighteenth birthday and announces her engagement to the mysterious and powerful Lycan Prince, Xavier Lockhart. As the brothers finally uncover Jenny's deception and desperately try to win Elara back, they realize it is too late. Elara finds her true mate in Xavier, breaking his deadly curse, and moves on to a new life, leaving her painful past behind.
6a0ac84fb7d7d2bfe20421a5.title: The Luna's Second Choice

6a0b56759c107ac109085e21.synopsis: In Alpha Queen Rising movie, Aurora gave up her secret life as the leader of the legendary Shadow Circle to be with her beloved mate, whom she works hard as an herbalist to support. But, when he’s promoted to Alpha’s General, instead of thanking her, he breaks their mate bond and replaces her with a scheming Commander's Daughter. He's not expecting the Alpha himself to show up and reveal Aurora is the lost wolf princess--destined to be Alpha Queen--and he'll regret letting her go.
6a0b56759c107ac109085e21.title: Return of the Alpha’s Daughter

6a0bb0d95d746c96610bb8fe.synopsis: The football captain humiliates me and has nude photos taken of me at school. At my lowest moment, I inherit my late father’s powerful conglomerate and a ring that activates five superpowers. I shed my weakness and turn my pain into revenge.
6a0bb0d95d746c96610bb8fe.title: Campus Saga: Superpower Teen

6a0cb99ac2308bcd5308bc59.synopsis: In Dark Notes movie, based on the novel by Pam Godwin. When Ivory Westbrook catches the attention of her new music professor Emeric Marceaux, she discovers his dominating discipline goes beyond the classroom, unfurling a torrid and taboo relationship that could destroy everything she’s worked for, or fulfill desires she never knew she had.
6a0cb99ac2308bcd5308bc59.title: Dark Notes

6a0f7cb70736a2e9de0e9c52.synopsis: In Alpha Daddy Make Me Yours movie, Wolfless Omega Lyra has always been called the unwanted runt. But she never thought that during this year's summer, when she moved back into the house of the alpha that she's secretly had a crush on for a long time, Alpha Damon-- he would also be her best friend's dad! At home, she can't hold back her long accumulated desires anymore-- they explode out. She fantasizes about Alpha Damon taking her virginity, dreaming about him, even while she knows that an Alpha like Damon would never fall in love with an omega like her. Moreover, Damon is her dad's best friend! When they finally have a forbidden touch, the truth slowly comes out.... could it be... that they're fated mates?
6a0f7cb70736a2e9de0e9c52.title: Alpha Daddy Make Me Yours

6a0f8432be29f7108105f4f8.synopsis: Evelyn, an ordinary high school student, is publicly humiliated after her crush on a popular hockey player is exposed. Devastated, she musters up the courage to send him nudes anonymously in hopes of catching his eye. But she accidentally sends the pics to Colton instead, the captain of the hockey team who always teases her. What will happen between them?
6a0f8432be29f7108105f4f8.title: I Accidentally Sexted My Enemy

6a18943221fde96a100f8ed8.synopsis: In My Alpha Boss Gave Me Triplets movie, Evie, a talented but vulnerable human designer, becomes bound to Leopold, the ruthless Alpha of the Stonehearth Pack, leaving her pregnant with his rare triplets. To protect her, Leopold forces her to move in with him, presenting their relationship as purely transactional while privately struggling with uncontrollable mate-bond instincts that cause him to share Evie's pain and emotions. As Evie is drawn into Leopold’s corporate and pack world, Darleen, a powerful she-wolf from another pack determined to claim Leopold, escalates from professional threats to phsyical ones. Evie's estranged family piles on by attempting to kidnap her. Will Leopold be able to prioritize his mate over everything, and save her from the whirlwind he brought her into?
6a18943221fde96a100f8ed8.title: My Alpha Boss Gave Me Triplets

6a18ab0e0a3fa9b1e70b3cb9.synopsis: Stephen Adams is just your average construction worker. A hardworking, single dad who stays humble... or at least that's what his son thinks. Turns out, Stephen actually runs the biggest construction corporation in America! But he's hiding his identity from his son to keep him humble and teach him the value of hard work. But, when an arrogant bully threatens his son, Stephen has no choice but to step in. Will Stephen's son finally discover his true identity?
6a18ab0e0a3fa9b1e70b3cb9.title: The Hidden Empire of Stephen Adams

6a18b1c2bbfcc4fcd30a20b9.synopsis: In The Hockey Captain That Hates Me movie, plus-size figure skater Skylar Carter hates the arrogant hockey team captain, Mason Reed, with good reason. When Skylar’s prank against the team leaves Mason injured, she’s forced to be his assistant or risk losing her own sports future. Forced together, their rivalry turns into undeniable chemistry. But after the school announces only one program will survive to next season, Skylar and Mason may be falling for the one person whose victory could destroy their dreams.
6a18b1c2bbfcc4fcd30a20b9.title: The Hockey Captain That Hates Me

6a18bf73a88aedd7ff0e368b.synopsis: Nora Harrison thought she killed mafia boss Luca Moretti. But he survives and resurfaces as a billionaire investor, trapping her in his world and forces Nora into a dangerous game: become his woman or lose everything she loves.
6a18bf73a88aedd7ff0e368b.title: Caged by His Twisted Love

6a18c2f9d083d51c99070fb9.synopsis: In Rose in Chains movie, hate has chained their fates together, love is the only key. Mafia Boss Liam swore to destroy the man that killed his father, even keeping his daughter Rose captive. Torn between his thirst for revenge and obsessive fascination with the fallen heiress, Liam finds himself just as much a prisoner to Rose. When the bloody truth behind their past is finally revealed, they realize they were never meant for devastating hatred, but instead love.
6a18c2f9d083d51c99070fb9.title: Rose in Chains

6a1bf0f03645558cb00f7d2e.synopsis: High school star student Eleanor Vance has been best friends with Leo Carter for 16 years, until he knocks her out and ties her to a goalpost as a “prank” to impress the popular girl Savannah. Humiliated in front of the whole school, Ellie transfers to California without a word. There, she finds real friends, academic success, and a caring new boyfriend. Meanwhile, Leo loses his mind with regret, but Ellie has learned that some betrayals can never be forgiven.
6a1bf0f03645558cb00f7d2e.title: The Prank That Broke Us

6a1cebc72b3d482f1904ee1d.synopsis: Driven to save her dying brother, Olivia Bennett is forced to pose as a debutante to win over wealthy Lian Cullen-until she catches the eye of his uncle, the powerful and intimidating Ethan Cullen. By day, she plays the elegant debutante; by night, a masked stripper in a dimly lit club. But as Lian's kindness hides hidden agendas, and Ethan's scheming fiancée Kim Smith closes in, Olivia finds her lies crumbling under Ethan's relentless pursuit.
6a1cebc72b3d482f1904ee1d.title: The Fake Debutante and the True Billionaire

6a1d20be7bad31c4c409e0e1.synopsis: Connor Reed, the world's most powerful arms dealer, saves Charlotte Hayes and spends the night with her while undercover. Four years later, still in hiding, Charlotte shows up... with his son. Now Connor must protect them both... without revealing his true identity.
6a1d20be7bad31c4c409e0e1.title: The CEO and Her Daughter's Secret Father

6a1f52bda2705ccbd5071c79.synopsis: Vera Marchesa just wants one thing: freedom from the dangerous mafia world she grew up in, and her overprotective bodyguard Dante, who refuses to love her. Determined to prove she's not a helpless princess, Vera pushes the one line Dante swore never to cross… even if that means they will crash and burn together.
6a1f52bda2705ccbd5071c79.title: Breaking My Bodyguard

6a1fa002b01d328ba8099905.synopsis: Martina, a farm-raised dancer, uses an engagement contract to secure her spot in the prestigious Bianchi Tango company, but Julian—a handsome assassin—interrupts her plans and forces her to help him. He is a dangerous obstacle, until Matina discovers he might actually give her everything she has ever wanted. Just as she finally gives in to her feelings, he walks away... But when they face death together, they realize that life is too short to waste true love.
6a1fa002b01d328ba8099905.title: Dance Until the End

6a1fa00db01d328ba809994d.synopsis: After six years abroad, Zacarías Montiel builds the world's largest financial empire—the Centurion Group—under the alias "Mr. Z," even helping the current president rise to power. When he quietly returns home to propose to his girlfriend, Isabela, she leaves him to pursue wealth, claiming that only the mysterious Mr. Z is good enough for her. Meanwhile, a small favor leads Zacarías into a sudden marriage with Fernanda Salazar, the beautiful CEO of Prisma Media. At Isabela's housewarming party, she repeatedly tries to kick Zacarías out—unaware of his true identity—until he finally decides to reclaim everything he once gave her.
6a1fa00db01d328ba809994d.title: Stand Aside, the Billionaire Is Here

6a1fa01bb01d328ba8099995.synopsis: Forced into marriage by her scheming grandmother and sister, Natalia becomes the wife of Leonardo, a rugged rural rancher and devoted single father to his mute daughter, Lilly. Unwanted by both Lilly and a hostile neighbor, Natalia struggles to find her place—until she uncovers the neighbor's abuse of the little girl. As she earns Lilly's trust, an unbreakable bond forms, culminating in Lilly speaking her first words to save Natalia. Just when Natalia finally begins to feel at home, new challenges threaten everything she's fought to build. With Lilly bullied at school and both her old and new families turning against her, Natalia must fight to protect the love, home, and family she never expected to find.
6a1fa01bb01d328ba8099995.title: Falling for the Cowboy Dad

6a1fa025b01d328ba80999dd.synopsis: At sixteen, Sofia’s adoptive mother sold her eggs on the black market, stealing her chance to ever become a mother. Years later, Sofia is just a school custodian—until she saves a little girl from a kidnapping and catches the attention of her mysterious billionaire father. Desperate to protect his daughter from a vicious custody battle, he offers Sofia an unexpected deal: marry him. What starts as a fake marriage soon turns into a love neither of them can resist. But his ruthless ex-wife, buried secrets, and deadly betrayals threaten to tear their new family apart. Sofia has already lost her chance at motherhood. Will she lose the family she finally found?
6a1fa025b01d328ba80999dd.title: His Daughter Chose Me

6a1fa1e93d80264639051d5d.synopsis: After three years of marriage, CEO Wes Sterling is convinced his wife Kira is a gold-digging cheater. Tired of Wes's accusations and mistreatment, Kira finally divorces him and reclaims her true identity... a billionaire heiress! What will Wes do when he realizes he's made the biggest mistake of his life? Will Kira make him pay... or fall for him again?
6a1fa1e93d80264639051d5d.title: The Billionaire Heiress's Double Life

6a1fa1f73d80264639051da5.synopsis: Rejected by her partner, Selena feel hopeless and discouraged, but the Moon Goddess has other plans for her!
6a1fa1f73d80264639051da5.title: My Alpha, My Forbidden Fate

6a1fa20d3d80264639051e35.synopsis: Carlos, the legendary shooter known as the King of Guns, broke the world record for long-distance confirmed kills and then vanished from the public eye. He hides his identity and works as a maintenance technician at a shooting range. There, he endures the humiliations from the club captain, Andre, who despises him without knowing his true identity. The shooting range is about to face a hostile takeover. To protect Joana, the owner, and her daughter Rebeca, Carlos finally decides to act, revealing his legendary shooting skills. His extraordinary performance immediately draws attention to his mysterious identity…
6a1fa20d3d80264639051e35.title: The Legend in Disguise

6a210e9bdd61d087070d184f.synopsis: When André Brandão, son of famous NFL quarterback Thiago Brandão and former beauty queen Cristina, disappears in a devastating fire, the psychotic fan Dinho sees an opportunity to swap André for his own son, Vitor. Twelve years later, the two boys meet at soccer tryouts, where André surpasses Vitor. The Brandão family, unaware that André is their long-lost son, relentlessly attack him. They subject him to physical and mental torture, encouraged by their adopted son. Until they discover the shocking truth—André is the one they were looking for. The Brandão family then do everything to beg for forgiveness while Vitor and Dinho plot revenge.
6a210e9bdd61d087070d184f.title: The Return of the Lost Striker

6a211c74b6d9a41c8b01403f.synopsis: In High Society movie, Adele was born with nothing: no last name, no family, no home. But then she meets Cesare Buonaparte. The Duke. The most feared man on their island nation. And finally, she has a chance to become something more. To bring herself out of poverty and save her friend's life, she makes a deal with the Duke: she'll help him escape an arranged marriage by pretending to be his long-lost sister. Though he's the most gorgeous, infuriating man she's ever met, siblings—even fake ones—can never fall in love. So... why does he keep looking at her like that?
6a211c74b6d9a41c8b01403f.title: High Society

6a21d0a1ce8c0095bc03942d.synopsis: In Waterboy Second Down movie, three years after Kaden broke Donovan’s heart to save his NFL dreams, superstar quarterback Donovan Miller is back — and signed with the agency where Kaden is barely surviving as an intern. Donovan says he came to Boston for revenge… but the tension between them says otherwise. In a world that could destroy Donovan’s career if the truth comes out, falling for each other again might cost them everything.
6a21d0a1ce8c0095bc03942d.title: Waterboy: Second Down

6a21e90ced9cf53ee8067221.synopsis: Asher, Layla's mate, betrays her by eloping with her sister, Vivian, who was supposed to marry Lucian, the most dangerous Alpha King in history. To protect her pack, Layla agrees to marry Lucian in her place. Asher still believes Layla is his fiancée. Layla and Lucian, along with Asher and Vivian, hold their wedding ceremonies simultaneously. Just as Layla is about to leave, Asher realizes Vivian tricked him. In a frenzy, he grabs Layla, who's about to leave forever.
6a21e90ced9cf53ee8067221.title: Not the Bride He Wanted

6a2270e74a210587e3084099.synopsis: In the Frostmark Empire, locked in eternal winter, only a marriage between a princess of pure royal blood and the Abyss Dragon can bring back the warmth of the sun. Princess Diana grew up happy alongside her three brothers — until Lorelei arrived. Using a stolen Dragon's scale, Lorelei seized all of Diana's love and standing. Deceived, the three brothers cast Diana aside — even offering her as a sacrifice to slay the dragon. Only after the dragon took Diana away did the truth emerge. By then, it was too late.
6a2270e74a210587e3084099.title: My Brothers Begged, But I'm the Dragon's Queen

6a28d7fbc02b070e9301f2cd.synopsis: Five young models go to an Airbnb in the woods for a full moon that comes once every five hundred years. What starts off as the perfect girl's trip quickly becomes a nightmare as a pack of ancient werewolves are awoken by the new moon.
6a28d7fbc02b070e9301f2cd.title: Models vs. Werewolves

6a2b00f6fb5ac0e51f0b87c9.synopsis: The York family, the most powerful, wealthy family in the nation, is rumored to have gone bankrupt. Even though the rumors aren't true, word spreads, and the Yorks watch as their allied families turn on them. The Wilson and Meyer families turn from trusted kin into violent, abusive monsters, hell-bent on destroying the Yorks. At back-to-back events, a wedding and a 70th birthday party, the Yorks face a deluge of abuse and humiliation from the Wilsons and Meyers, respectively, putting the survival of their family name to the ultimate test. Can the Yorks overcome the doubters, abusers, and haters? Will they clear their name, and reestablish their rightful standing as the most powerful family in all the land?
6a2b00f6fb5ac0e51f0b87c9.title: We Never Said We Went Bankrupt!

6a2b043eb06e7104e409f8ae.synopsis: In Don't Toy with My Heart, Mr. Billionaire movie, adult toy designer Holly is forced to sign a contract marriage with arms dealer Derek after her company’s cash flow collapses. What begins as a simple exchange of interests spirals out of control as they move in together and face escalating crises. Derek is cold, dominant, and in total control, yet he begins to waver in the face of Holly’s resilience and kindness. Holly appears soft on the surface, but she grows stronger with every scheme, betrayal, and wound, learning to fight back. Caught between desire and genuine emotion, they move from using each other to saving each other, confirming their feelings through danger and misunderstanding, and ultimately breaking the contract to choose real love.
6a2b043eb06e7104e409f8ae.title: Don't Toy with My Heart, Mr. Billionaire

6a2b0693f7fda4bb29086262.synopsis: After Quinn gives herself a makeover to get back at her neighbor and bully Cam, she becomes the subject of a schoolwide bet for her virginity. With every guy (and even some of the girls) chasing after Quinn, but how far will she go until she realizes the one guy sabotaging her every attempt is the only one who actually wants her?
6a2b0693f7fda4bb29086262.title: Virginity Pact

6a2b076bbe129b998d0fa894.synopsis: In Fiancée's Betrayal Dante's Inferno movie, Dante Bosch returns home after 3 years in the Marine Raiders on a top secret mission, only to discover not only is his fiancée Lilith pregnant with his brother Virgil's baby, but Virgil has also spent all his money. To add insult to injury, his parents take Virgil's side. After suffering betrayals and humiliations, Dante exposes Virgil's lies with a video at his wedding.
6a2b076bbe129b998d0fa894.title: Fiancée's Betrayal, Dante's Inferno

6a2bc46eb4f65096b30939f1.synopsis: Elena, the biological daughter of the wealthy Delaney family, was framed by her adopted sister Sarah in a car accident. Wrongfully accused of drunk driving, she was sentenced to ten years in prison. Nobody believed her. Famous sculptor Leo helped her take a new identity. Flora grew into a renowned sculptor. When she returned, Sarah accused her of being an ex-con and plagiarizing artworks. Flora fought back, exposing Sarah's lies. Sarah was the bastard daughter of Elena's dad. Sarah got punished. Flora cut ties with the cold family and started a new life with her lover Marc.
6a2bc46eb4f65096b30939f1.title: The Real Heiress Reclaims Her Place

6a31012f0a4db3ff73065e0f.synopsis: On mating night, Charlie is claimed by the Alpha and his Beta. By morning, she's publicly declared "unsatisfactory" and replaced. But when she discovers she can hear their private mind-link—and their chosen mate can't—the question becomes: if she was never meant for them, why is she the only one who feels the bond?
6a31012f0a4db3ff73065e0f.title: Mated to the Alpha and His Beta

6a32d64da3959ea0d306be2f.synopsis: In Death Touch movie, Ivy was raised in a lab because her touch can kill — an ability she doesn’t understand and can’t control. Now, she’s been sent to a military high school to become the government’s greatest weapon. Xaden, the elite soldier forced to train her, hates that she’s replacing him. But as they grow closer, the one thing Ivy wants most—to be touched—might kill the only person who’s ever cared about her.
6a32d64da3959ea0d306be2f.title: Death Touch

6a33069240a92351870a1179.synopsis: Based on the novel by Monica Murphy. At an elite prep school ruled by legacy and power, Whit Lancaster is untouchable—dangerous, ruthless, and irresistibly magnetic. Then, a quiet outsider crashes into his path, and is faced with a dark bargain: Let him destroy her in private… or risk being ruined in public. In a game of power, desire, and secrets—who will break first?
6a33069240a92351870a1179.title: Things I Wanted to Say

6a33101c56c0faf2ce013299.synopsis: Grace, a high school princess and Colt, her family's groundskeeper, are deeply in love. However, when Colt learns he has only months to live, he decides he'll do anything to push her away -- to help her let him go. Admist the misunderstandings and heartbreaks, will Grace find out the truth in time, or will she lose the only boy she's loved to the cruel fate without having a chance to say goodbye?
6a33101c56c0faf2ce013299.title: Teach Me How to Say Goodbye

6a33149d4dd31b5f0506cc09.synopsis: In the King of War Tech movie, Wesley Creed, the King of War Tech, hides his identity in order to keep his dead squadmates' research alive, only to be treated like dirt. 3 years later, he's ready to reclaim his identity.
6a33149d4dd31b5f0506cc09.title: King of War Tech

6a331cd1d5cb2422d00af359.synopsis: After his girlfriend dumps him, Eric, a luxury brand CEO with X-ray vision, uses his powers and confidence to bring down arrogant
6a331cd1d5cb2422d00af359.title: My X-Ray Vision Sees Right Through You

6a3321d8db2a78841b024cd9.synopsis: Based on the novel by Sarah Brianne. Elle's life is turned upside down when Nero, the untouchable bad boy, swoops in to save her from her school bully. One smile from him makes every girl swoon, Elle couldn't believe he wants her. Gazing into his eyes, she wonders if this notorious bad boy could be trusted... How was she to know that she was just a part of Nero's mission, as the heir to a Mafia Empire? As for Nero, he has somehow fallen head over heels for this girl who has no idea the danger she was in.
6a3321d8db2a78841b024cd9.title: Nero: Made Men

6a390a35f7ae1d26f00331c5.synopsis: Elena, the daughter of the Lord of Yalkreon, ventures out in search of sacred tree sap to save her mother from a deadly ice curse. Along the way, she unexpectedly rescues Hades, King of the Underworld, who immediately decides to make her his queen. But Elena is betrayed by her fiancé, then forcibly sold as a sacrifice to the Lord of the Frostlands by her cruel stepmother and greedy father. Just as all hope is lost during the sacrificial ceremony, Hades descends in overwhelming force, punishes everyone who has wronged her, and takes her back to the Underworld under his protection.
6a390a35f7ae1d26f00331c5.title: Chained by Hades, the Underworld King

6a39e60d9206d01df60805df.synopsis: Given a second chance at life, orphan sisters Ivy and Poppy return to the day of their adoption. Remembering her tragic past, Poppy maliciously chooses the impoverished Jones family, believing playing the "poor girl" is the secret to winning the wealthy Lockwood heir's heart. Forced into the toxic Lockwood household, Ivy refuses to be a victim again. While Poppy relies on deception and manipulation to steal the life she covets, Ivy focuses on true independence, standing up to her bullies, and forging her own path. Reborn, I Gifted Her My Hell is a gripping tale of resilience, self-reliance, and breaking toxic cycles.
6a39e60d9206d01df60805df.title: Reborn, I Gifted Her My Hell

6a3d1836ade141bc9d0a7026.synopsis: Best friends Ella and Leah married the Harper brothers, firefighter Charles and doctor Noah. On their third anniversary, Charles’s first love locks Ella inside a burning room. When Ella begs Charles for help, he brushes her off to find his ex's cat. Leah rushes in to rescue Ella and calls Noah to save Ella and her baby, but is met with mockery. Heartbroken and betrayed after years of miserable marriages, the best friends decide to file for divorce from the Harper brothers together.
6a3d1836ade141bc9d0a7026.title: Brides in Smoke

6a3d730b0112aac7e20ddfff.synopsis: After Carl Oliver, The American Sniper and King of Guns, heroically dies saving a little boy named Spencer from a car explosion, his spirit is magically transferred into Spencer's 9 year old body. Now Carl, while inside the body of a 9 year old boy, must save his new family's gun range from unscrupulous relatives, evil rivals, and even deranged killers.
6a3d730b0112aac7e20ddfff.title: American Sniper: The Kid of Guns

6a3d9547091cd749a8093d65.synopsis: In Her Billionaire Father Spoils Her Rotten movie, Genius hacker Abby was the Governor's adoptive daughter, enduring years of abuse to help him seize power. Yet, right before her 18th birthday, her adoptive father sells her to a lecherous businessman for $5 million. In despair, she uses DNA matching to find her biological father—America's top tycoon, Dominic Mancini. Back in the lap of luxury, Abby not only inherits trillions but also has three elite adopted brothers, each a titan in his own right, to protect her. At her grand coming-of-age ceremony, Abby makes a magnificent return as the sole heir, publicly unmasking her adoptive family's cruelty and making those who once bullied her pay dearly. Reborn from the ashes, she will begin her brilliant life at the pinnacle of power.
6a3d9547091cd749a8093d65.title: Her Billionaire Father Spoils Her Rotten

6a3d980baaf954b86307ecc4.synopsis: In Rise of the Caged King movie, once a business elite, Silas is framed for murder by his rival Chase and his own wife Marina. Sentenced to 60 years, Silas endures brutal humiliation from prison bullies until he meets Grayson, a legendary mafia godfather in hiding. Grayson trains him in lethal combat and helps reduce his sentence in exchange for a future favor of revenge. Meanwhile, young Ella suffers Marina’s abuse while secretly discovering the truth: her mother’s affair and her father’s innocence. Three years later, Silas is released. He crashes Marina’s engagement party like a ghost from the past, ready to strike. Armed with a father’s love, he begins his war to reclaim his life and rescue his daughter from hell.
6a3d980baaf954b86307ecc4.title: Rise of the Caged King

6a3d99936928d9c1f409ed59.synopsis: After years of torment and abuse from her mafia family, Francesca Adolfi is given a second chance at life when she's sent back to age fourteen, the day she was brought back to her birth father. But this time, she's not going to make the same mistakes. This time, she chooses to ally herself with the Adolfi's disgraced eldest son, Enzo, and help him retake his place as heir. And by saving him, maybe Francesca can save herself too.
6a3d99936928d9c1f409ed59.title: Mafia Princess Returns

6a4358c4abdd23a03d0d6563.synopsis: Ever since their parents married, Becca has hated her stepbrother, Samir. For two years, she's blamed him for stealing her family, her home, and the life she lost. But when a brutal heatwave knocks out the AC, they’re trapped alone in a house that’s far too hot—and far too small. As Samir struggles to fix the broken air conditioner, lingering resentment gives way to lingering touches. The line between hate and desire begins to disappear, and Becca must face the one truth. She's spent years denying that the man she's forbidden to want may be the only one she can't resist.
6a4358c4abdd23a03d0d6563.title: The Heat After the AC Died

6a43729bfd4df5cb34078482.synopsis: At Asgard Academy, underdog Elena is relentlessly bullied for her pathetically weak magic. Ice-cold, stoic Professor Cassius notices her for one thing. Her scent feels hauntingly familiar, and it inexplicably awakens his long-sealed curse mark. He offers her private tutoring as cover, helping her rein in her wildly unstable magic. Until he makes the shocking discovery...
6a43729bfd4df5cb34078482.title: The Professor’s Forbidden Dragon Prey

6a469b12d3f5c65f7f095b8a.synopsis: To Jason, Tessa was only a disposable practice run for the girl he actually wanted. After the blood on the sheets became a public trophy and her dignity a ghost, young Tessa finally stops trying to mend the shards. She is done with her first love. She is leaving him behind for a future that doesn't taste like salt and shame. But at the edge of the wreckage stands the one person who shouldn’t be there: another boy with no intention of letting her go alone.
6a469b12d3f5c65f7f095b8a.title: You've Been Replaced, First Love

6a4bde37cdb434b20e085b0a.synopsis: Clara fakes amnesia to test her boyfriend—only to catch him cheating and watch him toss her aside for his best friend, Ethan. Big mistake. For the ultimate payback, Clara starts fake-dating Ethan to drive her ex insane with jealousy. But what happens when Ethan’s fake kisses start to feel dangerously real?
6a4bde37cdb434b20e085b0a.title: Faking It with My Ex's Best Friend

6a4c5f016de432c9700fa3e9.synopsis: Scorned by her husband, Kate drowns her sorrows in a bar—and wakes up next to a gorgeous escort named Felix. She pays him off. He won't let it go. When he shows up at her door, she offers a deal: "How much?" But Felix isn't just any gigolo—he's a billionaire duke in disguise. Soon she's riding private jets, dripping in jewels, and watching her cheating ex get publicly destroyed. Then comes the pregnancy—and her ex's desperate plea for forgiveness. Now Kate must choose: the gilded cage of marriage, or the wild, impossible truth of a love she never saw coming. Too bad Felix isn't giving her a choice. The ultimate showdown between two worlds is about to begin.
6a4c5f016de432c9700fa3e9.title: One Night or Forever

6a4c65459ed73db2bf073c2d.synopsis: At my own Mate Claim Ceremony, Cassian rejected me and took my sister Maris’s hand, claiming he only wanted to save her from the Council. Then he tried to rip my dead mother’s moonstone necklace from my neck so Maris could wear it as his chosen Luna. The chain broke. So did the last reason I had to wait for him. In three days, the Council would send me to Rowan Vale, the Lycan king’s dying heir. Everyone pitied me. But Rowan was the first man to ask if I chose him freely.
6a4c65459ed73db2bf073c2d.title: My Sister Stole My Mate, So I Married a King

6a4f34b3b0d1ee9f560c3f6e.synopsis: I’ve been dreading my eighteenth birthday for as long as I can remember. My mating day was even worse than I could have imagined. Not only was I mated to the Alpha and the Beta, they don’t want me. Publicly cast aside for another woman, I fled into the wilderness, entirely unaware that I was actually a forbidden wolf-vampire hybrid. To protect me from a corrupt Council, my family wiped my memories, leaving me stranded in a rogue town as "Katie"—heavily pregnant and completely lost. But my past violently caught up when my mates and their secret Alpha brother, Mason, tracked me down. With a dark conspiracy now targeting my newborn daughter to breed a lethal hybrid army, I must survive a volatile web of dangerous desires to protect my child before a brutal war consumes us all.
6a4f34b3b0d1ee9f560c3f6e.title: The Alpha and Beta's Shared Mate

6a500e84492dec4b5a02f556.synopsis: In Nothing Escapes My Eyes movie, Liam is a delivery driver cuckolded by his gold-digging girlfriend. One day, he gets hit by a car belonging to Ivy, a gorgeous CEO. From the accident, he gains the superpower of "God's Sight', allowing him to see how much time is left in people’s lives, as well as the true value of things.
6a500e84492dec4b5a02f556.title: Nothing Escapes My Eyes

6a50162231243f4ece0229b8.synopsis: In I'll Make Your Daddy Mine movie, all her life, farm girl Lenore Williams has been bullied by spoiled heiress Ada Thornton. When Ada steals Lenore's fiance and kills her father, Lenore swears revenge - by seducing Ada's hot bachelor father, the mysterious mogul of Thornton Estates. It's all for revenge, so why does he make her feel things she's never felt before?
6a50162231243f4ece0229b8.title: I'll Make Your Daddy Mine

6a5191d8fa9f9f7a09081789.synopsis: Elijah Baran is a genie in a magic lamp who can grant three wishes. After thousands of years, a billionaire uses his last wish to grant Elijah freedom, but on one condition, Elijah must marry his granddaughter, Christine, for five years! To fulfill the wish, Elijah transforms into a human, marries Christine, and secretly helps her become a successful CEO. However, Christine ignores and constantly belittles him during their marriage. When the five years are almost up, Elijah starts to realize that Christine might never truly love him. He decides to divorce her.
6a5191d8fa9f9f7a09081789.title: The Great and Powerful Genie

6a547c258e7dc74d870b30af.synopsis: In The Valkyrie Divorces the God of War movie, to protect his wife, God King Kairos sealed his divine powers and feigned being a worthless mortal. Instead of gratitude, Cassia returned bearing her lover's child, demanding the family relic while humiliating him publicly. Driven past his limit, Kairos shattered his shackles, awakening his supreme godhood. He exposed her lover as an abyssal spy, leading to the traitor's execution. Begging for mercy, Cassia fled in exile, as the God King reclaimed his absolute throne.
6a547c258e7dc74d870b30af.title: The Valkyrie Divorces the God of War

6a55cba42bfaaef26f0f5299.synopsis: Wren is labeled wolfless and abandoned by her childhood lover Tristan at his coronation, who publicly rejects their mate bond and lets his lover cut her hair. Heartbroken, she leaves the Dark Moon pack and enters the elite Apex Academy. There, she awakens the rare powerful White Wolf bloodline hidden inside her. With the quiet Frost heir Killian's support, Wren defeats rivals, uncovers Vaelen's evil plot that preys on wolfkin's blood power, and rescues her dad. She stands side by side with Killian to build a new order where no one is forced to kneel for power.
6a55cba42bfaaef26f0f5299.title: The Lycan's Savage Luna

6a56dd826a410e5f5d04c33b.synopsis: In Zero to Alpha Return of the Wolf King movie, exiled for failing to awaken his wolf form, Nory trained twenty years under three Masters beyond Sacred Rank. Returning to see his mother, he enters the Clan Tournament, shatters the test stone, crushes every foe, and is revealed as the savior three Gold Leaders sought. When vampires invade, he slams the Legendary First Sire through seven walls. Learning his mother was injured saving him, he gathers three sacred relics to heal her. But crimson eyes in distant mist hint a greater threat.
6a56dd826a410e5f5d04c33b.title: Zero to Alpha: Return of the Wolf King

6a575df904e2a3e52d00406b.synopsis: One drunken night, one humiliating ex, fake-date her worst enemy Blake or watch the Greenharts lose every point because of her. Hannah signs the contract expecting torture. Instead, she finds the cold, untouchable rival everyone fears has a side no one's ever seen, fiercely protective, quietly devoted, and hiding a secret of his own. When the pretending stops feeling like pretending, is it still an act? Then her ex Tristan discovers the truth—Hannah is Miss H, the anonymous genius the whole school idolizes. Now he's on his knees, begging for a second chance. Two boys, one choice.
6a575df904e2a3e52d00406b.title: The Fake Dating Spell

6a580b359cc3a55a2b08ad6d.synopsis: She came to town for a fresh start. Instead, Penelope Harris got pregnant by her ex’s powerful older brother, Knox Grant– the rugged cowboy who owns the ranch where she works. Now Penelope is caught between the man who would burn the world down for her and her ex, who wants to see her burn.
6a580b359cc3a55a2b08ad6d.title: Keeping the Cowboy's Baby

6a580e0abaa3c12b130cb57d.synopsis: In How to Wreck My Bully's Heart movie, Kristina Cooper's a scholarship student by day, online masked singer by night. She's got the perfect internet boyfriend in Dax – sweet, caring, and supportive – until she finds out he's Daxter, the monsterous thug who's been bullying her at school! Will she forgive Dexter, the damaged, broken boy she once loved, or will their anonymous love end in Dexter's never ending regret as Kristina choses a brighter future without him?
6a580e0abaa3c12b130cb57d.title: How to Wreck My Bully's Heart

6a60170b103930ddda06a0a9.synopsis: Karter, the legendary Poker King lost everything when he reported Aaron for money laundering 3 years ago. He was rescued by Elena, the daughter of a small casino's owner. When Aaron returns to put Elena and the casino in danger, Karter gives up his disguise as a humble waiter, and reveals his true identity.
6a60170b103930ddda06a0a9.title: The Poker King Returns

6a601869953a7d189a0267a9.synopsis: Lucas Thorne, a powerful demigod disguised as a beggar finally finds love with a mafia heiress who accepts him at his lowest—but when danger closes in, he must reveal his true identity to protect her, risking the secret he was bound to keep.
6a601869953a7d189a0267a9.title: Her Man Is the Son of Death

6a616fcbc063a1f59108d8ca.synopsis: Exiled half-beast prince Cassian storms back from the dead, slaughters his father, and seizes the throne in a bloodbath. His first prey, Vera, the ice-cold former queen. The woman who crushed their love for a crown, married his father, and cast him into the beast pit to rot. Consumed by rage, the ruthless new king forces his stepmother into his bed as his personal captive and swears to kill Lucian, Vera's royal son with the dead king. Then a bombshell drops. His so-called half-brother shares his rare, exclusive beast blood. Vera has hidden the truth of Lucian's identity.
6a616fcbc063a1f59108d8ca.title: Crowned in His Claws

6a6175020e58adb4bc0cafae.synopsis: In 2006, Marcel "The Sniper" Wallace wins THE LEAGUE title, then loses his wife to rival Tyler Murray's hitman. He vanishes into a fast-food job for twenty years. Lured back as coach, he reunites with his resentful son Mars, a LEAGUE star. Marcel proves himself through impossible shots while Murray escalates to kidnapping and blackmail. At the Hall of Fame, Marcel reveals his identity and Murray confesses to murder. Victory comes when Mars accepts twenty unsent birthday letters and they embrace.
6a6175020e58adb4bc0cafae.title: Full Court Legend

6a62971687b70290eb03ff9a.synopsis: In Marry Me Twice, Mr. Grant movie, everyone's always told Nora to keep her head down and stay silent, but there's one exception — Vince Grant, her husband. As their contract marriage comes to an end after the best year of her life, Nora is faced with returning to her abusive family, who are already plotting to marry her off again. Always the calm, collected CEO, Vince finds himself desperate for a chance to win Nora over, even though she left him without looking back. He watches Nora shrink back into the shell he spent a year coaxing her out of, and decides enough is enough. Whether it's as the best "ex-husband" the world's ever seen, or Nora's real husband, with no contract between them, he'll protect her with everything he has.
6a62971687b70290eb03ff9a.title: Marry Me Twice, Mr. Grant

6a629f5ea1c787017500913a.synopsis: A lifetime ago, figure skating prodigy Gwen Tyler was at the top of her game and on her way to Olympic gold. But ten years later, she's stuck in a loveless engagement and a shadow of her former self. Then, her childhood best friend Aaron Lansing comes back into her life after a decade apart, and Gwen starts to realize... maybe the love she's been missing is the one she had when she was eighteen. Now she has to decide whether she's just going to keep letting life happen to her, or take back control for herself.
6a629f5ea1c787017500913a.title: Take Me Back to the Night We Met

6a62a25bff3dc346ee01104a.synopsis: In Honey-Trapped My Fiancé's Billionaire Rival movie, after ten years of loving Ryan, Jade Gray is asked to seduce his billionaire rival, Asher Blackwood, to help save Ryan’s first love, Eleanor. But Asher secretly has feelings for Jade, turning Ryan’s carefully planned scheme into a dangerous love triangle. As Jade grows closer to Asher, she begins to question who truly deserves her love.
6a62a25bff3dc346ee01104a.title: Honey-Trapped My Fiancé's Billionaire Rival

6a631d4b7f6e39aad1061157.synopsis: Leo, the legendary surfing champion, loses his title to a mysterious newcomer named Ruslan. But the biggest shock comes when he discovers that Ruslan is the man from his unforgettable night. Forced into an uneasy partnership, the two rivals find themselves drawn to each other as secrets, danger, and betrayal close in. Behind their battle for glory lies a hidden truth about Ruslan—and their forbidden desire has only just begun...
6a631d4b7f6e39aad1061157.title: Caught in His Current

6a63772975b2eafae30ae379.synopsis: Reese Calder orders a custom companion android, 006, with the face of Nolan Vance, her spoiled, maddening lifelong rival. By day, 006 cooks, cleans, and kneels when she says, "Down." By night, he breaks every command and makes her forget he is supposed to be a machine. Then Kindred Care texts: "Your companion hasn't shipped yet." Nolan calls it a prank. Miles calls it suicide: "If Reese finds the truth, you're done." But Reese finds the truth anyway, and now the liar is still kneeling.
6a63772975b2eafae30ae379.title: My Sex Robot Has My Enemy's Face

6a66b7bd7fa17f5a6102246c.synopsis: Cora took in three wounded wolves and raised them. The moment her sister Vivian appeared, the wolves couldn't look away—they turned cold and rough, trying to break Cora. She overheard them mocking her. So she offered a trade: three wolves for Vivian's snake. Silas the snake was ice-cold, yet he stayed—doing chores, guarding her. When her family forced an arranged marriage, Cora faked agreement, then fled through a window on her wedding day.
