Silas tracked her to the airport, injuring two wolves who tried to stop him. “You'll never get rid of me,” he said. Cora took over the family business and bonded with Silas. The cold snake was truer than any wolf.
6a66b7bd7fa17f5a6102246c.title: Traded My Wolves for a Snake

6a670d5c4fc3fdef560395e8.synopsis: Tessa’s crush throws her cinnamon roll in the trash and calls her a fat pig in front of the whole class. When she finally stops begging to be chosen, she starts glowing up and catches everyone’s eye, including the boy who destroyed her. But Tessa has already chosen Adrian, the masked outcast everyone calls scarred and pathetic. By the time Chase wants her back, Adrian’s secret is out: he was never weak. He was the richest, most dangerous boy in the room.
6a670d5c4fc3fdef560395e8.title: The Ugly Girl Turned Pretty

6a672bc50dc68f56a409f670.synopsis: In Sold to the Warlord Born for the Sky movie, a sheltered northern princess who was sold into marriage to the dragon-riding warlord of the brutal Blackclaw horde must decide whether surrendering to the man who bought her is her greatest betrayal or the only thing that can save her dying people.
6a672bc50dc68f56a409f670.title: Sold to the Warlord, Born for the Sky

6a6733958d893bb4600e0595.synopsis: Erin Vance’s 18th wedding anniversary turns into a nightmare when she discovers her husband Derek cheating with her best friend Sofia. Betrayed and abandoned, Erin is forced to start over with nothing. With help from Gavin Bower, she enters the “Miss Intercontinental” contest and rises from a housewife to a champion through her talent and determination. Defeating Sofia and exposing her scandals, Erin rebuilds her life. Gavin, secretly the president of K Group, supports her while letting her prove herself. After overcoming betrayal and danger, Erin regains her dignity and begins a new chapter with Gavin.
6a6733958d893bb4600e0595.title: I Became the CEO's Most Beloved

6a67cca11ec24d81c80639bc.synopsis: Based on the novel by Cora Reilly. As the heir to the Chicago mafia, Dante is logical to a fault. The only thing Valentina has in common with him is being a widow. When Dante chooses her as his next wife, it's a business decision made by a man still haunted from losing the love of his life. But Valentina won't repeat the lovelessness of her first marriage. As she struggles with her own desire for her new husband, little does she know -- his heart may have already started beating for her.
6a67cca11ec24d81c80639bc.title: Bound by Duty

6a67d06112cc28505607205a.synopsis: In God of Pain movie, a sheltered mafia princess tries to escape an arranged marriage, only to fall for the school’s most dangerous bad boy. But he refuses to love her… Until he can’t let her go.
6a67d06112cc28505607205a.title: God of Pain

6a6848570706aa908c0a81f9.synopsis: Luca Conri is the wolf-less runt of the Nightreign Pack, whose bark is bigger than his bite. Tormented by his own pack and hunted by rivals, Luca is reluctantly put under the protection of his dominant Alpha, and older brother's best friend, Dalton. However, everything changes when the two become fated mates, a bond that violates the natural order of the pack. As enemies close in and traditions try to tear them apart, Luca and Dalton must decide if they want to give into their lustful temptations in a forbidden romance that threatens their own lives.
6a6848570706aa908c0a81f9.title: Fated to His Brother's Alpha

6a686012cd3a8257390f38c9.synopsis: At Waverly University, the ice rink is split in two: on one side, the hockey team trains with brutal intensity; on the other, the figure skating team glides through elegant routines. Abby Williams is the golden girl of the ballet-on-ice program — obedient, disciplined, and desperate to land the lead role of the Black Swan in the Winter Showcase. There's just one problem: she has no idea how to be "bad." Enter Tristan Beaumont, the university's most notorious playboy and captain of the hockey team — reckless, magnetic, and hiding a devastating secret behind his bad-boy reputation. When Abby asks him to teach her how to unleash her dark side, neither of them expects what happens next: a forbidden attraction neither can control. Standing between them is Taylor Beaumont, Tristan's younger brother — Abby's skating partner, her best friend, and the "good" Beaumont everyone expects her to choose. As rumors, sabotage, and a jealous rival threaten to destroy everything Abby has worked for, she must decide who she really wants — and who she's willing to fight for. Torn between two brothers, a forbidden romance, and the role of a lifetime, Abby will learn that becoming the Black Swan means learning to stop following the rules — and start listening to her heart.
6a686012cd3a8257390f38c9.title: Offside with the Hockey Star

6a699eaa437c05bf2f08576c.synopsis: Ethan Cole, a top-tier aviation legend in his previous life, dies as a national aviation legend. He is reborn as an 8-year-old boy on the same flight where he once flew with his father. Only this time, he knows the truth: Flight 8236 is going to crash, and everyone on board will die. At 9,000 meters above sea level, fire begins to burn along the wings. The fuselage cracks open into freezing air. As panic spreads across the cabin, Ethan realizes he is the only one who understands what is coming. Trapped in a child’s body, he must stop the disaster and save his father—the man he loves most—before it is too late.
6a699eaa437c05bf2f08576c.title: The Eight-Year-Old Captain

6a69d75694d45d05cf089596.synopsis: A gifted contract mage, Layla, spent her past life collecting ninety-nine sacred cores to help her contracted beast, the Sacred Whale Neil, take human form—only to have Neil pierce her heart and push her into the Bloodtide Trench the moment he transformed. Reborn on the day of the contract ceremony, Layla abandons the Sacred Whale and chooses a dying little spirit snake instead. Neil, now in human form, teams up with her sister Evelyn to humiliate her, but the little snake turns out to be Poseidon, the Sea Emperor. As past betrayals and old wounds resurface, Neil kneels in regret—too late. Only Poseidon stands by her side. This time, Layla will never waste herself on the unworthy again, and finally learns to live for herself.
6a69d75694d45d05cf089596.title: After the Sacred Whale Betrayed Me, I Contracted Poseidon

6a6ab69baaeb8126f103b73a.synopsis: To discover who truly loves them, wealthy couple Hannah and her husband fake bankruptcy, with him pretending to be paralyzed after a stroke. Their test exposes the truth: their biological son Thomas and his wife refuse to help and turn them away, while adopted son Theo and his wife give up everything to save him. After learning the truth, Hannah and her husband leave their $50 million fortune to Theo. Thomas loses everything and finally realizes that true family is built on love, not blood.
6a6ab69baaeb8126f103b73a.title: The Billionaire Parents' Final Test

6a6afb1f12895345d90f1e50.synopsis: No mate, no wolf, and raising a pup alone, Ella never expected one act of kindness to tie her fate to Alpha Torin, who is cursed to never touch a woman. When she becomes the wet nurse to his newborn heir, Ella is pulled into a deadly game of jealousy and betrayal inside the Alpha's keep.
6a6afb1f12895345d90f1e50.title: Thirsty for the Wet Nurse

6a6b2207a6fa584bc0046f6e.synopsis: After surviving a month of kidnapping and torture, Claire returns home with severe PTSD, only to be misunderstood and humiliated by her brother Maxwell and her family. As her trauma becomes impossible to ignore, Maxwell begins to doubt his judgment — but when Claire gives up on ten years of love and walks away, he finally realizes the truth was never what he believed.
6a6b2207a6fa584bc0046f6e.title: Once Love Is Lost, It Never Returns

6a6bbe2e5e4b2a215007cf69.synopsis: Sit back, relax, and let Jesse Morales guide you through a sultry reading of Sweet Temptation. Immerse yourself in Cassio's world as Jesse brings every moment of tension to life. This captivating reading transports you into the seductive mafia romance behind one of the year's most beloved book-to-screen adaptations.
6a6bbe2e5e4b2a215007cf69.title: ReelTalk EP 85-Sweet Temptation: Chapter Reading with Jesse Morales

6a700666eef7d6f5550a0b27.synopsis: In I’m Pregnant It’s Not Yours movie, husband prefers secretary, who looks like his white moonlight, over his wife Iris. Calmly, Iris asks for a divorce, revealing that the baby she's carrying isn't his. Five years later, she returns powerfully with her new flame, while Husband is left drowning in regret.
6a700666eef7d6f5550a0b27.title: I’m Pregnant, It’s Not Yours

6a7148b271f37e5a1d0e518d.synopsis: Kaelen Ashfell bought me at the Mate Auction for a fortune. Three years later, after I gave him three hatchlings, his first love came back, and he crossed my name out of his Bond Ledger like I was property to return. He handed me and our babies to his brother Roran, then let his first love tear apart my den, my garden, and even hurt our child. Kael thought regret could bring me back. But the mate he discarded was about to learn what it felt like to be protected by someone else.
6a7148b271f37e5a1d0e518d.title: The Auctioned Mate

6a718008e9f96f29f507ec5f.synopsis: In 1911, amid New York’s Gilded Age, Evelyn Hart, a rural English schoolteacher, voyages across the ocean for love, only to suffer
6a718008e9f96f29f507ec5f.title: The Atlantic Bride

6a71aad3d35a1776dd0e357d.synopsis: When James loses his daughter Amy and his legs on the same day, he stops believing in magic. Little does he know, Amy is now Mia, a fortune-telling prodigy come to save James from his fatal bad karma.
6a71aad3d35a1776dd0e357d.title: Little Miss Fortune

6a7295ece52ae6cfe901ca85.synopsis: Sawyer is a quarterback prodigy, but his mom Marnie always ignores him in favor of his adopted brother, Ben, even when Ben frames Sawyer, steals his MVP title, and ruins his future. Heartbroken, Sawyer vows to make his mom realize just how much she hurt him and how much she's lost.
6a7295ece52ae6cfe901ca85.title: The Son Rises Alone

6a7296b9d0e875c4150ea9e9.synopsis: After claiming her fifth World Culinary Championship, the legendary Chef Sage goes undercover as a homeless beggar to find a partner with genuine character. Ignored by the masses and ruthlessly mocked by her ex, she encounters Jasper, a kind-hearted man who offers her his food. Desperate to save his family's failing restaurant from a vicious corporate takeover, Jasper hires Sage to play his wealthy fake fiancée. As rival factions push the Vance family to the brink with a high-stakes "Culinary Death Match," all hope seems lost. But when cornered, the beggar bride sheds her disguise. With a flash of her blade and her signature blue flame, she turns the tables against world-class chefs, exposing her true identity and sparking a legendary romance.
6a7296b9d0e875c4150ea9e9.title: My Homeless Bride Is a Culinary Legend

6a72d8a9a4caeefb6102148b.synopsis: Caleb Shaw calls BDSM a cure for his dead marriage, then chains his wife Mara to a tree for his mistress. When Mara says the safe word, he leaves with the key. By sunrise, Nina’s hired men find her. But Caleb never knew what Mara buried for this marriage. She was not just his wife. She was the woman who once owned the West Side docks. Now the collar, the blood, and the betrayal will drag every Shaw secret into the light.
6a72d8a9a4caeefb6102148b.title: My Safe Word Was Revenge

6a72f122a2ed0db5070b250d.synopsis: Owen — discarded heir of the Hull family, the one and only disciple of the master of the Dragon Knight Sanctum. He awakens the Ten
6a72f122a2ed0db5070b250d.title: Abandoned Pawn, Unrivaled Dragon King

6a732af43810ec89a30584cf.synopsis: Five years ago, Elena Hartwell broke up with her college boyfriend Killian Thorne to protect him from her ruthless uncle Victor—making him believe she was a gold-digger. Heartbroken, Killian returned to his family's trillion-dollar empire, while Elena was framed by Victor and imprisoned, where she gave birth to their daughter Luna. Now, brave 4-year-old Luna tracks down Killian at his corporate headquarters, shocking everyone by calling him "Daddy." After a DNA test confirms the truth, Killian learns of Elena's wrongful conviction and the sacrifices she made. With his power and resources, he sets out to free Elena, protect Luna from Victor's schemes, and win back the woman he never stopped loving.
6a732af43810ec89a30584cf.title: Mommy's Little Savior

6a737ed7c18545ffc201ea79.synopsis: In Bound by the Past movie, 8 years after Dante took a bullet for Valentina, a mafia war rages between Chicago and Las Vegas. With a world of bloodshed knocking on their door, they must decide how to protect their daughter, and their marriage.
6a737ed7c18545ffc201ea79.title: Bound by the Past

6a73e8221ba18f8dcb0e84b9.synopsis: After a devastating betrayal that decimates two powerful wolf packs, young Nora Reed is forced into a mating bond with Alpha Drake, her enemy, her savior, and the man who believes she's responsible for his family's death. For three years, Drake torments her, determined never to love her. But when he finally claims her body and then shoves her aside, Nora shatters. She cuts their magical soul-bond and disappears. Years later, she returns not as Nora Reed, but as Nadia Moon, heiress to a royal European pack, cloaked in wealth, power. Her mission is clear, protect her children, reclaim her power, and avoid Drake at all costs.
6a73e8221ba18f8dcb0e84b9.title: Crowned in Silver Blood

6a759aa8a6c28014960e4808.synopsis: On a snowy Thanksgiving, young healer Rita lives with her ungrateful uncle William and his cruel family. They exploit her powers, sabotage her feast, and secretly hire a thug to drive her away. Hunted and alone, she is rescued by mafia godfather Richard Genovese and his wife. Discovering their kindness and lack of an heir, they adopt her. On the journey, Rita's powers save them from crises, alarming Richard's rival. At the manor, she heals Richard's dying father, Arthur, and finds a lost heirloom. Her courage and abilities win the family's trust. Rita becomes a true Genovese, protecting her new family with everything she has.
6a759aa8a6c28014960e4808.title: The Godfather's Guardian Angel

6a75a8e09314bb5f390efc2d.synopsis: When Naomi accidentally summons Thanatos, the God of Death, a desperate kiss awakens his heart after ten thousand years. Revealed as his destined Bride of Death, Naomi is the only one who can break his curse, while the immortal reaper discovers that even a god can fall in love.
6a75a8e09314bb5f390efc2d.title: My Marriage with the God of Death

6a7619d41dcbbd8e12015bfe.synopsis: In Altarboy movie, after getting kicked out for being gay, 18-year-old Theo is dumped at a Catholic church to be "cured" — and finds his new priest is young, hot... and a huge jerk who makes Theo his personal altar boy. What starts as a game of temptation becomes a slow-burn obsession neither can pray away, but as the game turns real, both Theo and Alexander risk losing everything to a love neither of them is supposed to want.
6a7619d41dcbbd8e12015bfe.title: Altarboy

6a792e03ee704ba9f605ffb9.synopsis: In My Billionaire Boss Won't Let Me Quit movie, seeking a fresh start after years of managing crises, Grace takes on a new job, only to be swept into a fake marriage by her enigmatic boss, Mason. As their pretend arrangement blurs into undeniable passion, Grace falls deeper into his spell. But Mason is playing a far more dangerous game—and he has no intention of ever letting her go.
6a792e03ee704ba9f605ffb9.title: My Billionaire Boss Won't Let Me Quit

6a792f892dee9a176102157c.synopsis: In Shattered Vows movie, princess Venessa lived a sheltered life—until her sister was murdered. Stripped of her innocence in a single night, she must confront a devastating betrayal: her husband and best friend just helped the killer escape justice. The pampered princess is gone. Now she's coming for every last one of them, to take back the justice they owe her sister.
6a792f892dee9a176102157c.title: Shattered Vows

6a79353ca5472245d60215b3.synopsis: I’m Seraphina, ocean princess. In my last life, I loved shark lord Kael, yet he held me down while his lover Lira stabbed my heart with venom crystal. Reborn on my mate-picking day, I shocked everyone by choosing Rhys, the playful dragon eel playboy. Kael seethed, ignored me when assassins poisoned me, and knelt begging me to ditch Rhys later. But Lira’s fake fragility hides deadly malice—she just pushed me into deadly undertow. Can Rhys reach me before I drown?
6a79353ca5472245d60215b3.title: I Chose The Playboy Eel To Abandon My Shark Lover

6a7a194a6381c9b8fc06a1d9.synopsis: Cain Hunter, heir to the almighty Godfather, is back! He'll fight past mind-controlling schemers and threats haunting the shadows, whatever it takes to pass the ten trials his grandfather has set for him. But what if it all comes at a cost? What if it means losing the love of his life, Annalise?
6a7a194a6381c9b8fc06a1d9.title: Super Godfather 2: My Ex Dumped the Wrong Man

6a7a81a517f42fe9c400a799.synopsis: Five years ago, Tiffany was betrayed by her fiancé and best friend, poisoned, and left for dead while pregnant. She survived, but
6a7a81a517f42fe9c400a799.title: The Alpha and His Nanny Luna

6a7ade45f3da91a7740b6032.synopsis: Once a straight A freshman, Emma Lucas lost everything when Adrian Cole filmed her in bed and let her nudes spread across campus. He said her brother owed his sister a life, then made Emma pay for it. Three years later, Emma strips to keep Ryan alive, only to find Adrian in the VIP booth, paying men to humiliate her. “How did you get this cheap?” But when her family shatters and the truth about Lily resurfaces, Adrian’s revenge starts looking like the cruelest mistake of his life.
6a7ade45f3da91a7740b6032.title: My First Love Pays to Watch Me Strip

6a7bd0ea617617b70101f8ba.synopsis: In The Rockstar's Secret movie, Juniper is hopelessly, recklessly in love with Tristan—the dark, intoxicating rockstar who rules their campus. The catch? He’s her protective older brother Carter’s best friend, and as far as Tristan is concerned, Juniper is nothing more than an invisible little sister. Until the night the lights go out. Trapped in the pitch-black darkness, a wild, uninhibited flame ignites between them—a night of unforgettable passion with a mysterious girl whose face Tristan never saw. All he has to trace his secret lover is a delicate butterfly bracelet left behind, and the vivid memory of a butterfly birthmark. He is obsessively hunting for the stranger who shattered his world, unaware that the girl he craves is sitting right across his kitchen table. But if Tristan discovers Juniper was the woman in the dark, and if Carter finds out his best friend touched his sister, the fallout could destroy them all. Can a love born in the shadows survive the brutal light of truth?
6a7bd0ea617617b70101f8ba.title: The Rockstar's Secret

6a7d21ead4f206c4400f1499.synopsis: Based on the novel by bestselling author Cora Reilly. 21 year old Giulia Rizzo suddenly finds herself engaged to the ruthless crimelord Cassio Moretti against her will. Rumor has it he's responsible for the bloody, untimely death of his wife, whom Giulia is not only replacing as a wife, but as the mother of their two young children. Will rebellious Giulia manage to make a life for herself alongside Cassio, or will his refusal to let her into his heart create yet another broken marriage?
6a7d21ead4f206c4400f1499.title: Sweet Temptation

6a7d31e470be7cd955059ad9.synopsis: In 1849, the American West, poor dockworker William is betrayed by his lover and his boss, losing everything and becoming a slave laborer in a gold mine. On the brink of death, he awakens a mysterious "Golden Eye" that allows him to see through anything and uncover hidden treasures. From a powerless nobody to a legendary mining tycoon, William uses his extraordinary vision and intelligence to defeat the elites who once crushed him!
6a7d31e470be7cd955059ad9.title: King of Gold

6a7d37d954d2787d000968cc.synopsis: In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by mutant beasts, Kane is humanity's one and only War God — yet he hides his identity, secretl
6a7d37d954d2787d000968cc.title: Wasteland Sovereign

6a7e002a0b1fda126b0dd463.synopsis: Armand Procacci and Talia Wynzel go head-to-head in a Random Song and Dance Challenge, a fast-paced challenge where each round, they press a button to randomly determine a song they must sing or a dance move they must recreate. If they successfully complete the challenge, they stay dry. If they fail, they get splashed with water!
6a7e002a0b1fda126b0dd463.title: ReelTalk EP 87-Random Song and Dance Challenge with Armand and Talia

6a7e8d88d2bd828b3d09c462.synopsis: On her first day at Maple Elite Academy, transfer student Emma Parker does the unthinkable — she picks a fight with The Big Four, the untouchable heirs who rule the school. Tyrannical Rowan Calloway wants to break her. Golden-boy August Langford wants to protect her. But behind their masks, nothing is what it seems. The closer they get, the harder they fall — for the girl who was never meant to belong in their world. Enemies… or childhood friends? When it comes to Rowan and August, the answer is never simple. Who will she choose?
6a7e8d88d2bd828b3d09c462.title: Taming My Bullies 1-3

6a826d6cfbecc43db80d69ac.synopsis: Straight-A bookworm Georgia Pruitt accidentally shoves rockstar Riot Cross off his stage, so her strict father ships her to Silver Pines reform camp, where Riot's label sends him too. Bound as accountability buddies, the enemies fall in love through bullying storms, lakeside rescues, a stolen kiss, and a rewritten love song. When leaked photos force a breakup, Riot leaps from his departing car to sing with her onstage, and they choose each other and music school over Harvard and the tour.
6a826d6cfbecc43db80d69ac.title: Summer with a Superstar

6a826e8e44e10020b10b8cae.synopsis: A destitute orphan Layla accidentally stumbles into the Wolf King Kai's suite, and one night soul-binds them. He throws a check at her. She rips it up and slaps him. A month later, Layla discovers she's pregnant with sextuplets. Her greedy stepfamily sells her for $100,000. Kai transforms into a silver wolf, rescues her, and declares her his destined mate. Layla joins K-Group on her own merit. Kai secretly courts her. But Kai's rumored fiancée Chloe humiliates Layla—until Kai breaks the engagement publicly. Chloe colludes with a dark warlock to sell Layla, revealing she's a sacred vessel to break the wolf clan's curse. Kai rescues her and exposes Chloe as an identity thief. Layla is the true Grey heiress, swapped at birth. Layla delivers sextuplets, ending the curse. From abandoned orphan to matriarch of two clans, she rises to become beloved by all.
6a826e8e44e10020b10b8cae.title: A Cinderella for Wolf King

6a82a75faf43836c55050f31.synopsis: After World War III, I became a scavenger in a chaotic world, surviving by trading salvaged junk for supplies—while being bullied by classmates who would steal what I'd gathered. By chance, I discovered alien technology and rescued three beautiful women who became my wives. Now, I aim to use these assets to become the King of the Wasteland!
6a82a75faf43836c55050f31.title: I Rule the Wasteland Harem

6a82e0b7e9eb6dc4dc02e08f.synopsis: On her wedding day, Jagger Hamilton abandons Avery for his adopted sister Tatum. Jagger's uncle Beckett, Manhattan's feared "Ice Blade," marries her instead. Three years later, Avery carries Beckett's long-awaited child, but Jagger and Tatum return and brutally kill the baby. Beckett exacts brutal revenge, crippling and disowning them. Years later, Avery and Beckett welcome a healthy son, while a ruined, disabled Jagger—rejected by the family—takes his own life.
6a82e0b7e9eb6dc4dc02e08f.title: I Married the Groom's Uncle

6a83bdc05777e714af07985d.synopsis: Sold to a drug lord by her foster father, Aurora leaps from a tower and is reborn. She exposes the Harrisons' abuse, then her sealed wolf awakens, revealing her as Alpha King Vincent's long-lost daughter. Vincent brings Aurora home to a noble academy where she crushes every challenger. Three adopted brothers discover they are all her destined mates. At her coronation, Aurora exposes the Harrisons' crimes and Vincent banishes them. All three brothers declare love, leaving her choice open.
6a83bdc05777e714af07985d.title: The Alpha King's True Heiress

6a850d12889c4164400b645b.synopsis: In My Immortal Love movie, after being fired and betrayed on her birthday, Lana’s life takes a supernatural turn when she becomes the first person in 2,000 years to see Augustus—a cursed, invisible Roman immortal. Believing Lana is his destined "miracle," Augustus begs her to help break his eternal curse. There's just one deadly catch: to set him free, she must kill him. As they grow closer and undeniable sparks fly, Lana is torn between her deepening love and the cruel fate demanding his sacrifice. Can they defeat the ancient gods and break the curse without losing each other, or is their romance doomed?
6a850d12889c4164400b645b.title: My Immortal Love

6a850fc824d230ed1b0b190d.synopsis: Pampered real alpha princess Evie is framed and sent to the ruthless Werewolf Military Academy by her own family. They believe she is living comfortably, completely unaware that under the fake alpha princess's orders, Evie suffers brutal abuse. Three years later, she returns, broken inside, yet her family still views her as a spoiled brat. It is only when her father strikes her and her prosthetic limb falls off that they finally realize the horrifying truth...
6a850fc824d230ed1b0b190d.title: The Alpha Princess Is Gone for Good

6a857d2914793f87470ee412.synopsis: Rejected by his royal family and cast into the ocean as a child, Kai secretly becomes the legendary God of Tides. Years later, he returns home in disguise to find the pirate kingdom under siege. Now, Kai must save his family, all the while dealing with a father who thinks that he's worthless.
6a857d2914793f87470ee412.title: The God of Tides

6a86c823feaf9677a7003453.synopsis: Briar gave everything to her elite dragon flight and her fiancé, Silas. Her reward? Betrayal. They mocked her unawakened dragon as
6a86c823feaf9677a7003453.title: Reborn to Rule the Sky with My Dragon

6a87ad8d444b7845c203ccc2.synopsis: Bound by her late father's dying wish, ex-special forces soldier Hanna Carter buried her past and settled into quiet farm life, ma
6a87ad8d444b7845c203ccc2.title: A Farm Girl's Reckoning

6a87ee06934ea2f4e1022043.synopsis: Ryder and Enzo, F1 rivals for fourteen years, one from the slums, one a billionaire heir. Enzo whispers "I love you" during CPR; Ryder wakes convinced it was sabotage. Handcuffs, saunas, and blindfold drills force them close as Ryder battles desire. Enzo risks his life against a violent rival and quietly pays Ryder's mother's surgery. They confess at the track where it began. In the final race, Enzo pushes Ryder to victory with his own car and crashes. In the wreckage, Ryder says "I love you."
6a87ee06934ea2f4e1022043.title: T-Boning my F1 Rival

6a87fc75cd1a6219260b2137.synopsis: When the Duke dies suddenly, his greedy brother Richard steals the title and fortune. Overnight, Cordelia—the Duke’s only daughter—is stripped of her nobility and secretly blinded in a vicious plot. To protect her commoner lover, Luke, she brutally breaks his heart and drives him away. Believing she abandoned him for status, Luke leaves for the frontier, fueled by hatred. Years later, Luke returns as Luciano Thorne, the Empire's most powerful war hero and new Duke. Meanwhile, Cordelia is trapped at home, desperately guarding what's left of her inheritance. When her uncle forces the blind Cordelia to marry a 70-year-old merchant, Luciano arrives with an immense dowry to claim her himself. Luciano intends to punish her for the "betrayal." But seeing her scars and suffering, his hatred turns back into obsession. As they get caught up in revenge and irresistible attraction, the truth finally comes to light. Ultimately, the feared war god bows only to her, restoring her sight and placing the ducal crown back on the woman he has always worshiped.
6a87fc75cd1a6219260b2137.title: Forced to Marry My Ruined Ex: The Duke's Revenge

6a8ba4d6a8896f1ec604191b.synopsis: Asher secretly dated QB Chase for six months. Chase never went public—instead he played the perfect couple with Asher's sister Daisy. A naked photo of Asher leaked across campus. Daisy stole it from Chase's phone. Chase told Asher to stay quiet and kept using him. Hockey captain Finn opened Instagram in front of everyone: “Want to date? Follow me first.” Next day, he held Asher's hand in the hallway—fingers laced, for everyone to see. Daisy faked a nut allergy attack to frame Asher. Asher shoved her head into a fountain. Chase lost his game and screamed at Daisy on the sideline—his golden image shattered. Finn won, looked at the camera, and said: “Our goalie held two periods alone. I didn't want him carrying it alone anymore.” Everyone understood.
6a8ba4d6a8896f1ec604191b.title: The Quarterback’s Secret Darling

6a8ba4ddd9c22677010439b2.synopsis: Sold at auction and cast aside by the Alpha who bought her, Omega Elena is handed off to his vanished uncle—the Lycan King and War God, Finn—only to discover that her five children were his all along, and that the man she thought had betrayed her has loved and protected her from the very start.
6a8ba4ddd9c22677010439b2.title: The Alpha King Sold Me to the War God

6a8bafb465f5c507d0050da9.synopsis: In In Bed with My Brother-in-Law movie, Bella's arranged marriage becomes a nightmare when she catches her fiancé cheating. Seeking revenge, she sleeps with a stranger, unwittingly bedding her fiancé's powerful mafia boss brother, Damian Gotti. Forced back into the Gotti family, Bella faces dangerous secrets and forbidden desires. Damian relentlessly pursues her under his brother's nose. Eventually, Damian exposes his brother's crimes, saves Bella, and they unite to defend their mafia throne.
6a8bafb465f5c507d0050da9.title: In Bed with My Brother-in-Law

6a8bbc709c6562e0640a54ee.synopsis: Medieval times. Dragons rule the continent. Lydia is forced by her family to marry the "savage" Dragon King, Lucian, in her sister's place. She flees into the night — and in a blizzard-buried cabin, she encounters a dragon-shifter whose power is spiraling out of control. To save him, she gives him her virginity... The next day, she is captured. Her secret dragon pregnancy is exposed, and she is branded an unclean sinner, dragged onto the trial platform. Meanwhile, Lucian searches for her frantically, tearing a scale from his own heart to cast a tracking spell. When the crystal ball reveals the truth — that Lydia is the woman who saved him, unintentionally carrying his heir — and with Lydia's life hanging by a thread, he descends from the sky to pull her into his arms and declare to all: she is his only bride.
6a8bbc709c6562e0640a54ee.title: Fate of the Dragon’s Bride

6a8d2d531616ebd404056b3e.synopsis: When the apocalypse descended, Anya, a girl with severe social anxiety, deliberately infected herself to escape both survival and socializing. Unexpectedly, she retained her human consciousness and became a “freak zombie” with absolutely no combat power. She shouldered her backpack and embarked on a southbound road trip in search of her family. Along the way, her innate kindness led her to save survivors time and again. She met Zane, a cold and ruthless human killing machine; Leon, a fellow zombie male lead with overwhelming combat prowess; and Mia, a mad virologist. She also adopted an apocalypse-level adorable zombie dog. To find her family and uncover the truth behind the virus, the three people and one dog formed a quirky wasteland team, beginning a trope-defying, laugh-out-loud healing journey through the apocalypse.
6a8d2d531616ebd404056b3e.title: A Zombie Girl’s Journey Home

6a8d59cabdf43642fe0e20ab.synopsis: To the world, Nate Ryder is a failure whose Awakening ended in disgrace. But Nate knows the truth: he awakened the SSS-rank Thunder God—the rarest power on Earth. His father sold his health for a vial of Awakening serum. His mother has been paralyzed for ten years, yet she's the reason he never gives up. At school, the elite bully Tyler—an A-rank prodigy—crushes that serum and works with corrupt administrators to bar Nate from the national tournament. Facing relentless humiliation, Nate hides his power and bides his time. Every insult, every injustice becomes fuel for his training. Then the Federal Awakened Selection Tournament begins. Tyler, determined to defeat Nate in front of thousands, steps into the arena—expecting a hopelessly one-sided fight. Instead, Nate unleashes his SSS-rank Thunder God. In one electrifying moment, the "worthless failure" shocks the world—and begins his unstoppable rise to the top.
6a8d59cabdf43642fe0e20ab.title: SSS-Rank: The Slum-Born Thunder God

6a8e42ef484c07df8a01bcce.synopsis: Catherine, pregnant and controller of FG Group, catches her husband Jesse cheating on video with mistress Mia. She brings his disabled father Walter to the billiard parlor, where Mia shatters Catherine's family crest necklace, smokes illegally, and brutally assaults both the pregnant Catherine and elderly Walter—almost killing the unborn child. When Jesse arrives, he takes Mia's side—until he learns Walter is his biological father and Mia has committed grievous bodily harm. Business tycoon John Morgan, who had cut ties with Jesse, watches Catherine's abuse live. He arrives, reveals his true identity, and shatters Jesse's business hopes. Jesse and Mia slander Catherine, but she files suit with full evidence of assault, adultery, and illegal fund diversion. They are arrested and imprisoned. A year later, Catherine makes the Forbes list. John Morgan proposes publicly. Catherine lets go of the past and begins a new life.
6a8e42ef484c07df8a01bcce.title: Make my cheating husband pay the price

6a8e44fcd712caa73e051f91.synopsis: Raised on her Grandma's one unbreakable rule, stay away from serpents, she never expects to save a heavily wounded man in the fore
6a8e44fcd712caa73e051f91.title: The Silver Serpent's Bride

6a8e4e0c2fbe2915aa00b6f2.synopsis: Six years ago, college student Isabel was framed, leading to an unexpected encounter with billionaire heir Ethan, after which she became pregnant and dropped out of school. Six years later, Isabel works tirelessly to raise her child, who suffers from severe allergies. By a twist of fate, she joins Ethan's company and becomes his personal assistant. Faced with relentless bullying and even life-threatening schemes against her child by the vicious heiress Rachel, Isabel refuses to back down and bravely fights back. As they spend time together day and night, Ethan not only repeatedly steps in to save her but also falls deeply in love with her. As the plot unfolds, the child's true bloodline identity is unexpectedly revealed to Ethan's family, specifically his great-grandmother, Olivia. In the end, the malicious Rachel faces the consequences of her actions and is handed over to the police. Isabel unexpectedly becomes pregnant with twins—a boy and a girl—and shares a grand, perfectly happy ending with Ethan.
6a8e4e0c2fbe2915aa00b6f2.title: Secretly Pregnant with the Billionaire's Daughter

6a8e4fc5e108343d2b01885f.synopsis: Six years ago, heiress Milo left penniless Asher to save her failing family, keeping her pregnancy a secret. Now a ruthless tech billionaire still bitter about the past, Asher reunites with Milo at a gala — she’s now a desperate single mom, scrambling to pay for their son Leo’s life-saving heart surgery. As the truth of her sacrifice unfolds, a guilt-stricken Asher sets out to win her back, secures top care for their son, brings the real culprit to justice, and earns his second chance at love...
6a8e4fc5e108343d2b01885f.title: Second Chance: The Tech Billionaire’s Secret Family

6a8e7b7a96ec421187069107.synopsis: Ruby only meant to take a temporary nanny job for quick money, but she accidentally walks into the frozen world of billionaire Ethan Cole and his impossible twins. The children have already driven away sixteen nannies, Ethan runs his home like a boardroom, and every corner of the estate is ruled by cold order instead of warmth. What begins as a one-week trial quickly turns into something much larger. As Ruby challenges the household’s rigid rules, the twins slowly begin to trust again, Ethan is forced to confront the way he confuses control with parenting, and an external power struggle over custody, inheritance, and corporate leadership starts closing in. Caught between family politics and emotional chaos, Ruby becomes the first person who can truly reach the children—and the first one capable of changing Ethan himself. What started as a hired role becomes something real: she was brought in to play a mother, but she ends up becoming the heart of the family.
6a8e7b7a96ec421187069107.title: Rent-A-Mom for the Billionaire Twins

6a8e7cd3963eb73334012f37.synopsis: Three years after leaving Onyx Stormfire, Serafina meets him again at the Grand Clan Gathering hosted by the Ravenwing clan—only to find another woman at his side. No one knows that Serafina once gave up half of her own dragonfire to save Onyx from death, then pretended she had fallen for his younger brother, Corin, so Onyx would hate her and stop searching for the truth. The divided flame has left her unable to shift, and the last of her dragonfire is fading. She has returned only to see him one final time. When Corin reveals the truth, Onyx risks everything to reach her. Their twin dragonfires finally reunite, saving them both. Locke is exposed as the poisoner behind the conspiracy, while Vessa’s false pregnancy scheme falls apart. At last, Serafina and Onyx become bonded mates, vowing to grow old together.
6a8e7cd3963eb73334012f37.title: I Gave My Flame Up

6a8f2036ce8478256004c687.synopsis: Fay Thompson thought she understood the mafia world -- but the arrival of a scheming rival, a shocking pregnancy, and her lover's arrest will force her to become the Mafia Queen she was always meant to be, or lose Kent Lippert forever.
6a8f2036ce8478256004c687.title: Falling for My Ex's Mafia Dad 2

6a8fd24721a38cbb22013f3d.synopsis: Evelyn, an ordinary high school student, is publicly humiliated after her crush on a popular hockey player is exposed. Devastated, she musters up the courage to send him nudes anonymously in hopes of catching his eye. But she accidentally sends the pics to Colton instead, the captain of the hockey team who always teases her. What will happen between them?
6a8fd24721a38cbb22013f3d.title: A Spicy Text to My Nemesis

6a8febce22ae833a4c0170cf.synopsis: Laila, a destitute widow, is forced off a cliff by the tyrannical Governor Barrow—only to fall into the sacred dragon realm. There, she spends one fateful night with King Kael, a dragon sovereign bound by a deadly curse that burns any woman he touches. Ten months later, she gives birth to a royal dragon egg. Hunted by Barrow, she desperately entrusts the egg to the dragon clan. When the temple issues a decree seeking one who can hatch the egg, Laila tears down the royal notice and steps forward. Despite scorn and humiliation from the nobles, she reunites with Kael. In the end, it is her unconditional mother's love that awakens the dying egg—and a penniless commoner becomes the mother of the dragon clan's sole heir.
6a8febce22ae833a4c0170cf.title: Pregnant with the Dragon Lord's Last Heir

6a8ff3b28f0795e2880ba0dd.synopsis: Shivon has spent her life dreaming of escaping her cruel family and earning a place at the Royal Academy. But after one reckless night with the mysterious Duke Alaric Blackmoor, she discovers she’s carrying the one thing everyone believed impossible—his child. Alaric was thought incapable of producing an heir, because a wolf can only conceive with his fated mate. Now, as Shivon’s family tries to sell her to the ruthless Lord Greyfang, Alaric will stop at nothing to find the woman who may be his one true mate—and protect the impossible heir growing inside her.
6a8ff3b28f0795e2880ba0dd.title: Knocked Up by the Wolf Duke

6a94dfc6525a0f0b0507216a.synopsis: On the continent of Vester, Iso—Supreme Ruler of the Hidden Dragon Dominion—goes into hiding under a humble identity to investigate his mother Saintess Esara's murder. Disguised as an ordinary man, he takes residence in Silvermoon Castle and, honoring an old betrothal, becomes the fiancé of Sera, heiress to the saintess lineage. Sera, however, is obsessed with the legendary Dragon Lord—a mythical figure she has worshipped from afar—and feels only disappointment toward her unremarkable-looking betrothed. She frequently mocks and belittles him, unaware of his true identity. Cardinal Taren of the Orthodox Church, coveting the saintess's power, secretly hires eight renowned Dragon Slayers and rallies noble conspirators to ambush and assassinate Sera time and again. Each time, Iso secretly intervenes, wielding his silver-dragon might to save her. At Dragon Ridge Altar, he finally reveals his true form as the Dragon Lord—yet Sera fails to recognize him. The perils continue: a tavern trap, a royal council coup, and a siege by dark Dragon Slayers—all quietly thwarted by Iso from the shadows. At the climactic final banquet, the Church launches its all-out assault. Iso summons a thousand dragons before the entire assembly, shattering the enemy's ranks. Only then does Sera realize that the "ordinary" fiancé who stood by her all along is the Dragon Lord she so longed to meet. Together, they join forces to counter the Church's conspiracy and uncover the truth behind the past.
6a94dfc6525a0f0b0507216a.title: Secret Dragon

6a94ec3a834d8e48b901d181.synopsis: After his father dies saving the world, he is branded a traitor and his entire clan is destroyed. Ryan vanishes into exile, training in secret for fourteen years. Now Ryan returns to expose the dark mage's conspiracy, clear his father's name.
6a94ec3a834d8e48b901d181.title: Vindication: Blood of the Archmage

6a966a6a2b3144019f077a7f.synopsis: GT endurance driver Kai Mercer is pushed into a reserve role after refusing his sponsor’s sexual advances, while struggling with his father’s debts and his mother’s illness. Through an anonymous platform, Kai develops an intimate relationship with a mysterious man named Nox, unaware that Nox is actually Adrian Cross, his new team owner and a four-time World Endurance Champion. As Kai falls for both identities, Adrian’s secret creates a dangerous conflict of trust and power. When the truth is exposed, Kai walks away. After kidnappings, threats, professional investigations, and an ethics hearing, the two eventually rebuild their relationship, while Kai earns his place as a professional works driver.
6a966a6a2b3144019f077a7f.title: Below the Red Line

6a97cd86f09d793bab0603ad.synopsis: Born a commoner, Eleanor has spent years quietly protecting her husband, Duke Adrian, and his kingdom. Yet he has always mistaken her loyalty for ambition, believing she married him only for status and power. After being publicly humiliated and heartlessly cast aside by the man she loves, Eleanor finally gives up on their marriage and walks away. Only after she leaves does Adrian discover that the mysterious masked warrior who repeatedly saved his life was Eleanor all along. What he still does not know is that she is also the long-lost heir to a powerful empire. When Eleanor reclaims her identity and the power that rightfully belongs to her, Adrian finally realizes what he has lost. Meanwhile, an ambitious regent launches a coup, plunging the entire kingdom into crisis. With both his former wife and his realm in danger, Adrian is willing to sacrifice everything to protect Eleanor. But this time, he is no longer fighting to win back her love—only for the chance to earn her forgiveness.
6a97cd86f09d793bab0603ad.title: The Duchess They Cast Away
